da lta dus la ma bab pas ye shes snying po'i drung du btang ba yin/ nga rang gis sang dus la bab tshe bshad/ ma hā ma ya nga rang gis shes te dug mtsho'i gling na dpal zhi ba bzang po zhes bya ba/ ma rgyud kyi bdag po zhig bzhugs shing yod pas khyod khong can btang dgos gsungs/ tshogs shig bshams pa'i gral du nā ros dur khrod la phyag sdigs mdzub gtad pas/ skad cig la dur khrod so sa'i gling nas rnal 'byor pa dur khrod 'dzin pa gsum byon nas/ nga'i bu mar pa 'di lho dug mtsho'i gling du btang ba la khyed gsum gyis bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs shig gsungs pas/ gcig na re/ bdag gis dug sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las skyob gsungs/ gcig na re/ bdag gis gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa las skyob gsungs/ gcig na re/ bdag gis mi ma yin gyi 'jigs pa las skyob gsungs/ der nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ 'di nas dug mtsho'i gling la zla ba phyed kyi lam yod pas/ dug gi chu la dang por bol nub/ de nas rim bzhin pus nub/ brla phra sbom/ tha ma rkyal te song*/ shing re re 'dug pa'i rtsa ba la 'khris la song*/ gnyis gnyis 'dug pa'i bar la song*/ sa skya thal le gang 'dug tu zhag sdod gyis/ ku ku ri pa de lus la spu skyes pa/ kha mtshul spre'u 'dra ba/ mdog mi sdug pa/ cir yang brdzu ba zhig yod pas/ de la the tshom ma byed par nga nā ro pas btang ba yin gyi/ ma hā ma ya gnang ba zhu gyis la chos zhus shig gsungs/ lung bstan phyag rtags dang bcas pa mdzad nas brdzangs te/ bla ma mar pa rgya gar lho phyogs dug mtsho khol ma'i do ri la zla ba phyed kyi rgyags bzung nas/ lam bgrod dka' ba'i phyir bla ma'i bka' bzhin du byon pas/ lam bar bya gnyis 'phur song ba ma gtogs sems can gzhan gyi rigs ma mthong ba la/ dug mtsho'i do ri la phebs pa dang*/ gzhi bdag mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la sprin 'thug po 'khrigs/

glog dmar 'khyug cing 'brug sgra drag po sgrog pa dang bcas du 'gro/ ku ku ri pas ci byed/ nga 'dir bsdad pas ku ku ri pa'am de mig gis kyang ma mthong ste/ rna bas kyang ma thos gsungs/ yang gdong pa mchan du bcug thal/ gzhan du btsal pas ma rnyed tshe/ bla ma'i gsung dran nas da ci'i de ka yin pas snyam/ slar de'i drung du 'ong nas phyag byas te/ nga paṇa chen nā ros btang ba yin/ ma hā ma ya zhu ru 'ong pas gnang 'tshal zhus nas/ phyag rtags phul bas gdong pa mchan nas bton te/ ci zer nā ro pa bya ba bslabs pa'i shes rgya med/ bsgoms pa'i nyams myong med pa'i paṇa chen rgod bro/ ma hā ma ya shes ni shes/ kho rang gi bslabs pas chog mod/ mi sod dal du mi ster ba zhes skur 'debs kyi tshul dgyes dgyes 'ga' gsungs pa'i mthar/ a kyang bre mo byas pa yin/ khong paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin phyir ngas dag snang byas pas/ nged gnyis phar slob tshur slob tu song*/ ma hā ma ya khong rang gi mkhyen rung*/ bka' nga la babs pa dang*/ dag snang gis khyod nga la zhu ru btang 'dug pas mthil phyin zhig slob pa yin/ phyis nā ro'i drung du zhus la khyad ci 'dug ltos shig khyod tshur yong ba'i lam bar du mi gnyis dang 'phrad dam gsungs/ ma 'phrad zhus pas/ mir ma mthong byar mthong ba yin gsungs nas/ dbang bskur te lkug chen lkug chung brgyan pa dang gsum gyi ngang nas rnal 'byor gsum du ngo sprad pa ni/ dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas lam rgyas bsdus gsum lam du slong ba dang*/ zab pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas rig pa gsum rnal 'byor du khyer ba dang*/ mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas gnas kyi chings lnga*/ rtsa ba'i rdzogs rim nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'i don rnams rgyas par gnang*/ bar chad med par slob gnyer tshar ba dang*/ bla ma la chos rdzogs par thob pa gtang rag gi dga' ston bshams pa'i tshogs gral du/

mar pa thugs spro ba'i ngang nas bla ma dang mched lcam rnams kyi drung du gnang ba zhus nas mgur 'di phul lo// ༈ rje sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi sras// 'gro ba kun gyi rdo rje 'chang*// rgyud gnyan po rnams kyi gter bdag po// dpal zhi ba bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud// sku mthong bas nga rgyal ri bo bsnyil// gsung thos pas tha mal sems rgyud grol// thugs dran pas phyi nang mun pa bsal// deng sang dus kyi skal ldan bdag /bod nas rgya gar yul du mchis// bshul thag ring ba'i mi zhig yin// dam chos paṇ+ḍi ta la zhus// brgyud pa nye ba'i dam chos thob// rje dngos grub can gyi zhabs la btugs// mi dang mi min bar chad zhi// gsang sngags pha rgyud ma rgyud thob// gdams ngag che ba'i ston pa yin// dpal zhi ba bzang pos thugs la btags// bla ma bzang po'i bu gcig yin// bar chad med par lho bal bgrod// las 'phro can gyi ban Zེ yin// bde mchog rgyud rgyal bde blag khums// sgrub thag nye ba'i dam chos yin// bkra shis lung bstan zhal nas thos// mi lus thob pa'i don go yin// lho brag bod du lte ba bcad// dkar po'i rgya la las 'phro sad// grub thob mkhas pa rnams dang mjal// dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag thob// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug zhabs drung du// rnal 'byor gsum gyi don la bslabs// sgyu ma chen po'i ma dang mjal// kun tu bzang po'i pha rgan bsten// chags lam ting 'dzin nyams su bdar// shes rab gsum gyi sgron me rgyas// gti mug gsum gyi mun pa bsal// sgrib pa gsum gyi bud shing bsregs// ngan song gsum gyi dur sa stongs// bka' drin che'o bla ma rje// skyid do chos kyi blo gros bdag /dga' 'o 'dir bzhugs mched lcam kun// zhes pa'i glu bod skad du blangs pas bod kyi grogs dang bod skad go ba med pa'i phyir/

Zrma shrī la sogs pa'i mched grogs rnams na re/ bod smyo ba min nam gsungs pa la bdag rigs dang las 'phro khyad par can yod kyang*// skye ba 'di'i bag chags shas mthug pa'i stobs kyis glu bod skad du byung ba yin gsungs nas/ slar rgya gar gyi skad du bsgyur bas khong rnams ngo mtshar skyes so// da nā ro pa'i drung du myur bar 'gro dgos dgongs pa la/ ིra gyi rje mar pa mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i snyan pa la brten/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i ngang nas chos thob pa zhig byed dgongs pa rgyun chags su yod pa las/ khyad par bla mas rdzong dang tshogs 'khor gnang ba'i snga nub mngon sum du yang yang dran zhing mchog tu dad pa zhig byung bas/ yid kyi maṇ+ḍal dang yan lag bdun pa phul/ gsol ba btab pas rmi lam du/ mai tri pa'i pho nya yin zer ba'i bud med mdzes ma lag tu bum pa thogs pa zhig byung nas/ de'i bum pa dang phyag mar pa'i dbu thog tu bzhag pa zhig rmi ba las/ mnal sad pa dang dga' spro dpag tu med pa zhig thob par gyur to// de nas rje btsun mar pa 'byon par chas pa la/ dpal zhi ba bzang pos mar pa'i rdzongs su tshogs 'khor mdzad nas/ gnang ba'i chos rnams kyi dpe cha rnams gnang zhing*/ phyag mar pa'i dbu thog tu bzhag ste zhal nas/ nged kyi 'dug sa 'di lam bgrod dka' bar yod kyang*/ khyod 'dir slebs pas don chen thob/ nā ro pas khyod skal ldan du mkhyen nas nga'i sar yang brdzangs/ mai tri pa'i sar yang rdzong ba 'dug cing*/ nā ro pa rang gis kyang brtse bas rjes su bzung ste ci 'dod kyi gdams pa gnang nas/ kha ba can 'dul ba'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol bar 'dug cing*/ de bzhin du ngas kyang khyod dang po yong ba shes nas/ bsu ba la srung ma mir sprul nas btang ba yin te/ mir ma mthong byar mthong 'dug da gdams ngag dpe cha dang bcas pa byin nas/ bkra shis mnga' gsol byed pa yin pas dga' bar gyis shig gsungs nas/

mnyes mnyes mdzad pas rmi lam dang lung bstan mthun par byung ste/ rje mar pas/ bla ma la phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa dang dga' spro dpag tu med pa zhig thob nas/ mar pas phyi phyag gi tshul du/ bla ma dang chos grogs rnams la yang rtogs pa 'di mgur du phul lo// ༈ 'di na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rnams// snying grogs spun rnams snyan gsan 'tshal// mgo rgod mar pa lo tsā ngas// las 'brel sad pas lho bal phyin/ dngos grub can gyi bal po dang*// ye shes snying po zhi bzang la// gdan bzhi gsang 'dus bde mchog skor// rgyud dang man ngag gter kha phyes// da lta slob dpon zhal snga nas// zhus pa gnang ba'i dam chos tshar// lung bstan bkra shis dus gcig thob// mdang sang thal ba'i khar nub tu// maṇ+ḍal yid kyis bshams nas kyang*// mai tri pa la gsol btab snyam// 'khrul pa'i bag chags rmi lam du// mnga' bdag mai tri'i pho nya mo// bud med lus la bzhin rgyas ma// lag na bum pa thogs pa yis// mi kho bo'i mgo la reg pa rmis// thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs pa 'dra// sngon smon lam las kyi 'brel lam bsam// de phyir dad 'dun drag bzhin spongs// sgrub pa rgyun chad med par mdzod// ces phul ba dang*/ bla ma zhi ba bzang pos mar pa'i dbu thog tu phyag bzhag nas bar chad med par byin gyis brlabs so// de nas bla ma mar pas sgyu ma chen po'i skor rnams mkhyen te/ tshur byon pas zhag gsum la pua ha rir phebs/ rje nā ro pa chen po des dge tshul shes rab seng ge gcig pu la man ngag zhig gnang gin 'dug pas/ ma 'ong gsung ba'i phyag gis brda' zhig byung bas/ de ma grol bar phyag 'tshal zhing bsdad/ chos thon pa dang drung du phyin/ byin rlabs zhus pas/ chos thob bam gsungs/ thob lags zhus pas/ khong nga la gshe zhing mi 'dug gam gsungs/ bre mo gsung gin gda' zhus pas/ ji skad gsung gin 'dug gsungs/ gsungs tshul zhus pas/

de kho rang yin mod/ yon tan med par dug mtsho'i gling mi med par sdod/ mi'i lus la spre'u'i gdong pa yod pas/ phyag rgya ma mi ma 'byor par khyi mo la byed mkhan ku ku ri pa min pa su yod gsungs bzhad nas/ a rkyang de ga khong gi che ba yin/ de khong min pa gzhan gyis mi yong zhing*/ khong gis nga las dgyes pa rdo rje gsan/ khong ma hā ma ya'i grub thob yin pas ngas zhus pa yin gsungs/ ma hā ma ya tshar gcig nā ro pas kyang gnang byung ba don la khyad med pa la/ tshig nā ro pas gsungs pa rnams cung zad rgyas pa dang dod pa zhig byung bas/ bla ma rang gis 'di lta bu mkhyen bzhin du bdag dug mtsho'i gling du dka' las de tsam du byed du 'jug pa ci lags zhus pas/ khong ma rgyud kyi bdag po yin zhing gdams ngag la nges shes skyed pa dang*/ khungs btsun pa'i phyir btang ba yin gsungs/ der bla ma mar pas shar phyogs £ ga la na kha sa/ pa ṇi rang byon gyi lha khang yod pa gzigs su byon/ de'i tshe ma hā ma ya'i bgro gleng mdzad par dgongs te/ gnyos na leu na bla ma bi lam ta pa la chos zhu zhing yod pa'i sar byon te/ tshong 'dus nas zas chang mang po nyos nas gsol ba'i tshe ma hā ma ya'i bgro gleng mdzad pas rje mar pa rgyal ba dang*/ gnyos na re/ khyod la ma rgyud slob pa'i slob dpon de su yin zer bas/ mar pas bla ma gsang ste/ nga'i bla ma rnal 'byor gsum dang ldan// dman pa dbyibs la zab pa sngags// mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor pa// bla ma thar pa'i lam ston yin// da lta grong khyer ser skya na'o// zhes gsungs pas/ gnyos kyis ser skyar phyin nas/ bla ma thar pa'i lam ston gang na bzhugs zhes 'dri zhing btsal pas/ bla ma thams cad thar pa'i lam ston yin pa la/ khyod la su dgos pa yin zer byung bas/ bden snyam/ bla ma gsang bar shes rung rtsad bcad pas dang po ma chod/ phyis chod rung dug mtsho'i lam ma bgrod par gnyos dpal ku ku ri pa dang ma mjal skad/

de nas rje mar pa dpal nā ro pa'i drung du byon te/ bdag grogs po dang 'phrad nas ma brgyud bgro gleng byas pas bdag rgyal/ khong na re/ rgyud slob pa'i slob dpon su yin 'dri ba la/ bdag gis ma bshad lags zhus pas/ bla ma gsang mi dgos pa yin te/ khong gser mang yang des chog pa min/ bsod nams dang las 'phro dgos pa yin gsungs/ de nas mar pas nā ro pa la mai tri pa'i drung du 'gro ba'i gsol ba btab pas/ dgyes bzhin gnang ba las/ bla ma nā ro pa la mnyes pa'i mchod pa dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje spun rnams la tshogs gtor phul nas/ bar chad med par gsol ba btab pas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung ngo*// de nas lam la zhugs te/ mai tri pa gang na bzhugs zhes 'dri zhing byon pas/ ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dgon pa na bzhugs te lam bgrod dka' mo rang yod pas ma phyin pa drags zer ba 'ga' byung bas/ tshe 'di'i phyir nor tshol ba ni min/ chos phyir shi na'ang shi 'gro dgos dgongs pa thugs la shar nas the tshom med par byon te/ mai tri pa'i bzhugs sar nyi ma snga phyed tsam la phebs pas/ shing ‚ gro Z'i grib ma la bzhugs pa dang mjal bas/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags dang mjal ba lta bu'i dga' ba chen po skyes nas brkyang phyag lan bdun btsal/ gser la sogs kyi 'bul ba bgyis te/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la bstod pa'i mgur 'di phul lo// ༈ khyed 'gro ba'i don du 'dzam gling 'dir// rgyal po'i rigs su skye ba bzhes// phyi nang sgrub thabs sna tshogs mkhyen// mai tri pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun sgrol mas lung bstan nas// bar chad med par byin gyis brlabs// ri khrod dbang phyug zhabs rdul reg /a wa ZÓ ti khyod la bstod// sku ni rin chen gser gyi ri// ye shes smon sogs rnam dag pa// nyon mongs nad rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i// chos kyi nyi ma khyed la bstod// thugs ni stong nyid rdo rje yis// bdag lta'i ri bo chen po 'joms// chos rnams mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa'i// mnyam med bla ma rje la bstod// sprul sku 'dzam gling kun gyi rgyan// rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid// thugs rje'i gter ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// gtsug gi rgyan gyur khyod la bstod// mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs// gang zhig dregs can ma lus pa// brtul zhugs nus pas bka' nyan mdzad// rdo rje 'dzin pa khyed la bstod// bde gshegs bla ma thugs rje can// mnga' 'bangs bor nas dam chos mdzad// paṇa chen nā ro la sogs pa'i// bla ma kun las gdams ngag zhus// rgyud sde'i slob gnyer 'ga' re tshar// lho dug mtsho khol ma'i do ri la// dpal zhi ba bzang po'i zhabs drung du// dam pa khyed kyis thugs rjes bzung*// srog phangs pa med par drung du 'ong*// ri bo me 'bar gyi dgon pa na// shing ‚ gro Z'i bsil grib la// mnga' bdag rgyal sras mai tri pa// pha sangs rgyas khyed dang da lta mjal// nyi ma shar 'dra'i dad pa skyes// shi yang phod pa'i dad pa g.yos// kha gting med par gsol ba btab// rgyun chad med par byin gyis brlabs// bram ze chen po'i srol 'dzin cing*// sprul pa'i ri khrod dbang phyug drung*// legs par 'ong ba dam pa'i chos// theg pa'i yang rtse snying po'i don// mtha' bral phyag rgya chen po de// nam mkha' lta bur gnang ba zhu// zhes gsol ba btab pas/

mnga' bdag gis rjes su bzung ste dbang bskur rnams rdzogs par mdzad cing*/ gsang mtshan thugs kyi rdo rjer btags/ de'i tshe bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa/ mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs gtor rnams bshams pas ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang po byung zhing*/ bla mas phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ rgyud stod pa glur blangs 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ do ha'i bshad pa dang bcas pa rnams cig car du sgro 'dogs chod par gnang zhing*/ nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs bzang po thugs la 'khrungs pas thugs dgyes par gyur tshe/ bla ma la gtang rag gi mchodV nyi zla la// bla ma mnga' bdag byams mgon bzhugs// bdag gi sems rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// yi dam lha tshogs ji snyed pa// dbyer med dpal ldan ZÓ ti pa// snying gi paVོsa tshul bzhin zhus// khyad par phyag rgya chen po zhus// chos shes pa rnams kyi sgro 'dogs bcad// mi shes pa rnams slob gnyer byas// rje sa ra ha yi bka' srol gyi// byin rlabs dang rtogs pa dus gcig byung*// rje la rtogs 'bul gyi dbyangs shig len// phyi nang grub mtha' sna tshogs kun// rtogs shing phyag rgya chen por 'dus// snang ba bad// gzhi sems nyid chos skur da gzod go /mi kho bo'i the tshom da gzod zad// 'khrul pa'i gzhi rtsa da gzod zhig /tha snyad la sangs rgyas mi re bas// rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhabs drung du// don nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu dang*// brgyud pa rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// go ba nyams myong rtogs pa 'di// phul ba bla ma rje btsun dang*// mched grogs 'dir bzhugs dgyes par mdzod// ces phul bas mnga' bdag mai tri pas mar pa la zhal gdams bcu gnyis rdo rje'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ bu dad pa'i rtsa ba mi brtan na// gnyis med kyi rtsa ba brtan mi 'gyur// phyogs med kyi snying rje ma skyes na// gzugs sku rnam gnyis thob mi 'gyur// shes rab rnam gsum ma bar na// sems la ltos la ma yengs sgoms// rkyen gyis sems la gnod gyur na// dbang bzhi'i nyams len rgyun du gyis// nyon mongs rang rgyud shor gyur na// bla ma'i gdams pa dran par gyis// rtse gcig gsol ba ma btab na// dam pa'i thugs dgongs ga la longs// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ma bsgoms na// 'khor 'das dbyer med ga la rtogs// bcu gnyis rdo rje'i mgur ldan pa// dran pa dang bcas bcu gsum 'di// rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pas na// bcu gsum pa la gnas par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/

mar pa'i thugs la shin tu 'thad cing 'jags par gyur nas/ mai tri pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i ngang nas byon te pua ha rir nā ro pa'i drung du phebs pas/ nā ro pa'i zhal nas lho dug mtsho'i 'gram gyi dur khrod so sa gling na/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'brel tshad don ldan rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa zhig bzhugs pa de'i drung du song la gdan bzhi zhus shog gzhan yang rang gang mos kyis ku su lu rnams la chos ci 'dod zhus shog gsungs pa ltar/ṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ gdan bzhi'i dbang gdams ngag rnams dgyes bzhin rdzogs par gnang*/ gzhan yang dpal sing gha gling pa la sogs te/ dur khrod dang shing drung na bzhugs pa'i ku su lu'i rnal 'byor pa mtshan ldan 'ga' dang 'ga' la bskyed rdzogs kyi dbang gdams ngag dang*/ 'phral dgos kyi gdams ngag phran tshegs mang po skabs skabs su zhus pas// gdams ngag gi gter mdzod du gyur pa lags so// de nas nā ro'i drung du phebs/ phyag phul nas snyun dris pas/ khyod dbang gdams ngag rnams yid ches po byung ngam gsungs/ lo rgyus rnams zhus pas shin tu mnyes par gyur to//

nyam rtogs thugs la 'khrungs tshul/༈ de nas rje mar pas/ dpal nā ro pa la bde mchog gi dbang gdams ngag rgyud 'grel bshad pa rnams dgos zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang rgyas par gnang rgyud 'grel bshad lung du gnang nas/ gal nyams len che ba yin gsungs/ bka' babs bzhi'i gdams par grags pa nā ro chos drug dang*/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sems su ngo sprabs/ thugs spro ba'i ngang nas nyin mtshan 'da' ba byung ngo*// de nas mar pa'i thugs la ngas bal po dang rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis tsam song 'dug ste/ dbang dang gdams ngag mang po yang thob pa tsam du ma bzhag par tshig don gnyis la slob gnyer dang nyams len mi 'gyod pa byas pas/ smra rgyu dang bsgom rgyu yang gzhan la smon mi dgos pa byung*/ byed dgos pa shar nas/ gser lhag ma gang yod kyis lam chos tsam zhig ma gtogs kun gyis yo byad bsgrubs te/ bram ze ku sa mu to dang*/ rnal 'byor ma su ka Z ri la sogs pa rnams bkug nas/ paṇa chen nā ro pa la gtang rag dang*/ dga' ston tshogs mchod phul ba'i gral du mar pa'i thugs dgongs la/ nga bod nas rgya gar du 'ong pa'i don la bla ma mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mang po dang mjal/ rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa mang po thob cing slob gnyer byas/ sgra skad lo tsā ni mkhas pa'i tshad du shes/ nyams dang rtogs pa phyin ci ma log pa ni rgyud la skyes/ da bar chad med pa bod du log 'gro ba yin pas/ dus de ring las dga' ba mi yong dgongs nas mgur chen brgyad kyi thog ma/ ༈ dpal nā ro pa'i drung du dbyangs ring te pu'i ri'i khong rgyud kyi skad la rta drangs te/ rtogs pa 'di mgur du phul ba lags so// rje mtshan dz+nya na siK'i zhabs la 'dud// sgra sgyur bod kyi ban chung nga*// sbyangs pa snga ma'i las 'brel gyis// nā ro paṇa chen khyed dang mjal// rgyud zab mor grags pa'i dgyes rdor bslabs// snying po ma hā ma ya gnang*// yang snying bde mchog 'khor lo zhus// lar rgyud sde bzhi yi khong snying phyung*/

ma skal ba bzang mos rjes gnang ba'i// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma chad pa'i// dbang gzhi'i don la ngo sprod mdzad// zag pa med pa'i ting 'dzin skyes// zhag bdun bar du brtan pa thob// srog rtsol 'pho ba nyi zla gnyis// g.yo med nam mkha'i khyim du tshud// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams// bde gsal mi rtogs khong nas shar// bag chags gnyid kyi 'khrul pa de// 'od gsal lam gyi ngo bor rtogs// yid kyi g.yo ba gzung 'dzin gnyis// spros bral chos kyi sku ru thim// phyi nang sgyu ma'i 'khru+ul 'khor 'di// skye med phyag rgya chen por rtogs// nang 'dzin pa yid kyi rnam shes 'di// sngon chad mdza' bo 'phrad pa bzhin// sems nyid rang ngo rang gis shes// lkugs par rmi lam rmis pa bzhin// brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar// gzhon nus bde ba myong ba bzhin// smra ru med pa'i don zhig rtogs// rje sku drin che'o nā ro pa// sngar yang dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs// da dung bka' drin bskyab tu gsol// zhes phul bas/ nā ro'i phyag mar pa'i dbu thog tu bzhag nas zhal gdams kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā khyod// chos brgyad tshe 'di'i don ma sgrubs// gzung 'dzin nga khyod res ma gcod// nye du dgra la skur ma 'debs// gzhan gyi chos la sgro ma 'dogs// thos bsam mun bsal sgron me yin// thar pa'i lam mchog 'phrang ma gcod// sngar yang bla rje yin pas mchog /phyis kyang 'khur zhing blos ma spang*// rang sems nor bu rin chen 'di// dred por chu la ma bskur bar// bag zon yengs med srungs shig dang*// dgos 'dod bsam pa thams cad 'grub// ces dang*/ gzhan yang thugs brtse ba'i gsung mang po gnang ba rnams dgyes bzhin/ slar yang sku drung du yong ba'i dam bca' phul nas bod la byon no// de nas gsum pa dbang gdams ngag sogs dam pa'i chos rnams thob nas slar bod du byon tshul ni/

mar pas 'tsho chas rnams rdzogs pa dang mnyam du gnyos kyi chas kyang zad de/ phan tshun dus bsgrigs nas tshur lam yang yang gnyos dang bsdebs nas byon pa las/ gnyos kyi yid la/ nged gnyis gser nga mang rung chos kho mkhas rigs su 'dug snyam pa'i phrag dog gi bsam ngan shar te/ gnyos la grogs paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis/ a tsa ra gcig dang*/ gzhan yang lam grogs 'ga' bzung 'dug pa la gnyos kyi dpe cha sogs chas rnams bskur 'dug mar pas phyag dpe'i khres po byas nas bsnams byon pas/ gnyos na re/ rang re lo tsā ba chen po khres po 'khur ba mi yong bas/ a tsa ra 'di la bskur zer ba ltar bskur bas/ gnyos kyis a tsa ra la pho brngan byin nas/ mar pa'i dpe cha chu la shor ba ltar gyis la bskur byas nas kha lag bslabs pabazhin/ a tsa ras gru chu bo gang gā'i dbus su slebs tshe/ mar pa'i phyag dpe chu la bskur ba las/ gnyos kyis byas pa mkhyen cing*/ bod du gser 'tshol ba'i dka' las/ rgya gar du bla ma 'tshol ba'i dka' las/ chos dang gdams pa de 'dra gzhan la dkon pas/ med par song bas/ chu la lceb bam lceb bam snyam pa'i thugs las chen po byung tshe/ bla ma'i gdams ngag dran nas thugs las cung zad chung bar gyur zhing*/ gnyos la ngan lan byed pa'i thugs 'dun ma shar rung*/ 'di khyod kyis byas pa yin byas pas/ ma byas zer/ gru thon phral a tsa ra bzung nas rgyal po la zhu byas pas/ a tsa ras gnyos kyi bslab tshi gnod byed mi rigs shing*// khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la// gnod pa de 'dra ga la rigs// nyon mongs dug lnga'i bsam sbyor gyis// mi bdag gi dpe dang lhan cig tu// mi khyod kyis bsgrubs pa'i snyan grags dang*// gser dang dam chos chu la 'pho// nga rang mthong che ma yin te// gzhan la dkon pa'i khyad chos dga'// gzhan phan med pas blo ma bde// 'on kyang nan tan zhu dag gis// chos dang rang gi sems rgyud 'dres// tshig don ma brjed wa ler bdog

/slar yang rgya gar yul du yong*// paṇa chen nā ro la sogs pa'i// grub thob rnams las zhus pas chog /mi khyed rang deng nas bla ma dang*/ chos bshad lo tsā'i khur bor la// gnong 'gyod dang bcas yul la byon// sdig la mthol bshags drag po gyis// bsam sbyor de 'dra byed bzhin du// bla ma'i rlom sems byas lags kyang*// blun po 'ga' yi mgo skor las// skal ldan smin grol ga la 'byung*// mi lus rin chen rnyed dka' 'dis// ngan song gsum po mi sgrub 'tshal// ces de skad gsungs pas/ gnyos na re/ da sems las ma byed par/ nga'i dpe cha ma phyir g.yar nas bris pas chog zer bas/ khyod kyi ma phyi e g.yar yang mi shes/ g.yar rung khyod dang nga bla ma dang gdams ngag ma gcig pas phan yang mi thogs/ khyod kyi dpe cha bas nga rang gi blo la yod pa rnams dga' ste/ 'on kyang rgya gar du myur du slebs pa zhig byed dgongs pa thugs la shar zhing*/ zhal nas/ de ga byed pas ma phyi g.yor zhig gsungs so// de nas bal por phebs pa dang*/ gnyos dang bsdebs rung sdig gsog pa 'dug dogs nas mi 'gro ba'i lo rgyus byas pas/ gyes 'gro khar/ gnyos na re/ 'o na dpe cha chu la shor ba'i gtam gang du su la'ang ma gtong bar nga'i sar dpe cha 'bri bar shog zer ba ltar chad mdo byas nas/ ga la phrag dog byas dpe cha chu la 'pho dus/ thugs spro ma langs par khong la dbyangs gsungs pa thos pas ngo mtshar che/ de lta bu'i thugs dam thog tu khel ba de/ lta ba bzang po phyin ci ma log pa 'khrungs pa'i rtags yin pas/ lta ba mthar phyin pa gzhung gi tshig la ma brten par khyed rang gi thugs la 'khrungs pa'i mgur zhig gsung 'tshal zhus pa la 'di gsungs so// ༈ 'dren pa'i bla ma dam pa dang*// ha du dkar pos dbu mdzad pa'i// khyod mdo sngags kyi slob gnyer tshang ba rnams// yud tsam zhig bod kyi glu la nyon// mthar thug gi lta ba khyad par can// zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin// thabs shes ya bral 'dod pa gang*// mtha' ru lhung bas dgag bya'i phyir// khyed mkhyen pa'i drung du brjod dka' yang*// dbyangs sngon chad ma blangs sdug par 'gro// bstan bcos dbyangs su blang gi gsan// dngos po 'dzin pa dgag bya'i phyir// bdud sde bcom pas med ces gsungs// don de 'dra bzhin du bzung bas bsgribs// 'khor mang yon tan 'byung ba'i dpal// khyad par thabs ni gyur pa spangs// rmongs pa stong pa chad par 'dod// dge tshogs sun 'byin chad pa'i mtha'// nam mkha'i me tog zhen pa rnams// dkar po'i lo tog 'joms pa yi// ser ba log pa'i lta ba yin// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid shes par gyis// stong pa mi shes skyes bu kun// med la yod par sgra yis btags// log pa mig rgyu chu 'dzin cing*// don la rmongs pa 'khor ba'i rgyu// sems tsam mu stegs grangs can sogs// thabs dang shes rab ya bral 'dod// so so rang rang grub mtha' yang*// shing skam me tog 'dod dang mtshungs// khas len thams cad bral ba yi// don de rab tu mi gnas pa'i// rab tu shes pa shes phyin te// mi gnas srid dang zhi ba'i mtha'// snying rje stong pa'i snying po can// thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug

/de ni rang byung lhan cig skyes// de ltar bde dang stong pa dang*// rig pa dang ni stong pa nyid// tha dad med par bdag gis go /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang*// gdod nas rang bzhin stong pa nyid// dbyer med rang bzhin spros bral du// chos rnams de ltar go bar mdzod// lta bas mtshon pa'i tshig tsam du// zhen pa'i yul du bdag gir mdzod// 'jig rten pa yi lta ba de// rgyu 'bras las la yid ches byas// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za// mkhyen pa mchog gis de skad gsungs// mi gang snying rje med pa rnams// til 'bras me yis tshig pa la// de la 'bras bu ga la 'byung*// gzhi med khyad par ga la yod// de la theg chen yod ma yin// mkhyen rab na ga dzu nas gsungs// dmigs yul lta ba ma mchis na// dam chos gnang ba don med yin// sbun pa 'bras bu med dang mtshungs// de skad mar pa lo tsā zer// khyed mkhyen pa'i don la thugs rgyas rnams// don go bar gda' na bzod par gsol// zhes pa gsungs pas/ bla ma bal po pa dang*/ grogs ha du dkar po la sogs pa rnams dgyes par gda'o// de nas mar pa bod la chas byon pa las// li sho ka ra zhes bya ba bal bod mtshams kyi grong khyer sho gam mang po len pa zhig yod pa der zhag shas bzhugs dgos byung ba las/ nub tha ma'i rmi lam du mkha' 'gros do li la btegs nas lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la byon pas/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang mjal te lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs pas snying po don gyi chos phyag rgya chen po'i brda don rnams gnang bas/ sku la zag med kyi bde ba dang thugs la phyin ci ma log pa'i rtogs pa shar bas dga' spro dpag tu med pa zhig rmis pa las/ mnal sad nas gsung rnams ma brjed par 'dug ste/ glang po mkhar du zla ba gnyis tsam chos gsungs shing bzhugs pas/ gtsang gyer phu'i klog skya jo sras sku gshegs nas gdan sa 'dzin pa'i sras po che bas gsan te/

skyid drung du na 'dren mi btang bar 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ dus btab nas btang bas dpal khud kyi lha mtsho srin mtsho nas bsu ba dang bcas/ gyer phur gdan phebs pas sna len bzang po byas/ zla ba gcig gi bar du chos grwa chen po btsugs/ zla ba yar gyi ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i gral du jo sras kyi bla ma mar pa la/ bla ma khyed la nged yab sras kyis sngar yang sna len bzang po byas pa lags/ da yang bgyid pa lags pas/ de ring tshogs gral 'dir sngon chad tshig tu ma brjod cing*/ tshig dang don du 'dril ba'i dbyangs shig gsung 'tshal zhus pas/ kho bos kha seng dpyid ka bal po mthil nas yar 'gro lam gcig yod pa'i sa na/ li sho ka ra bya ba mtha' 'khob kyi grong khyer sho gam len pa zhig 'dug pa der kho bos zhag 'ga' bsdad pas/ nub gcig gi rmi lam na rigs kyi mtshan ldan ma bram ze'i bu mo'i cha byad du byas nas/ kho bo lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la 'dong zer nas khrid de// rje bram ze chen po dang dngos su mjal ba'i rmi lam byung*/ de'i dus yid la mi byed pa snying po'i don/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas 'di lta bu thos gsungs te/ lta ba khyung chen gyi gshog rgyangs lding ba'i skad la rta drangs te sems gnad du bsnun pa do ha rdo rje'i mgur chen 'di gsungs pa lags so// ༈ dpal de ring bkra shis yar gyi ngo*// dus khyad par can gyi tshes bcu la// dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshogs gral du// bu 'gyur ba med pa'i dam tshig can// khyed klog skya jo sras zhu 'bul ba// sngar ma thos pa yi glu longs skad// nga bshul ring lam la gshar ba des// lus ngal dub dbang du song ba'i phyir// glu yid 'phrog snyan po ma mchis shing*// tshig sdeb sbyor mkhas po mi shes kyang*// grogs khyed bas ngo che med pa'i phyir// ngo che'i dpral ba mi ldog pas// don sngar ma thos pa'i ya mtshan can// bram ze'i bzhed dgongs glur len pas// khyed gdan gang bzhugs pa'i mdo sngags rnams// snyan lhan ner gsan la thugs dgongs 'tshal// dus kha sang dpyid zla tha chung la// gzhi bal po'i mthil nas yar 'phags pa'i// gdugs gro lam mchis kyi shul kha na// bal po ling gi sho gam ri// gdol pa can gyi grong khyer du// mi brda mi 'jal gyi sho gam pas// mgron kha zhan po yi bod rnams bskyil// mi ngas kyang dbang med zhag 'ga' bsdad// dgung nub gcig tham thum rmi lam na// rigs kyi mtshan ldan tshangs skud can// bram ze'i bu mo mdzes ma gnyis// cung zad 'dzum zhing zur mikyang*// glog 'gyu skad cig yud tsam la// lho dpal gyi ri la phyin pa rmis// shing blag sha ljon pa'i bsil grib la// ti ra ro yi gdan steng na// rje bram ze chen po sa ra ha// zhal sngar ma mthong ba'i gzi mdangs can// btsun mo gnyis kyis mtha' brte+en nas// sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum mdangs can// bo ba// glang chen chang gis myos pa bzhin// g.yo 'gul med pa'i nyams shig shar// ngag la gsung gis byin rlabs pa// stong nyid seng ge'i nga ro yis// yi ge med pa'i don gsungs pa// lkugs par rmi lam rmis pa bzhin// brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar// yid la thugs kyis byin rlabs pa// lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// 'gro 'ong med pa'i don rtogs pas// dur khrod gnas pa'i mi ro bzhin// bsam du med pa'i nyams shig shar// de rjes bde chen dag pa'i gsung*// rin chen mgur gyi bum pa nas// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi brda skad kyis// sprin bral nam mkha' stong pa'i don// gnas lugs mtshon pa rdo rje'i mgur// skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos// na mo stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// rgyun chad med par gnyug ma'i sems// gdod nas dag pa de bzhin nyid// nam mkhas nam mkha'i sbyor ba mthong*// rtsa ba khyim na gnas pa'i phyir// yid kyi rnam shes btson du bzung*// sgom pa shes pa phyi ma yis// sems la lhan pa gdab tu med// snang srid sems kyi rang bzhin shes// gnyen pos ngan 'das pa thob byar med// tha mal shes pa rang lugs de/

ma bcos so ma nyid du zhog /bya ba rnams la dpyod ma rtog /phyogs dang cha la mi gnas shing*// spros bral nam mkha'i dkyil du ltos// chos zad sar 'khyol ba snying po'i don// lta ba'i yang rtse phyag rgya che// sems gnad du bsnun pa'i brda don zhig /bram ze chen po'i zhal nas thos// skad cig de la gnyid kyang sad// de ma brjed dran pa'i lcags kyus zin// ma rig gnyid kyi mun khung du// rig pa ye shes mthongs phye nas// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ltar// 'khrul pa'i mun nag sangs nas thal// dus gsum sangs rgyas zhal mjal yang*// phyin chad dri rgyu med do snyam// sems kho thag chod pa'i nyams shig shar// yid 'gyu ba zad pa ngo mtshar che// e ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang*// bla mas gsungs pa zab mo'i don// ngag smra ru mi btub gsungs na yang*// dgung do nub mi smra'i thabs ma byung*// dus da res tsam zhig ma gtogs pa// sngon chad ngag tu brjod ma myong*// da phyin chad bzlas sam rna bas nyon// da sngon chad bshul ring rgyang gi mi// mdza' bshes gnyen med grogs kyang med// lus ngal dub bkres par gyur pa'i tshe// bu khyed kyis gang byas sems la yod// de ma brjed sems la shin tu gcags// drin 'khor bar thal lo snying gi grogs// rje gong na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong rnams// mi bdag la bka' bkyon mi gnang 'tshal// don 'khrul par gda' na bzod par gsol// zhes pa'i mgur gsungs pa dang*/ klog skya jo sras kyis/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ngo*// de nas rje mar pa lho brag tu 'byon pa'i zhar la phyi mo yong rigs su mi 'dug na'ang*/ tshod ltar rung dgongs nas kha rag tu gnyos kyi sar byon/ dpe cha'i phyi mo rnams dgos gsungs pas/ rje mar pa la gnyos kyis gser srang gang dang maṇ+ḍal gcig phul nas/

ma hā ma ya la khyed rang 'dris par 'dug pas dpe mi dgos pa 'dug khyod kyis ma hā ma ya sogs ma rgyud kyi bdag gyis la shod/ ngas gsang 'dus sogs pha rgyud kyis bdag gyis bshad kyis zer phyi mo ma byung bas/ rgya gar la myur du 'byon pa'i thugs 'dun drag po dang bcas lho brag tu phebs pa las yab yum gnyis ni sku gshegs 'dug slob dpon dang jo bo chen po rnams kyis sna len bzang po byas// sngar slob 'bangs su song bas chos ni ma zhus te/ chos mthong chen po byas/ de'i stobs kyis nye 'khor gyi yul pas kyang chos zhu ba dang phyag 'tshal mkhan ni med/ zhe sa mthong cha 'jog ni dga' rab byas/ lho brag gi thag ring sa nas chos dbang zhu ba yang 'ga' re byung zhing*/ phyag dang 'bul ba phran tshegs byed pa mang dag byung bar gyur to// rgya gar la byon thengs dang po'o// ༈ bar pa la yang snga ma ltar don gsum las/ dang po gser 'tshol du byon zhing bu slob rnams dang mjal tshul ni/ gser 'tshol ba'i phyag phyi la 'khrid dgongs nas/ lho brag gi ban btsun chos zhus pa dga' la/ cho ga tshig don lag len dang bcas pa bslabs pa rnams zhabs tog la 'khrid/ dbang rdzas dang mchod cha bzang po bsnams/ chibs pa gcig 'jal nas chibs byon te/ dbus kyi gtsang po'i lhor phebs nas chu kha zhig tu gsol mdzad cing bzhugs par/ sngags btsun dpon slob kyi rnam pa can gnyis byung ba'i drag pa des na re/ drung pa rnams gang nas phebs/ gang du 'byon zer bas/ grwa pa rnams kyi nang nas smra mkhas pa zhig yod pa des/ drung pas gsan las che rje'i zhal snga nas/ rgya gar gyi mkhas grub nā ro paṇa chen gyi dngos slob sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā zhes bya ba'i bla ma de yin/ nged dpon slob skal ldan las 'phro can rnams smin grol la 'god pa dang*/ skal med rnams la yang rnam dkar gyi las 'brel 'jog pa'i phyir dang*/ slar yang bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du rgya gar la 'byon pa'i yo byad gser gyi 'bul sdud la 'byon pa yin/

zhes sogs lo rgyus zhib par byas pas/ des na re/ 'o na bla ma'i snyan pa sngar nas thos shing mjal na snyam pa yod pas/ do nub nga'i sar 'byon pa zhu zhes gdan drangs nas/ gzhung ri bo khyung lding gi dgon par phebs te/ sngags btsun de/ bu slob rnams kyi nang nas thog mar che zhing mjal ba gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor yin no// der gzhung du sna len dang zhabs tog bzang po byas/ chos zhu ba'i gsol ba 'debs su byung ba la/ bcom ldan dgyes pa rdo rje mtsho skyes rdo rje'i lugs su dbang bskur sgrub thabs gnang ba la/ na bza' bzang po la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang po byas/ gzhan yang khong rang gi slob ma dang yon bdag mang po la chos zhus byas shing bskul/ bla ma la gsol ba btab nas dbang bskur/ zla ba gnyis chos bshad pas 'bul ba mang po byung zhing snyan grags 'phel bar gyur/ de nas 'phan yul gyi sras sa dmar bya bar bzhugs/ kri ya'i sgo nas sri'u dgu tsam bsos shing*/ sri'u re la gser zho bcu gcig re blangs/ lha mo re ma ti'i rjes gnang dang las tshogs re tsam yang byas shing bslabs/ chos thun re tsam yang bshad pas thams cad shin tu mos par byung ngo*// der mi mang po la dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur tshe byang 'dam shod snying drung gi mar pa mgo legs bod du tshong la yong ba dus mtshungs nas/ sgang rgyud na mi mang po long long 'dug pa la su ci byed pa yin dris pas/ rje btsun nā ro pa'i slob ma mar pa lo tsā bya bas mi rnams la dbang bskur zhing tshogs 'khor byed par 'dug zer bas/ mar pa mgo legs kyis bsam pa la nga dang rus pa'i phaser mi rnyed/ kha gtam la yang 'phan yul skya mo na/ byi'u la lhu thang rtsi/ byang kha sna brgyad na 'brong bu la gzugs thang rtsi bya ba yin/ 'phan yul ba ni mi ngan/ dad pa chung*/ sa btsa'/ mgo mkhregs/ byang la nga can du gshegs dang*/ 'gro na rta bzhon/ ber gyon/ sdod na 'bol 'ding*/

sha mar thud gsum zos pas chog zer ba la/ 'o na khyed can du 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ mgo legs kyis nged kyi gdan 'dren zhig byung ba dang byon zer/ tshong rnams brin pa dang byang la song nas nged kyi bla ma chibs pa'i rta/ chas 'gel ba'i mdzo/ na bza' lam rgyags dang bcas pa bskur nas sngon la bsu ru btang bas 'byon pa'i skad thos te/ mgo legs rang gis kyang rta bzhon nas bsu ru phyin par nga'i gos 'di rnams la dpal nā ro chen pos byin rlabs mdzad pas/ bor na phangs shing lho brag tu sleb pa byed gsungs/ snod du bcug nas bsnams byon/ khyod dga' ba yang byed gsungs nas rngog gis phul ba dang*/ mgo legs rang gis phul ba'i na bza' so ma rnams bzhes/ mgo legs rang gi 'og rta chibs su phul nas 'byon pa'i ma/ na bza' so ma bdag gis phul ba ma gtogs gzhan yang gda' ba la/ dang po nas mi gsol ba ci lags zhus pas/ gos rgya gar la khyer mi bde bas rnying nas gser du mi 'gyur/ so ma gser du bsgyur nas dpal nā ro pa la 'bul snyam pa yin te/ da khyed dga' ba 'dug pas gyon pa yin/ rgya gar du gser med na chos mi thob gsungs pa las/ phyag rdzas la sred pa lta bu de skyon du mi 'dug yon tan du 'dug snyam nas mar pa mgo legs las 'brel sad nas mchi ma 'khrugs shing ba spu g.yo ba'i dad pa thun mong ma yin pa zhig skyes te/ bla ma 'di'i drung du snying nas chos shig byas nas phyag phyir rgyun du 'brang ba'i yid dam bcas so// ༈ de nas 'dam shod snying drung du phebs tshe mgo legs 'brog sde de'i dpon du 'dug pas/ g.yog rigs rnams la yang bskul nas sna len bzang po byas/ mar pa mgo legs rang gi dam bca' ltar chos sgor zhugs nas dbang gdams ngag rnams zhus te/ g.yog rigs dang nye rigs 'ga' shas rnams la'ang dge bskul byas/ chos zhu ru bcug der yang sri'u mang po gsos pa la gserta/

gnag lug dang go khrab mang po sogs gser dang 'bul ba thugs tshims pa'i tshe/ da rgya gar la 'byon dgos dgongs nas/ mgo legs rang dang*/ chos byed mi 'ga' bla ma'i phyag phyir 'brangs te lho brag la chas byon pa las/ gtsang po byang du dol gyi tshur ston dbang nges kyis gdan 'dren du byung ba ltar dpon slob rnams dol du phebs nas ga pa la dgyes rdor/ tshur ston dang*/ mar pa mgo legs la gsang 'dus rgyud rkyang gi lugs dang*/ rim lnga'i dmar khrid/ ba rang lba ba can ya ma hā ma ya'i bshad pa rnams mdzad nas thon ston la jo bo yang bos nas tshogs 'khor bzang po zhig gnang ba'i gral du/ grwa pa rnams kyis bla ma rin po che la rgya gar na bla ma du bzhugs/ de rnams kyi nang nas sgrub rtags kyi yon tan ngo mtshar can dang ldan pa ci 'dra mchis/ de rnams las dbang dang gdams ngag chos ci zhus/ phar tshur 'byon pa'i lam la grogs ji lta bu dang bsdebs nas byon/ zhes zhus pas/ rje mar pas de dag gi lan du tshig lhug pas rgyas par bkrol rjes/ mdor bsdus tshigs su bcad pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje rtsod ldan dus kyi rdo rje 'chang*// dka' ba da pa'i skyes bu mchog /kun gyi ི bor thod bzhin khur// dpal nā ro'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud// nga lho brag mar pa lo tsā 'di/ lo bcu gnyis lon nas chos dang mjal// de sngon sbyangs kyi bag chags sad par nges// dang po yig tshang ka kha bslabs// bar du sgra sgyur lo tsā bslabs// tha ma lho bal rgya la phyin// lo gsum bal po'i mthil du bsdad// byin rlabs can gyi bal po la// rgyud gnyan por grags pa'i gdan bzhi nyan// chos skyong dud sol lha mo zhus// des kyang 'dod pa ma tshim par// rgya gar yul du chos la phyin// chu mi zan dug gi chu la brgal// lus dug sbrul bzhin du shun pa brjes// srog chos phyir dor phod bsam pa yis// gnas ngo mtshar mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i// byang phyogs phu la ha rir byon// dngos grub can gyi dgon pa ru// sgo srung nā ro paṇa chen la// rgyud zab mor grags pa'i dgyes rdor dang*// bsre 'pho mtshams sbyor gyi gdams ngag thob// khyad par gtum mo'i las rgya zhus// snyan rgyud kyi don la ngo sprod byas// nub du la k+ṣe tra'i dgon pa ru// dpal ye shes snying po'i zhabs la gtugs// pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa nyan// sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi gdams pa thob// lam rim pa lnga yi don la bslabs// lho dug mtsho khol ma'i gling du phyin// gdugs nyi ma'i dgung du smag tu sros// lam da lta gsal ba da lta stor// srog yal bar dor nas rje btsun btsal// dpal zhi ba bzang po dngos dang mjal// ma rgyud ma hā ma ya gnang*// dbyibs rnal 'byor gsum gyi don la bslabs// sgyu ma sum rgyud kyi gdams pa thob// shar dngos grub kyi chu bo gaṅga brgal// ri rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod dang*// me tog mdangs 'phrog gi dgon pa ru// rje mnga' bdag mai tri'i zhabs la gtugs// rgyud zab mo bstod pa glur blangs thob// chos phyag rgya che la rtogs pa bskyangs// sems dngos po'i bzhugs tshul gtan la phab// gzhi chos nyid don gyi ngo bo mthong*// de 'dzam gling yongs la grags pa yi// phyogs bzhi bla ma'i brgyud tshul yin// gzhan dur khrod nyul ba'i rnal 'byor dang*// shing drung gnas pa'i ku su lu// yongs su ma grags 'ga' yod de// rdzogs rim kha thor mang du zhus// ngo mtshar can gyi sgrub thabs dang*// phran tshegs kyi gdams ngag rtsis las 'das// lam la kha rag gnyos dang 'grogs// nged bal po'i mthil du slebs pa'i tshe// nga lho brag gi mar pa lo tsā dang*// kha rag gnyos kyi lo tsā gnyis// la ོtsā gang mkhas gang mkhas zer// gdams ngag gang che gang che zer// yar bal bod mtshams na thon tsa na// nor zang zing gi sku bsod khong la rgyas// yul la stod tsho bzhir phyin tsa na// sgra sgyur gyi grags pa mnyam por thob// bod dbus gtsang gi mthil du thon tsa na// gdams ngag gi snyan pa kho bos thob// bla ma grub thob dang mjal lags pas// gdams ngag mi che'i dogs ma mchis// tha snyad la byang chub mi sa pas dar ma mdo sde la sogs pa 'khrungs par gyur to//

rgya gar du thengs gnyis pa byon tshul/༈ de nas gnyis pa rgya gar la byon nas bla ma rnams dang mjal te chos zhus tshul ni/ bla ma dang yi dam chos skyong srung ma la/ sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag dang*/ da bcol las kyi gsol gdabs dang bya dga' la mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzang po bskor nas/ gser srang lnga bcu tsam bsnams nas rgya gar la 'byon par chas pa la// grwa pa 'gas phyag phyir 'gro bar gsol ba btab pa las/ ma gnang bar gcig pur 'gro gsungs byon pas bal por phebs nas ི ther ba dang*/ pen ta ba gnyis mjal nas gser gyi 'bul bas mnyes par byas// bal po sku mched kyis kyang blo thub kyi grogs bzang po dang bsdebs nas/ rgya gar du brdzangs pa las bar chad med par rgya gar du phebs te/ nā ro pas dbu mdzad bla ma rnams la bka' drin gyi sgo nas gser gyi 'bul bas mnyes par byas/ slar yang chos zhus tshul ni dpal nā ro pa'i drung du dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbyangs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje'i gur dang*// thun mong gi bshad rgyud saṃ £ོ ṭa'i 'grol ba man ngag dang bcas pa rnams zhus so// de rjes nā ro pa'i zhal nas sngar gyi bla ma gzhan rnams dang yang mjal/ sngar thob pa'i chos rnams la nan tan zhus dag phyis the tshom mi za ba dang*/ sngar ma thob pa rnams zhur phyin pa drags pas thog mar gang du 'gro gsungs pa las/ thog mar mai tri pa'i drung du 'gro zhus nas mai tri pa'i drung du byon te gser gyi 'bul bas mnyes par byas nas/ sngar thob pa'i chos rnams la nan tan/ ma thob pa gsang 'dus kyi dbang dang 'grel pa/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud rnams zhus shing*/ de dag gi dpe cha bzhengs te/ pua ha rir nā ro pa'i drung du chos gsan nas na leura byon pas/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shri £ dra dang mjal bas/

sna len gyi tshogs 'khor zhig byas pa'i gral du khong na re/ khyed kyi mnga' bdag mai tri pa las snying po don gyi chos skor gsan zer bas/ rje bram ze chen po'i slob ma ri khrod dbang phyug gi brgyud pa de dang*/ tai lo pa'i slob ma/ 'o skol rang gi bla ma nā ro pa'i dgongs pa gnyis gang zab pa 'dug gsungs/ nā ro pa'i dgongs pa la tshogs kyi 'khor lo glu gar gyis grub pa yin pas/ mai tri pa'i dgongs bzhed zur tsam zhig dbyangs su blangs pa la 'gal med dgongs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ gson dang snying grogs dpal bzang po// nga mar pa bya ba'i baqེ la// nā ro mai tri'i dgongs pa gnyis// gang zab gsungs pas dbyangs 'di len// seng ge lta bu'i nā ro pa// kun gyi nang nas rin po che// dgos 'dod thams cad skong mdzad pa'i// dgongs pa nyid kyi thugs la mnga'// rje Zrma Z ras thugs rjes bzung*// paṇa chen 'di yi zhabs pad ni/ deng sang bdag gi gtsug gi rgyan// khong gi dgongs pa 'di ltar gda'// snyan lhan ner gson la thugs gtad 'tshal// chos sku'i mkha' la ye shes sprin phung 'khrigs// char rgyun sprul pas 'gro ba yongs la khyab// brgyud pa ma chad skyes bu'i bla ma mchog /de la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku nam mkha' lta bu ste// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen yin// ye shes sprin phung 'khrigs pa de// byang chub sems dpa' rnam gnyis yin// phrin las bdud rtsi'i char 'bab pa// rje btsun bram ze sa ra ha// sprul pas 'gro don mdzad pa de// ri khrod dbang phyug sha ba ri// de yi brgyud pa ma chad pa// mnga' bdag rgyal sras man du ma gol gsan par zhu// tshig gi sdeb sbyor mi mkhas kyang*// don gyi gdams ngag go lugs 'di// snyan tshud bgyid pas mjal bar mdzod// srid gsum ye nas rnam par dag /don dam ye nas go rgyu med// med pa ma yin rgyun chad med// 'pho 'gyur med par lta bar bzhed// gnyug ma'i ngo bo ngang gis gsal// zag med bsam gtan rgyun chad med// med pa ma yin 'du bral med// zhen chags med par sgom par bzhed// sna tshogs rten 'brel shugs 'byung la// sgyu ma'i rol pa 'gag pa med// med pa ma yin dngos po la// glo bur nges med ོda par bzhed// sems rgyud byang chub snying por gsal// sku gsum sangs rgyas thob byar med// med pa ma yin re dogs bral// gzhi med rtsa bral 'bras bur bzhed/

ces gsungs pas// yang dris pa/ sgom nyams su len pa'i ga rjes gnang mdzad// gsang mtshan gnyis med rdo rjer btags// khong rgyud sde kun kyi lde mig 'dzin// gsang sngags thabs lam mngon du gyur// chos kyi rgyal mtshan chos kyi mdzod// chos kyi seng ge chos kyi rgyal// sgra dang dbu tshad mtha' dag mkhyen// paṇ+ḍi ta yi dngos grub brnyes// dngos po'i gnas lugs dri med mkhyen// rgyal srid rtswa bzhin dor byas nas// tshe gcig mchog gi go 'phang thob// rje btsun mkha' 'gros zhal bstan cing*// thun mong bsgrubs pas thams cad thob// de ltar yon tan dpag med brnyes// pha khong gi dgongs pa 'di ltar gda'// rim par skyes pa'i gang zag la// srog rtsol gtum mo'i gdams ngag dang*// zhen med sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag dang*// mun sel 'od gsal gyi ngo sprod dang*// srid pa longs sku'i ngo sprod dang*// skye ba sprul sku'i ngo sprod sogs// thabs mchog gzhi lam 'bras bu'i khrid// cig car ba yi gang zag la// phyag chen gcer mthong ngo sprod mdzad// pha khong mthong sgo gsum dad pa skyes// thos na las kyi sgrib pa 'dag /mjal na ngan song 'jigs las grol// zhus na sad de ltar gda'// legs sam skal ldan rdo rje'i spun// ces pa de skad gsungs pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta shṝ £ dras dbu mdzad pa rnams dgyes nas lo tsā ba khyed kyi mdun ma gsha' mar grub gda' gsungs so// de nas rje mar pas dpal nā ro pa'i drung du phebs te/ yang bka' lung ltar bla ma rnams la gser gyi 'bul ba dang bcas thog mar dug mtsho'i do la byon te/ ku ku ri pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rus pa'i rgyan can dang mjal/ de nas nub du la k+ṣe trar phebs te dpal ye shes snying po dang*/ sing gha gling pa dang mjal nas bla ma kun la gser gyi 'bul bas shin tu mnyes par gyur pa la/ slar yang sngar thob pa dang ma thob pa'i dbang lung gdams ngag rnams thugs tshim par zhus pa kun la zhus dag nan tan dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/

chos gang thob pa'i dpe bsgyur zhing bris te bsnams nas phu la ha rir phebs pa dang*/ dpal nā ro pa la bde mchog rgyal po iṇ+ḍa bo Zི nas brgyud pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud bshad srol bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i lugs shog dril gdams ngag dang bcas pa thob pa dang*/ sngar thob pa'i chos rnams kyi dpe cha bsgrubs nas dri zhing yod pa las/ lan gcig nā ro pa gsol mdzad pa'i drung na mar pa bzhugs dus shig kha che la bar nas yin zer ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa a ka ra siKི bya ba'i dge slong zhi dul can/ nā ro pas kyang zhe sa rtse sprod du mdzad pa zhig byung ba de/ gsang 'dus kyi dbang lung 'grel bshad man ngag dang bcas pa gnang dgos zhes gsol 'debs shing 'dug pa la/ rje mar pas kyang gsol ba btab pas/ da dus la bab phyir cis kyang byed gsungs/ khong dang mnyam du gsang 'dus rigs rgyas bsdus gnyis ka'i dbang dang*/ rgyud bshad pa chen mo don gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba sho lo ka sum stong lnga brgya tham pa dang*/ 'grel pa sgron gsal rnams gnang zhing*/ chos grol ba dang khong 'byon zhing 'dug pa la/ gshegs skyel byas/ da gang du 'byon zhus pas/ nga bod la lam byas rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la gnas 'brel la 'gro gsungs pa la/ mar pa'i thugs la paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa 'di bod la byon rjes/ nga la gsang 'dus sogs chos zhu mi cung zad nyung ba tsam yong ngam dgongs pa yud tsam zhig thugs la shar bas/ de paṇ+ḍi ta'i mngon mkhyen gyis rig bzhin bod la byon pas/ kha ba gung thang gi yang thog na nag tsho lo tsā bas sgron gsal 'chad cing 'dug pa'i sar phebs pa las/ khong na re/ dzo ki khyod gang nas yin/ gang du 'gro gsungs pa la/ nga paṇ+ḍi ta yin/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la 'gro byas pas/ nag tsho khrel nas/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta 'di rnams gser 'tshol ba'i phyir du rkang pa sngo rjen rjen yong nus pa rgod bro/

khyod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta a ka ra siKṇ+ḍi tas mngon mkhyen gyi dgongs pa la/ bod la phyin chos bshad rung*/ nga rang gi 'dul skal ni 'di bas gzhan mi 'dug bod kyi da lta'i sngags la dad pa kun ni ḍoṃ £ི he ru ka'i rnam sprul mar pa lo tsā'i gdul byar 'dug pas/ khong rang gi thul bar 'dug pas/ rgya nag la phyin rung tshe'i bar chad du 'gro ba dang gdul bya'i skal ba o rgyan na yod par dgongs pa'i phyir/ slar rgya gar la 'gro dgos pa thugs thag chod pa las chos grol tshe/ nag tshos gser gyi 'bul ba mang dag phul ba'i khar/ bod du mkho ba'i yod byad 'ga' phul nas/ rgya nag la byon pa'i thog mar bod la 'byon dgongs pa gda' bas lha sa bar gyi sa sna dang zhabs tog pa mi du dgos pa gtong zhus pas/ thugs zhen log che ba dang*/ sngar paṇ+ḍan gyis phul bas/ 'o na khyed tshogs rdzogs phyir cung zad cig khyer dgos gsungs te/ srang gang bsnams nas gshegs pas nag tsho lo tsā bas rje btsun mar pa la/ sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' chen por thugs thag chod pa'i dag snang shar ro// de nas paṇ+ḍi tas rgya gar du phebs te/ rje mar pa la/ ngas grogs po dogs pa bzhin ma byas pas/ re ba bzhin gyi gdul bya phrin las yod pa yod do// gsungs pas/ rje mar pa'i thugs la paṇ+ḍi ta bzang po 'dis nga'i ngan rtogs cung zad de mngon mkhyen gyis dgongs 'dug ste/ zhe nas rgyun chags su med pas thugs gting nas khrel don med/ lar rang rig pa sgrim/ bsam rtog ngan pa ma byung ba byed dgos dgongs par shar zhing*/ shar ba ltar paṇ+ḍi ta la zhus pas/ a cang bre mo yin/ khyed skye ba sngon nas lhag bsam dang ldan pa'i phyir/ da lta bla ma'i thugs su 'byon cing*/ ma 'ongs pa na bstan pa dang sems can gyi dpal du gyur pa 'dug gi gsungs nas o rgyan la gshegs so// de nas rje mar pas bla ma rnams kyi drung du dbang lung gdams ngag rdzogs par zhus pa rnams kyi phyag dpe rnams bsgyur zhing*/

bzhengs pa rnams brtson 'grus skyed nas mdzad pas myur du grub par gyur to// gsum pa bod la byon tshul ni/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la dgongs pa'i mdzad phrin rnams bzhed pa ltar grub pas thugs tshims nas bod la 'byon khar/ nā ro pa'i drung du gtang rag gi tshogs 'khor zhig phul ba'i tshe/ paṇa chen nā ro'i phyag rje btsun mar pa'i dbu thog tu bzhag nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ nam mkha'i me tog skyes bu yis// mo gsham bu yis rta bzhon nas// rus sbal spu yis thun brabs te// ri bong ra yi phur pa yis// dgra bo chos nyid klong du bsad// lkugs pa smra zhing dmus long blta// 'on pa nyan zhing zha bo rgyug /nyi zla gar mkhan dung 'bud cing*// 'khor lo bu chung bskor bar byed// ces dang*/ gzhan yang grong 'jug dang*/ snyan brgyud sogs gdams ngag zab mo 'ga' yod pas lan gcig cis kyang shog cig ces nan cher gsungs pa ma gtogs/ nā ro'i zhal nas 'di ltar yin gsungs pa ni mi 'dug mar pas go ba dang ji ltar lags zhu ba ni ma byung*/ tshig rnams ni thugs la sa ler 'jags bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ da dung lan gcig cis kyang mjal ba'i dam bca' phul zhing smon lam btab cing byon pa las/ bal por phebs te yun ring ma bzhugs par bod la byon nas gtsang du phebs pas/ gtsang rong gi me ston tshon pos bde mchog gi dbang gdams ngag rnams zhus te/ gnang zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bla ma sku khams bzang zhing snyan grags dang bcas bod du phebs pa gro bo lung du thos pa las/ mar pa mgo legs sogs bu slob 'gas bsu ba la byon pa dang*/ bla ma gtsang nas byon pa gnyis nyang stod ra nang du mjal te/ lho brag tu phebs nas bzhugs pa'i drung du rje btsun mi la sogs pa skal ldan gyi gdul bya mang po 'dus shing*/ sku bsod snyan grags gdul bya phrin las rnams shin tu rgyas par gyur to// de nas rje btsun mi la tshar gcod kyi sras mkhar grub nas/

sras kyi che 'don dang rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshogs gral du rje mar pa dang sras dar ma mdo sde bgro gleng mdzad pas sras rgyal te/ sras kyi zhal nas/ dka' las skya bas byas rung*/ dngos grub gzar bus len pa ltar/ dka' las pha jos mdzad rung*/ nyams len bdag gis byed dgos pa gda'/ pha jo rang zhal skyo ma kha ler bzhugs mdzod/ zhes dgyes nas bzhad pas/ yab kyi zhal nas/ bu nga rgyal gyi gong bu la yon tan gyi chu mi chags bya ba yin pas/ bu mkhas pa dang che ba de pha jo'i bka' drin yin zhing*/ nga yang de ka 'dod rung*/ nga rgyal ma che bar glu 'di nyon cig mai tri thar lam gsum// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa yin// gdams ngag zab pa de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// ngas sngon bla ma thugs sun ma phyung pas// mkha' 'gro mnyes phyir bu bzhin skyong*// rkyen ngan bar chad med pa de ltar lags// ngas chos theg pa che la blo sbyangs pas// sems bskyed kyis 'gro ba yongs la khyab// dam chos bod du dar ba de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// ngas sngon bla ma bsu skyel byas pa yis// rkang pa 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan// yul rgya gar 'khor ba de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// ngas rgyud dang rgyud 'grel man ngag gsum// tshig don ma nor mkhas par bslabs// bstan pa dar ba de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// mes rngog tshur ston mgo legs bzhi// snying dang 'dra ba'i bu bzhi yin// rgyud 'grel 'chad pa de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// bla mas ci gsungs bsgrubs pa de// mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan yin// gdams ngag ster ba de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// pha jo nga na so rgas nas gda'// chos nyid kyang zad sar 'khyol nas gda'// mdo sde'i dus la bab gda' bas// che mkhas kyis bstan pa spel mdzod cig

/mi rgan gyi bsam pa 'grub pa lags// zhes gsungs pas/ kun rje mar pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes so// de nas rab gnas dang bkra shis mdzad tshe/ yang rje btsun mar pas bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ bla ma bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// nga yi brgyud pa rin chen 'di nyid la// nyes ltung med pa'i bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /gdams ngag zab mo'i nye lam la// nor 'khrul med pa'i bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /nga rang mar pa lo tsā la// zab mo gnad kyi bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// byin rlabs dngos grub bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu chen slob ma'i 'khor tshogs la// dad pa dam tshig bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /yon bdag yul mi nye ring la// mthun rkyen tshogs sogs bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /las dang bya ba thams cad la// 'gro don byang chub bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre la// chad mdo btsan pa'i bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /'dir tshogs khrom gyi lha mi la// bde skyid smon lam bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /ces gsungs pa'i rjes su bla ma rngog pa la sogs pa'i bu slob dang yon bdag rnams kyi 'bul ba bzhes nas/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba rnams mdzad pa lags so// rgya gar du 'byon thengs bar pa'o// ༈ phyi ma la yang sngar dang 'dra ba gsum gyi dang po/ gser la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bsgrub tu byon tshul ni/ de nas rje btsun mi la la rjes 'dzin gyi dbang gdams ngag rnams gnang nas lho brag stag nyal sgrub pa la bzhugs su bcug rje btsun mar pa dpal nā ro pa'i drung du dam bca' phul ba ltar 'byon par bzhed pas/

mar pa mgo legs sogs bu slob mang po dang bcas slar yang dbu ru byang phyogs la gser gyi 'bul sdud la byon pas/ snyan grags kyi sgo nas chos zhu mkhan mang ba'i stabs kyis gser gyi 'bul ba mang po byung ba'i mthar/ mar pa mgo legs kyi sar dbang bskur gcig mdzad pa'i tshe/ dbang gi dngos gzhi zin nas rjes chog rnams mdzad dgos dgongs pa'i bar de la/ rje mar pa mnal dang 'od 'dres pa'i ngang la song ba'i gzigs snang la/ sku mdun du tshur dar gyi gos dang rus pa'i rgyan gsol ba'i bud med mdzes ma gsum bsgrigs nas/ sngar paṇa chen nā ros gsungs pa'i brda tshig ma go ba de rnams 'grol ba'i phyir/ dbus ma'i ram g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis btegs nas dbyangs 'di skad do//

rgya gar du thengs gsum pa byon tshul/༈ mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i me tog gis// snyan brgyud mo gsham rta bzhon nas// brjod med rus sbal spus brabs te// skye med ri bong phur pa yis// tai lo chos nyid klong du bsad// tai lo lkugs pa'i smra bsam brjod med kyis// nā ro dmus long mthong med bden mthong grol// nā ro 'on pa chos nyid chos sku'i ri bo la// blo gros zha bo 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med par rgyug /nyi zla dgyes pa rdo rje ste// gar mkhan du ma ro gcig yin// dung gi snyan pa phyogs bcur grags// 'bud pa snod ldan dag la 'bud// 'khor lo bde mchog 'khor lo ste// bskor ba snyan brgyud 'khor lo nyid// bu chung zhen pa med par bskor// zer phral thugs dam sad pa dang thal mo kyis 'bul ba yang gser du 'bul/ phyag rdzas gzhan rnams kyang gser du bsgril bar zhu zhus pa ltar gser du bsgril nas/ slar yang mar pa mgo legs dang bcas lho brag tu phebs te/ rgya gar la 'byon dgos dgongs bzhin pa'i ngang la zhag shas lus pa'i tshe/ rje btsun mi la lho brag stag nyal sgrub pa'i sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs yod pa'i mnal lam du/ bud med sngo sangs ma dar gyi na bza' dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa smin ma dang sma ra ser khyug ge ba yod pa zhig byung nas/ khyod la yun du bsgoms pas 'tshang rgya ba phyag chen dang chos drug 'dug ste/ tshegs chung ngus bsgoms pas 'tshang rgya ba khyad par gyi 'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams pa de mi 'dug pa zer byung bas/ de lung bstan dang bar chad gang yin mi shes/ lung bstan yin na nga'i bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la med mi srid snyam byon nas lo rgyus dang bcas zhus pas/ de mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan yin par 'dug ste/ nga rgya gar nas tshur yong dus paṇa chen nā ro'i zhal nas/ grong 'jug dang snyan brgyud kyi gsung bgros shig byung ste/

zhus pa tshor ba mi 'dug pas dpe rnams lta gsungs/ dpon slob gnyis kas rgya dpe rnams gzigs pas 'pho ba'i yig cha mang dag 'dug ste/ grong 'jug gi dpe ma rnyed nas dbu ru byang phyogs su byung ba'i brda 'grol de rnams kyang 'di zhu ba la bskul bar 'dug gzhan yang snyan brgyud la sogs pa'i gdams ngag ci 'dra yod kyang mi shes pa 'dug pas/ da rgya gar la myur du 'gro gsungs pa la/ yum bdag med ma bu slob dang bcas pa rnams kyis sku na bgres pa sogs rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas bshol 'debs kyis zhu ba nan tan phul ba la/ khyed rnams ci zer rung*/ ngas da dung dpal nā ro pa'i drung du lan gcig mjal du yong ba'i dam bca' phul zhing*/ nā ro'i zhal nas kyang de bzhin shog gsungs pa'i zhal ta yod pas/ ci la thug rung rgya gar la 'gro gsungs mi gsan par 'dug pas gzhan bya thabs ni ma byung*/ gser la sogs rgya gar la 'byon pa'i phyag rdzas rnams sbas pa las/ nga stobs nus ma thon na bya thabs med/ thon bzhin bla ma'i drung du dam bcas pa nyams pa las shi ba dga' gsungs nas thugs rgyal bzhengs pa'i ngang la gzims bzhugs/ nangs par gzims mal bu gu ha re gshegs 'dug pas/ grwa pa kun phyogs bcur kha bkram ste 'tshol du brgyugs pas/ rje btsun mi las phyag phyi zin/ de'i sar gzhan 'gas kyang slebs pa rnams kyis zhu ba phul bas/ da 'bul ba med rung dam ma nyams pa byed/ gser med rung rgya gar la 'gro gsungs pa la/ 'o na re zhig gro bo lung du cis kyang phebs dgos/ de nas rgya gar la 'byon pa zhu zhes zhu ba nan gyis phul bas byon pa'i tshe/ slar yang slob 'bangs kun gyis phyag phul nas da sku na byon pa dang*/ rgya gar gyi 'byon lam la dpal mo dpal thang zhes bya ba'i thang chen po rta yang ngal dub chad pa dang*/ kha la bya la zhes bya ba shin tu grang bas dbyar yang 'khyags pa dang*/ rong dang bal po tshad pa shin tu che ba dang chu bo gaṅga chu chen po 'jigs su rung ba dang rgya gar mtha' 'khob dang*/

lam bar gyi yul phran mu ge che zhing*/ ar jag la rgod pa rnams ni bla ma rang gi gsung tshad ma yin pas bden nges yin/ da de lta bu'i nyen la bdos nas rgya gar la byon rung sku tshe'i bar chad du song na/ rang re'i grwa pa bu slob gdul byar gyur pa rnams su la re zhing ji skad byed/ gang zag gis nyams len nus na/ chos sngar bod du bsgyur ba rnams kyis ci dgos chog bla ma ni thugs kyi dkyil du bsgom zhing bzhugs pa la gsol ba 'bral med btab pas/ thugs rje'i byin rlabs la thag nye ring med phyir/ 'dir bzhugs rung chog lags mod/ cis kyang sngar bod du na drangs pa'i chos kyis mi chog par len dgos na/ sras dar ma mdo sde phyag phyi ba dang bcas pa la bslab bya lam yig gnang nas chos zhu ba la brdzangs te/ bla ma rang da lan bod kyi gdul bya rnams la dgongs nas cis kyang bzhugs par thugs rjes 'dzin pa zhu zhes gsol ba btab pa las/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bla ma'i thugs rje la nye ring med rung*/ ngas da dung lan gcig mjal du yong ba'i dam bca' phul yod/ bod kyi gdul bya rnams la bu gtong bar ma zhus/ tshong pa rgas pa lus zungs ngan rung lam rgyus bzang zer ba ltar/ nga lus cung zad rgas rung rgya gar mi bgrod pa'i rgan po min/ rgya gar gyi rgyus kyang nga rang che bas da lan las ci la thug rung chos len du 'gro ba yin/ lam bar la 'jigs pa de dag yod da yod de/ nga la de dag gis mi brdzi ba'i gdeng 'di dag yod pas/ da lan 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro gsungs/ rgya gar phar 'byon gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ dpal nā ro mai tri'i zhabs la 'dud// ngas nā ro'i drung du dam bcas pa'i// dgos pa mchog cig yod pa'i phyir// gsung mkha' 'gros brda bkrol bskul mdzad pas// bla ma dran te bzod glags med// nga las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro

/dpal mo dpal thang du che lags kyang*// nga la rnam shes rlung bzhon gyi gdams pa yod// 'di mdo phrug phal gyis do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// la kha la bya la shin tu grang lags kyang*// nga la gtum mo me 'bar gyi gdams ngag yod// 'di snal gos phal gyis do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// bal po shin tu tshad pa che lags kyang*// nga la 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag yod// 'di bzang drug phal gyis do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// chu bo gaṅga chu ru che lags kyang*// nga la rnam shes mkha' lding gi gdams ngag yod// 'di gru gzings phal gyis do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// rgya gar mtha' 'khob mu ge che lags kyang*// nga la dka' thub chu 'thung gi gdams ngag yod// 'di bza' btung phal gyis do zla min/ las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// lam bar dang yul phran 'jigs pa che lags kyang*// nga la ma mo jag chings kyi gdams ngag yod// 'di zla skyel phal gyis do zla min/ las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro /bla ma nā ro dang mai tri yang rgya gar na bzhugs// dpal zhi ba bzang po yang rgya gar na bzhugs// rten ma hā bo Zི yang rgya gar na bzhugs/ nga las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// zhes gsungs shing thag chod pa'i tshe/ sngar 'bul sdud las byung ba'i gser dang*/ slob ma rnams kyi 'bul ba thams cad gser du bsgril bas/ gser dkar yol gang byung ba bsnams te/ gzhan phyag phyi la gtong ba'i zhu ba phul yang ma gnang bar gcig pu rgya gar la byon no// ༈

gnyis pa bla ma nā ro pa btsal zhing chos gsan tshul ni/ rje mar pas 'byon lam nyang stod la byon pas bzhengs kyi glang po snar jo bo rje bod du byon pa dang mjal bas/ sngar nā ro pa'i drung du na leu'i chos khrims mdzad pa rgyal rigs kyi paṇ+ḍang khyed la snyan brgyud kyi chos mnga'am ci/ bdag gi gsung bgros sam zhal ta re tsam 'dug ge byas/ mtshan nas bos mang du bshums pas/ dge tshul ba na re/ snyan brgyud dam de 'dra thos kyang ma thos/ kho yong rgyu yin te gsungs/ khyed la thugs brtse ba'i gsung mang po rang yang yang 'byon gyin 'dug 'byon khar kho yong nges yin pas 'di byon tshogs mchod zla ba gcig la phul pa'i mthar/ mjal bar lung bstan pa ni/༈ nor bu rgyal mtshan rtse la 'phyar// sgeg mo me long zur mig blta// bya 'phur steng nas rgyal mtshan 'phyar// ded dpon gru gzings gtong bar rmis// dpal nā ro pa dang mjal bar nges// gsungs so// de nas yang khyed rang gi slob dpon rje btsun dang*/ phar slu bkye ba rmis// nā ro pa dang mjal te 'ong*// gsungs so// de nas nā ro pa'i slob ma rnal 'byor ma rus pa'i rgyan can dur khrod na bzhugs pa'i sar song la gsol ba thob gsungs nas phyin te/ gsol ba btab pas lung bstan pa/༈ ri gsum rtse nas dung 'bud cing*// lung gsum mdo nas lam sna 'khrid// bum nang mar me 'bar ba yis// 'dzam gling 'od kyis gang bar rmis// nā ro pa dang mjal te 'ong*// gsungs so// de nas dge tshul ba shes rab seṅge na re/ da yang rje btsun la ngo mi chung bas zla ba gcig la gsol ba thob gsungs nas btab pas lung bstan pa/༈ bdag gis mya ngam thang chen la// dmu long 'khrid de gzhan la sprad// de yi ma rig mig phyes nas// sems kyi me long bltas pa rmis// nā ro pa dang mjal te 'ong*// gsungs so// de nas nā ro pa'i rdo rje spun ri ri pa dang*/ ka so ri pa can du song la gsol ba thob gsungs nas/

ri ri pa can la zla ba gcig la gsol ba btab pas/ lung bstan pa/༈ sngon tshe bram ze bzang ldan la// rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po yis// dge bzang dpang btsugs gsol btab pa'i// 'bras bu 'dir 'ong mi mjal med// de'i don bla ma nā ro pa'i thugs rje dang*// slob ma mos gus can khyod kyi gdung shugs nang 'dzoms pa'i nus pas/ da nangs nga yang skye ba yang snga ma dran zhing shes pa zhig byung ba ni nā ro pa bram ze bzang ldan zhabs bya bar gyur/ lo tsā ba khyed byang phyogs kyi rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po bya ba yin/ da drang srong dge ba/ ka so ri pa bram ze bzang po/ de gnyis dpang por bzhag nas/ phyi ma la mjal bar gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes pa yin gsungs/ de nas ka so ri pa can la zla ba gcig la gsol ba btab pas/ lung bstan pa/༈ yongs dag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni// mi g.yo pua ha ri ru// sems nyid chos sku'i me long ni// nā ro pa yis ston par 'gyur// ces gsungs pa sogs mjal ba'i lung bstan kho na byung bas dga' spro'i spobs pa zhig skyes/ rje btsun snying la 'dod pas gdungs te/ sdod ma zug par res grogs dang bcas te btsal/ res grogs med du ri sul dang nags khrod dang*/ grong khyer rnamasi khog pa gcig dang*/ 'bras bre drug rnams bskur nas/ 'di nas shar drang po la byon zer ba ltar phyin te zla ba brgyad btsal ba'i dang po la/ mar pa'i mnal laṃ du rje nā ro pa de seng ge la chibs/ dz+nyā na ma ti dang*/ gu na ma siKི bya ba'i phyag rgya ma gnyis kyis mtha' brten nas nyi zla'i steng du gar bsgyur glu len pa mthong ngo*// de la gsol ba btab pas rnal 'byor ma de gnyis na re/༈ nā ro gnyis med zung 'jug ste// phyag rgya gnyis kyis mtha' brten cing*// seng ge bzhon nas nyi zla yi// steng nas gar bsgyur glu len pa'i// rmi lam 'khrul pas mi bslu'am// zer ro// de nas zla ba gnyis pa la bla ma pen ta ba rgya gar du byon pa grogs su khrid/

res bram ze'i khye'u gser phrang grogs su khrid nas btsal bas ma rnyed cing ngal dub sgyid lug pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' nas sgra zhig na re/༈ dad gus rgyun chad med kyi rta// brtson 'grus lcag gis ma bskul na// gzung 'dzin ri gas dngos po yi/ na/ khyi yis bya 'phur grib snyogs bzhin// don med g.yang la mi 'khyams sam// zer ro// de nas zla ba bzhi pa la btsal bas/ ri logs shig na phar rnal 'byor pa gos ser po gyon pa zhig song ba las/ yin nam min nam bsam zhing bsdad pas/༈ gang yang skye ba med pa yi// sems nyid chos nyid chos sku ru// the tshom sbrul mdud ma glod na// rtse gnyis khab kyis don mi 'grub// gsungs nas gshegs so// de nas zla ba lnga pa la btsal bas/ zhal mthong ste zhen pa skyes pa las/༈ 'ja' tshon lta bu zhen med lus// ngos bzung med par ma shes na// dmus long ltad mo lta ba bzhin// de don rig par ga la 'gyur// gsungs nas gshegs so// de nas zla ba drug pa la btsal bas/ nyams la bye stong zhig na bzhugs 'dug pa la gsol ba btab/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas chos zhus pas/༈ snang srid gdod nas dag pa la// chos nyid maṇ+ḍal ma phul na// zhen bcas rin chen maṇ+ḍal gyis// chos brgyad sgrog tu ma tshud dam// gsungs nas gshegs so// yang zla ba bdun pa la btsal bas/ nyams la brag phug gcig na mi ro gcig gis khog pa phyes/ thod pa phog nas klad pa dang rgyu ma la sogs pa rnams rtsib mas dkrugs nas gsol gyin 'dug pa la gsol ba btab gdams ngag zhus pas/ rtsib khyim gang byin pa skyug dro nas ma zosasung gleng 'ga' yang byung ba shar te// de yan chad ni thugs nyams la byung ba kho na'o// zla ba brgyad song ba'i tshe thugs skyo nas phyag dper gzigs rtog mdzad cing bzhugs pas/ paṇa chen nā ro dran nas ma bzod par dpe cha lta 'phro la bor te/ ri mun pa can zhes bya ba'i nags la 'tshol du phyin nas/

phyugs rdzi zhig la dris pas brngan pa dgos zer/ gser byin nas dris pas/ shel gyi pha bong la nā ro'i zhabs rjes yod pa zhig bstan pas/ rje btsun dang mjal snyam byed pa'i dga' spro dpag tu med pa zhig thob ste/ gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ nā ro'i thugs kyi sprul pa tsan dan sdong po yal 'dab shin tu rgyas pa zhig gi rtse la/ 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i gur khang tsan dan sdong po la reg ma reg zhig gi nang na/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sprul pa'i sku lha dgu sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs rnams gsal zhing rdzogs par mthong bas/ de bla ma'i sprul par shes nas phyag mchod phul gsol ba btab pas/ yum bdag med ma'i thugs kha nas a W'i sngags spu shad kyis bris pa'i ri mo lta bu de la 'od 'phros te/ mar pa'i thugs kar thim pas sku'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang thob par gyur te/ paṇa chen nā ro'i thugs rjer shes nas/ dga' ba dang bla ma dran drags ngu 'bod 'o dod smre sngags dang bcas gsol ba btab pas/ paṇa chen nā ro dur khrod kyis brgyan pas sgeger phangs med maṇ+ḍal du bkod nas phul bas/ kho bos gser mi 'dod gsungs bzhes su ma gnang bas/ rje la mi dgos rung*/ bdag dang gser 'bul mkhan sogs sems can thams cad tshogs rdzogs pa'i slad du cis kyang bzhes dgos zhes zhu ba yang yang nan gyis phul bas/ 'o na bla ma dkon mchog mchod cig gsungs nas/ gser thams cad nags gseb la gtor song bas/ bla ma dang mjal ba'i dga' spro'i ngang nas yang bod du dka' las byas tshul rnams dran nas phangs sems shig shar ba las/ phyag gnyis g.yab mdzad de thal mo sbyar ba'i kha phyes te/ god nyams med par gnang nas khyod phangs na slar yod do// nga la gser gyis dgos pa med/ dgos na 'di dag thams cad gser gling yin gsungs/ zhabs sa la brdab pas sa gzhi thams cad gser du song ngo*// de nas bu chos kyi blo gros sleb pa la sna len byed gsungs/

nam mkha' la lta stangs mdzad de gzigs pas/ nya ro so ma che la yid du 'ong ba zhig babs byung bas 'di khyod kyis bshos shig gsungs/ bshas pa'i nang nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs te/ tshogs dang mchod pa'i yo byad bzang zhing gya nom pa dpag tu med pa dang*/ lha'i sku rnams byung bas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod pas mnyes par byas/ dpon slob gnyis kyis kyang thugs dgyes bzhin rol tshe/ mar pas cho kyis gsol ba btab pas/ nā ro pa'i zhal nas khyod 'dir tai lo'i thugs rjes bkug pa yin/ nga la tai lo'i lung bstan yod pas gdams ngag pua ha rir bya gsungs/ lung bstan gsung du gsol zhus pas/ ༈ rang grol ye shes nyi ma yis// pua ha ri'i dgon pa ru/ /£ོ ṭa'i ma rig mun pa sel// ye shes snang bas khyab par gyis// gsung ba yod gsungs/ dpon slob gnyis paaa ha rir phebs pa dang cher song ste/ rje btsun bdag la skyabs su gsol/ zhes bskor ba byas gsol ba btab pas/ mkha' 'gro dang bgegs rnams kyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs dngos su bstan nas mar pa 'dzin du byung ba la/ mar pas kyang ri brag la sprin gyi gseb la byon pa ltar/ thogs rdugs med par rjes nar mar byon pa'i phyi bzhin bgegs rnams kyis kyang ded pa'i tshe/ nā ro pa rang gis skyob nus rung*/ bla mas lung bstan bdag gi bu// snod ldan mar pa blo gros la// mkha' 'gro'i ming can bdud mo rnams// bar chad rtsom pas byin gyis rlobs// zhes tai lo pa la gsol ba btab pas// tai lo'i sprul pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa'i khro bo dpag tu med pa byung ma thag bgegs rnams mar pa'i phyi bzhin ma thar zhing*/ khro bo rnams kyi gzi brjid ma bzod par phyogs bcur bros pa'i phyi bzhin/ khro bo rnams kyis kyang ded pa'i rjes brag gi gsang bar nar mar byung zhing*/ de dus mar pas kyang 'od dang sprin phung gi gseb nas tai lo'i sku phyed tsam gzigs/

de gzigs pas dgyes te bro 'khrab pas/ brag gi khong gseng du rje mar pa'i zhabs rjes gnyis dang*/ bgegs rnams bros pa'i rjes byung ba yang pua ha ri na mngon gyur du yod do// khro bo rnams kyis bgegs btul ba'i tshe mkha' 'gro rnams skrag nas thal mo sbyar te/ 'jigs pa'i sku la 'jigs pa'i gsung*// 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha legs bsnams pa'i// 'jigs chen sku la skyabs su mchi// bdag cag gnod skyel ma lags kyi// zla ba gnyis shar tshul du ni*// shing rta chen po'i rta bang ma lags// bdag rang dran pa'ang ma lags// bdag la thos pa dga' zhes bya ba'i slob ma zhig yod pa de la mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung ba lags zhus pas/ ngo mtshar che/ bod mun pa'i gling na skyes bu gangs la nyi ma shar ba 'dra ba yang yod pa 'dug gsungs/ phyag gnyis dbu'i gtsug tu thal mo sbyar nas// byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum na// a ha ri'i ri dang shing rnams bod kyi phyogs la mgo gug ste yod par gda'/ de nas khyod la sngar su la'ang ma grags pa'i khyad chos/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi chos ster ba yin gsungs nas/ bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ bcu gsum ma/ lha lnga ma/ lhan skyes rnams kyi dbang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur/ yum rdo rje phag mo lha mo bco lnga ma/ bdun ma/ lnga ma/ lhan cig skyes ma rnams kyi dbang sin Zà ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas brda'i dbang dang*/ gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gnang nas/ khyad chos kyi gdams ngag 'di la ltos na khyod la sngar byin pa'i gdams pa rnams phyi shun gyi tshul du yod cing*/ yang snying du gyur pa'i mchog gi gdams pa 'di brgyud pa bcu gsum ma rdzadi la rgyud 'dzin sogs kyi rten 'brel ci 'dug ltas mthun par lung bstan bya dgos dgongs nas rje mar pa la/

dpal nā ro pas tshogs 'khor zhig gnang*/ de'i nub drung du gzims pa'i tho rangs paṇa chen nā ros/ dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkhar khra lham mer sprul nas/ bu mar ston chos kyi blo gros ma nyal bar yar longs dang*/ nam mkha' la khyod rang gi yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje sprul pa'i lha dgu yang phebs 'dug pas/ khyod nga la phyag 'tshal lam/ yi dam la phyag 'tshal gsungs pas/ mar pas yi dam rten dang brten par bcas pa khra lam mer 'dug pa la phyag btsal bas/ nā ro'i zhal nas/ ༈ bla ma med pa'i gong rol na// sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med// bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas kyang*// bla ma dag la brten te byung*/ bya ba lags/ 'di dag kho bo'i sprul pa yin gsungs/ yi dam bla ma'i thugs kar thim ste song*/ de'i rten 'brel gyi gnad kyis da khyod la mi brgyud ring po mi yong zhing*/ rten 'brel de yang sems can gyi skal ba yin/ chos brgyud sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du yod pas dga' bar gyis shig gsungs pas/ mar pa'i thugs la/ ngas sngar thos bsam de tsam zhig byas pa la/ yi dam bas bla ma mchog tu bstan pa kho na mthong zhing thos/ bsgom pa'i tshe yang bla ma yi dam gyi dbu gtsug tu bsgom zhing yod/ kha sang bla ma 'tshol ba'i tshe yang yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje tsan dan sdong po'i rtse la bzhugs pa dang mjal rung*/ des ma tshim par bla ma btsal ba yin pa la/ da lan de ltar yong ba de nga'i sngon las yin dgongs thugs 'byung zhing*/ skyo ba'i nyams chen po yod pa'i tshe mnal ltas ngan pa yang byung*/ de dang mthun par sku la rgya tshad kyi bro tshal bas 'grong la khad pa bcu gsum dang*/ rlung gis khyer te grongs thengs kyang gsum byung ba'i bar la/ dpal nā ro pa'i zhal nas snyan brgyud kyi chos 'di bka' gnyan pas bdud kyi bar chad kyi rnam par 'dug ste/ khyod nga dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gces pas/

ngas kyang dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ khyod la bdud kyi gnod pa tsam zhig dkon mchog gis kyang skyob pa la brtson par mdzad pas/ tshe la bar chad mi yong ba'i khag ngas theg khyod rang myong 'gyur gyi las ngan mdzad pa'i thabs su nad dkon mchog gi thugs rjer shes pa gyis la/ sems can la byams snying rje dang nyams len gyi dran pa dang ma bral ba gyis gsungs nas thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung ba'i tshe/ mar pas bdag shi rung gson rung dkon mchog gi thugs rjer shes pa las gzhan ma mchis pas/ 'gro ba kun la bdag ltar thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ nā ro pa mnyes so// bsnyung ba'i bar la thugs mnyes pa'i mched lcam rnams kyis kyang thugs dam srung 'khor mdzad cing*/ yang yang byon nas gang phan gyi sman dpyad dang rim 'gro /dkon mchog la gsol gdab rnams gang byas pa drag gsungs pa la/ rim 'gro byed pa la yo byad thams cad bla ma la dmigs pa ma gtogs ngas bdag tu bzung ba gcig kyang med/ bla ma'i phyag rdzas nga'i rim gror btang na nyes par 'gyur bas mi byed/ sman dpyad bod kyi sems can rnams kyi bsod nams kyis ma thub na nga 'chi ste yong*/ thub na sman dpyad med rung nad las grol te 'ong bas mi byed/ dkon mchog gsol gdab dpal nā ro pas brtse bas skyong ba las lhag pa zhig yod rgyu med cing*/ bla ma la ni rgyun du gsol ba 'debs shing yod/ chos skyong rnams bstan pa bsrung mi bsrung la rag las gsungs/ sman dpyad dang rim 'gro ci yang ma byas rung*/ bla ma dang mched lcam rnams kyi thugs rjes bsnyung gzhi las grol lo// bsnyung ba las grol rung*/ thugs skyo ba ma sangs pa las/ mched lcam rnams kyis bsnyung ba las grol ba'i gtang rag gi thugs gsos shing*/ dpal nā ro pas kyang bsnyung ba las grol ba'i gtang rag gnang zhing*/ de'i tshe gdams ngag nyams len gyi sgo nas thugs gso ba'i phyir/

rje mar pa la chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bka' drin can gyi zhabs la 'dud/ bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā khyod// dal 'byor lus kyi phung po'i yid// dbyar skyo tshe na 'di skad longs// sems kyi gnas thabs lta ba'i gdeng*// lus kyi gnas thabs sgom pa'i gnad// phyi na sgyu ma lha yi sku// nang na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// 'og na a shad tsaṇ+ḍa li// steng na haṃ yig rnam pa can// steng 'og rlung gi 'khor lo ni// srog rtsol bum can nyams len gyis// bar na bde stong gsal ba'i nyams// ming yang gtum mo'i gdams ngag zer// rlung gnad du tshud dam lo tsā ba// phyi na snang ba sgyu ma tsam// nang na nyams myong smra ma btub// nyin mtshan snang ba sprul pa'i sku// ming yang sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag zer// zhen pa log gam lo tsā ba// rmi lam nyams kyi 'khrul pa'i dus// mgrin par oṃ yig 'od zer can// dran 'dun bag chags kyis mtshams sbyor las// skyes pa rmi na pho 'dre zer// bud med rmi na mo 'dre zer// byol song rmi na klu ru 'dzin// dga' ba rmi na sems dpang skyed// mi dga' rmi na snying mi dga'// 'dre sems kyi rtsa bar ma shes na// rnam rtog gi 'dre la zad pa med// bzang ngan rang grol ston pa'i don// ming yang rmi lam gyi gdams pa zer// rang bzhin shes sam lo tsā ba// gnyid dang rmi lam bar zhig na// gti mug chos sku'i ngo bo can// brjod med 'od gsal bde ba'i nyams// rjes la 'od gsal rgya yis thebs// rmi lam 'od gsal 'thug po nyid// ming yang 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag zer// sems skye med du rtogs sam lo tsā ba// sgo brgyad 'khor ba'i dkar khung can// sgo gnyis phyag rgya chen po'i lam// sgo brgyad bcad nas sgo gcig 'byed// sems kyi mda' la rlung gi gzhu// hig gi rgyud kyis rab bskul nas// rnam shes tshangs pa'i lam nas 'phen// ming yang 'pho ba'i gdams ngag zer// rlung dus su khegs sam lo tsā ba// rang lus dus kyi tshad phebs la// gzhan lus mtshan ldan dam pa'i yul// dang ma dag gzugs sku gnyis// bar do'i dus su zin yang 'tshal// rmi lam bar do bsre 'pho'i gnad// ming yang bar do'i gdams ngag zer// bar do 'byongs sam lo tsā ba// lar phyi nang gi chos la thos pa dgos// go bas mtha' gnyis spong ba yin// yin min gyi sgro 'dogs chod tsa na// gol sa med pa'i lam gcig yin// lam de la skyo ba ga la yod// ces gsungs pa de thugs la shin tu 'jags par gyur pas skyo ba sangs shing*/
