phyis kyang bla ma dran pa sogs thugs nam nges par 'byung ba'i tshe gsungs par gda'/ rje mar pa bsnyung ba las grol zhing thugs skyo ba sangs pa'i tshe/ nā ro'i zhal nas/ dmangs kyi rnal 'byor bdun las/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor la 'gro gsungs pa'i zhabs phyir phyin/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rdzing bur mar pas kyang khrus mdzad tshe/ sku la srung ba zab mo zhig yod pa de bkrol nas bzhag pa khwa tas khyer song ba/ nā ro pas mi ma yin gyi bar chod rtsom par dgongs pas lta stangs dang bcas sdigs mdzub mdzad pas/ bya rengs te nam mkha' nas lhung byung ba las/ srung 'khor bzhes te mar pa la gnang nas/ da phyin bar chad bdud las rgyal ba yin no gsungs/ de nas dpal nā ro pa chen pos/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros 'di nga'i rgyal tshab tu bkod pa yin gsungs/ rdzongs kyi tshogs mchod bshams pa'i gral du bka' lung gnang ba ni/ lo tsā ba khyod la ngas sngar ngo sprad pa ltar phung po lnga rigs lnga*/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gdod nas gnas pa ngo 'phrod phyir/ ngo bo la spang blang med pas snang srid kyi chos thams cad rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bor gyur cing*/ de dag chos nyid 'gag med du shar ba'i rang rtsal du shes pas/ zung 'jug tu ma gyur pa'i chos gcig kyang med phyir/ chos nyid kyi klong du nyams su len pa la thog rdugs med pa dpe nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba lta bu yin zhing*/ de rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gyi bstan pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bu mngon du gyur pa yin pas/ lung gi chos 'khor gyi bstan pa rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun lta bu shugs la 'dzin par 'gyur bas/ ིra khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lung rtogs kyi sgo nas 'dzin cing*/ bye brag gsang sngags kyi bstan pa lung rtogs gnyis ka nyin mor byed par 'gyur zhing*/ khyod kyi tshe 'di'i rigs rgyud chad de/

chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du gnas par 'gyur la/ ma dag pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gi snang ngor khyed tshe 'di'i 'dod yon la mngon zhen rdo la ri mo bris pa bzhin du 'gyur mi srid cing*/ brtan brtan dang che che 'dra mo zhig snang rung*/ khyod rang gi ngo bo thog ni chos nyid du ngo 'phrod 'dug pas/ sbrul la mdud pa bor ba bzhin 'khor ba rang grol du 'gyur la/ ma 'ongs pa'i slob rgyud thams cad kyang seng ge dang khyung gi phru gu bzhin du je bzang je bzang la 'gro ba yin zhing*/ rang re gnyis tshe 'dir ི zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pa na khyod kyi chos brgyud la/ phyi nyan thos kyi rnam pa can la/ nang theg chen gyi don rtogs pa'i sar gnas kyi sems dpa' 'khor bcas yang mang po 'byung zhing*/ gzhan cha lugs nges med kyis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su byed par 'gyur la/ bu bdun gyi mi tshad stong yod rung rigs rgyud yong rigs su mi 'dug na'ang*/ 'gyod med kyi thabs la pha bu kun yi dam lha'i bsnyen sgrub kyi mtshams dam po'i ngang nas/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs gtor la 'bad 'bungs thon/ khyed skye ba sngon nas sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can sar gnas kyi sems dpa' chen po yin phyir/ 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs par 'dug pas/ bod gangs can gyi gdul bya rnams kyi phyir/ nga'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba yin no gsungs/ phyag g.yas mar pa'i dbu thog tu bzhag nas ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ sngon tshul bzhin sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can// gnyug ma'i don rtogs rnal 'byor pa// bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā khyod// rigs lnga bya 'phur chos nyid klong*/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// rigs rgyud nam mkha'i me tog yal// chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung dang ldan// zhen pa rdo la ri mo bkra// 'khor ba chu ris rang yal 'gyur// bu seng ge khyung gi phru gu bzhin// slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// theg pa chen po'i don rtogs nas/

las can smin dang grol gyur pa'i// skal ldan gdul bya'i rgyal po khyod// da ni bod yul dbus su byon// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs// spos kyi shing rnams rgyas pa'i sa// sman sna tshogs skye ba'i ri mgul na// skal ldan gdul bya sna ldan yod// bu de ru song la 'gro don mdzod// khyod kyi 'gro don 'grub par nges// tshe 'dir brtse gdungs nang mthun pas// 'od gsal ngang la 'du 'bral med// phyi ma dpar thugs chas pa'i tshe/ pua ha ri'i nub phyogs a mra'i tshal gyi shing drung zhig tu gzims pa'i tho rangs shig gi thugs dgongs la/ ngas tshe 'dir bod nas rgya gar la lan gsum yong ba'i snga ma la lo bcu gnyis/ bar pa la lo drug da lan lo gsum ste nyer gcig song ba las/ dpal nā ro pa rang gi drung du lo bcu drug dang*/ zla ba bdun bsdad 'dug chos byas pa la grub thob kyi bla ma rnams dang mjal/ sgra skad dang slob gnyer ni mthar phyin pa shes dgongs te dgyes bzhin bod du 'byon pa la/ bla ma dang mched grogs rnams shul du lus pa ni thugs 'phreng*/ lam bar gyi chu 'phrang ar jag la sogs pa rnams la ni 'tsher/ slob gnyer rjes gdams ngag khyad par can rnams thob nas/ bod du 'byon pa la ni brod pa'i thugs nyams drag po zhig shar ba/ paṇa chen nā ro pa la phyi phyag gi tshul du tshogs mchod cig phul ba'i gral du lo rgyus dang bka' gnang zhus nas/ bung ba rgyang ring du 'phur 'gro ba'i sgra la rta drangs nas yongs su grags pa'i mgur chen lam glu ring mo 'di bla ma dang mched lcam rnams la phul lo// ༈ rje 'gro ba 'dren mdzadog mdangs 'phrog gi dgon pa 'dir// dbang bzhi'i chu bo rdzogs par bskur// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag mthar thug gnang*// bla med theg pa mchog gi don// gnyis med rtse gcig gzhir bzhag nas// sems stong pa nyid la sbar zin byas// kha ba can 'dab byang phyogs su// lung bstan rgyal tshab bkod pa'i phyir// da ni ban chung bod du 'gro// ban chung bod du 'gro ba la// shul na 'phreng ba rnam gsum yod// yid la bcags pa rnam gsum yod// lam na 'jigs pa rnam gsum yod// bar na mtsher ba rnam gsum yod// gdeng na brod pa rnam gsum yod// ngo mtshar che ba rnam gsum yod// glu 'di'i rjes zlos ma bshad na// tshig des don gyi brda mi mjal// shul du 'phreng ba rnam gsum ni// rje nā ro pa dang mai tris dbu mdzad nas// grub thob kyi bla ma brgya rtsa gcig

/shul du lus te ma bas 'phreng*// dpal 'jigs med grags pas dbu mdzad nas// mched dang lcam dral brgya rtsa gcig /shul du lus te ma bas 'phreng*// gnas phu la ha ris sna drangs pa'i// grub thob gnas chen brgya rtsa gcig /shul du lus te ma bas 'phreng*// yid la gcags pa rnam gsum ni// lho Zrma bo Zི a sho ka /drin can gnas po pho mo rnams// 'bral mi phod de yid la gcags// bram ze'i khye'u gser phreng can// shi srog gis 'thud pa'i grogs po byas// 'bral mi phod de yid la gcags// ded dpon gyi bu mo sngo sangs ma// mtshan ldan de rig mar bsten bsten nas// 'bral mi phod de yid la gcags// lam gyi 'jigs pa rnam gsum ni// mtsho dug mtsho khol mas sna drangs nas// shar chu bo gang ga da gzod brgal// de ma mthong gong nas nga re 'jigs// ri u shu ri yi nags 'dab na// chom rkun jag pa lam na sgugs// 'di ma mthong gong na nga re 'jigs// grong khyer ti ra hu ti na// khrel med sho gam char ltar 'bebs// 'di ma mthong gong nas nga re 'jigs// bar gyi 'tsher ba rnam gsum ni// 'phrang sa la ha ti ma gtogs pa// bca' 'phrang zam pa brgya bcu gcig /e ma rngul chu bas kyang 'tsher// la kha la bya la ma gtogs pa// la chen la chung brgya bcu gcig /e ma rngul chu bas kyang 'tsher// thang dpal mo dpal thang ma gtogs pa// thang chen thang chung brgya bcu gcig /e ma rngul chu bas kyang 'tsher// gdeng gi brod pa rnam gsum ni// sgra ka la tsan dras sna drangs nas// skad sna brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs lo tsā tshogs na nga re brod// dgyes rdor gdan bzhis sna drangs nas// rgyud 'brel brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs ston chen tshogs na nga re brod// bka' gzhi'i gdams pas sna drangs nas// snyan brgyud brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs sgom chen tshogs na nga re brod// ngo mtshar che ba rnam gsum ni// bsre dang 'pho ba ma gtogs pa// khyad chos brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// dud sol lha mo ma gtogs pa// bstan srung brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// rim lnga'i dmar khrid ma gtogs pa// rdzogs rim brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// che na ma cis kyang mjal ba zhu// zhes bla ma lo tsā bas mgur de bzhengs pas/

mched grogs gong mar gyur pa/ bram ze mu ta ka karti dang*/ rnal 'byor ma su ka Za ha ri'i rdo skas kyi rtsa bar ma phebs bar phyi 'gros kyis/ bla ma la gom pa re la phyag re dang them re'i steng nas phyag re 'bul zhing*/ rdo skas rdzogs mtshams su/ bla ma la gdung shugs drag pos phyag mang po btsal ba'i sa der yang*/ rdo la rje mar pa'i zhabs rjes shig byung ba da lta yang yod do// dpal nā ro pa yang sku tshe 'di nyid la ma dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang zhus pa'i dus nam mkha' nas lha'i me tog gi char tsan dan dang a ka ru la sogs pa'i dri bzang 'thul ba dang*/ mar me la sgron shing mdzub gang sbar ba ḍā kis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rtags su/ g.yo 'gul byed bzhin zhag bdun thub pa/ lha'i rol mo yid 'phrog pa'i sgra sna tshogs sgrog pa byung zhing*/ bde mchog dpag tu med pa zhig shar bas/ mai tri pas/ ltas 'di dag re zhig rgya gar du gsang ba'i bka' rgyas btab pa ltar byas so// nā ro mai tri gnyis ka la sangs rgyas bas kyang lhag pa lta bu'i nges shes skyes so// gsum pa bod la byon tshul ni/ ༈ de nas mai tri pa dang*/ dpal zhi ba bzang po/ ye shes snying po la sogs pa'i bka' drin can*/ lo tsā ba khyod la ngas dang po nas khyod dpon slob kyi thugs rje dang*/ mos gus nang mthun pas zhal mjal nges byas pa ltar/ zhal mjal pa'i snyan pa ni sngar nas thos/ rang re gnyis sdebs nas btsal ba ma gtogs gzhan gang dang gang du btsal/ bla ma dang zhal gang du mjal/ sku che ba'i yon tan dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas ci 'dra mthong*/ nā ro mai tri gnyis ma gtogs pa'i bla ma du tsam bsten/ nged rnams kyi tshogs chung 'di khyod bar chad med par 'dir byon pa'i dga' ston yin/ khyed kyis kyang skyes kha la dri ba 'di dag gi lan du glu zhig longs mdzod gsungs pa'i lan du/ yid gdung bas skyo ba sangs par byed pa chos skyong gi shugs glu'i skad la rta drangs te/

bla ma dang mjal tshul ngo mtshar ltas brgyad kyi mgur chen 'di bla ma dang mched lcam rnams la skyes su phul lo// ༈ dpal ka na ka shris dbu mdzad pa'i// 'dir bzhugs gsan cig mched lcam rnams// mi nga rang gang yin zer tsa na// mtshan snyan mar pa lo tsā yin// lte ba bod yul dbus su bcad// sbyangs pa lho bal rgya ru byas// rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyigha gling pas sna drangs pa'i// mngon shes rig pa mnga' brnyes shing*// snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum bzhugs// kun gyi nang nas mchod sdong bzhin// rje 'gran gyi do med nā ro pa// rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can// rje khong gi drin la 'khor thabs med// pha yid la bcags so sprul pa'i sku// mi kho bos ma bcol sa phyogs med// zhal yang de mjal de ma mjal// ri mun pa can gyi nags 'dabs su// ngo mtshar shel gyi pha bong la// rgya yi 'bur du bkod pa bzhin// pha rje btsun gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes mthong*// lar ngo mtshar che na de che mod// shing tsan dan sman gyi sdong po la// nā ro'i thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul gyis// dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu yi// yum lhan cig skyes ma'i thugs ka nas// aW sngags kyi 'khor lo de// spu shud rtse mos bris 'dra las// 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba yis// bdag la rjes su gnang bar mdzad// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// nga rang dbang med par mchi ma shor// ngu snying 'dod pa'i gdung sems skyes// rab tu ma bzod smre sngags bton// rtse gcig yid kyis gsol ba btab// thugs rjes gzigs nas mdun du byon// mthong lam lta bu'i dga' ba skyes// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// ngas dkon pa'i rin chen gser phye phul// nga ni de kun mi 'dod gsungs// yang yang bskyar te bzhes par zhus// pha bla ma dkon mchog mchod cig gsungs// ltos med nags kyi gseb tu gtor// kho bo phangs sems skyes pa las// khyod 'dod na ོgas kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa bshams// ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas byung*// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu ru// khrus byas srung 'khor khwa tas khyer// lta stangs sdigs mdzub mdzad ma thag

/khwa ta rengs nas sa la lhung*// bar chad bdud las rgyal lo gsungs// ngo mtshar che na 'di che mod// khyod 'di ru ma 'dug bod la song*// ljongs byang phyogs kha ba can rgyud na// gdul bya snod ldan yod do zhes// lung bstan rjes su gnang ba thob// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// sprul sku nā ro paṇa chen la// ngo mtshar can gyi mthong lugs brgyad// khyod rdo rje spun rnams ma gtogs pa// khong gzhan la bzlas na yid mi ches// da dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// log ra 'dug pas/ bkra shis pa'i glu zhig len dgos/ khyed kyis bla ma mai tri pa'i lta ba gtso bor smra ba yin zer bas/ khong gi dgongs pa ji ltar bzhed 'drir byung ba la/ de'i lan du mai tri+i pa'i bzhed gzhung gi rtogs pa'i mgur 'di bzhengs par gda'/ ༈ dpal ri khrod zhabs kyis byin rlabs shing*/ dgongs pa mthar thug gi snying po'i don// chos phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa// rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// grogs snying dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje spun// 'bral thabs med do mched lcam rnams// tha dad lus la sems rgyud gcig /dpal 'jigs med grags pa ma lags sam// rgya gar yul nas yong ba dang*// khyed bal yul mthil na bzhugs pa gnyis// tshe 'du byed dbang du ma thal bar// kha sang de ring dus bzang la// mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i tshogs gral du// dus mtshungs zhal yang 'dzoms pa de// dam tshig ngo lkog med par nges// mi kho bo shin tu spro ba skyes// khyed dga' ru tshor ram 'dir bzhugs rnams// nga blo rmongs bod kyi ban chung la// mi khyed kyis mtshan snyan lo tsarā btags// khyod sgra sgyur bod kyi glu longs zer// ngag 'dren pa'i gre 'gyur mi bde yang*// khyed gong ma rnams kyi bka' ma lcogs// rje nā ro mai tri rnam gnyis la// sku drin rjes su dran pa'i glu// ngo mtshar can gyi mthong lugs yod// snyan lhan ner gson cig mched grogs rnams// rje rtogs pa can gyi mai tri pa// mi khong gi snyan pa rgyang nas khums// sprul sku'i bzhugs gnas rgya gar yul// ljongs yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du// sa skyong rgyal po'i cod paṇa gyis// zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru bsten mdzad cing*// gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas pa rnams// mnga' bdag gtsug gi rgyan yin zhes// snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur grags// cho 'phrul bya yi lo dus su// bde gshegs mchod pa mnga' mdzad phyir// mtshan mnga' bdag zhes byar yongs su grags// rje sangs rgyas de yi zhal snga nas// theg pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don// chos phyag rgya che la ngo sprod bgyis// phyi gzung ba yul gyi snang ba 'di// bde ba chen por rgyun chad med// skye med chos kyi sku ru rtogs// nang 'dzin pa sems kyi rnam shes 'di// 'gyu ba ngos gzungs rgyas thugs phyung yang*// mthar thug de las med do gsungs// mi kho bo'i sgro 'dogs de nas chod// rje mai tri chen po'i bzhed pa yin// khyed da lta bzhed na de la mdzod// dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo dkon mchog gsum// thugs dgyes par mdzod cig gdan gang rnams// zhes gsungs pas/

khong rnams rje mar pa la lhag par ngo mtshar skyes so// ༈ de nas me dza gling na bla ma mi mnyam rdo rje zhes bya ba mnga' bdag mai tri pas bsdus pa'i mched grogs yin zhing*/ rje rang gis kyang tri ya tshar gcig gsan pa'i slob dpon yang yin pa zhig yod pa de'i drung du phyag skyel du byon pas/ khong gi grogs po kha che'i lha bzo ba zhig gis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la rab gnas mdzad cing gda' ba la/ de'i tshogs gral du byon pas/ khong rnams na re/ lo tsā ba khyed rgya gar du byon/ yun ring por bzhugs/ khyod kyi bla ma nā ro pa de/ sku snyan pa shin tu che bar gda' ba khong gi drung du khyed ji tsam bzhugs/ chos ni gang gsan/ khyed rang la khong du chud pa'i gdengs ci yod/ khyed rgya gar nas byon pa'i skyes su glu zhig longs zer ba la de'i lan du/ nā ro pa dang mjal lugs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// nga mos pa'i bu yi lam sna drongs// lar mi nga glu long mi rigs te// khyed mched grogs gong ma'i gsung ma lcogs// da ni 'chi brod kyi dbyangs gcig len// khyed gdan gang gi thugs la 'di bzhes la// chos tshul bzhin nyamasasu len par zhu// nga bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā dang*// rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen gnyis// ljongs me tog rgyas pa'i grong khyer dang*// ri bo gser gling gi dgon par mjal// de tshe rabs kyi smon lam dag pa 'dra// gnas byin rlabs can du grags pa der// sku snyan pa can gyi rje btsun de// lo bcu drug zla ba bdun du bsten// dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs lan bdun zhus// dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i byin rlabs mdzad// rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje gsungs// yi dam lhan cig skyes ma gnang*// gdams ngag skor tsho skor tsho zhus// lam rtsa dang rlung la sbar zin byas// sangs rgyas chi yang nga re brod// khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi jo bo sngags pa kun// don snyan brgyud kyi ngo sprod mi mnga' bar// bshad rgyud tshig gi tha snyad la// tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas ma re mdzod// lar snying nas dam chos mdzad dgongs na// nā ro dang mai tri'i brgyud pa zungs// bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// bde nas bde bar 'gro ste mchi+i zhus 'drir byung bas/

yang rje lo tsā bas de'i don du mgur 'di bzhes so// ༈ bram ze chen po'i gdung 'tshob pa'i// mtha' bral gnyug ma'i don rtogs phyir// dpe med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// mtshan mai tri zhes byar yongs su grags// pha rje btsun de yi bka' srol 'dzin// lam 'bral med sgom gyi rnal 'byor pa// mi kho*/khyad par grub thob zhal lnga bzhugs// rje 'gran gyi do med rnam gnyis bzhugs// gtso bo paṇa chen nā ro pa// de 'og rgyal sras mai tri pa// khong lhag par ma bas brtse ba'i phyir// nga yang yang yid la 'phreng nas kyang*// shar chu bo gaṅga'i 'gram du phyin// ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod du// shing ‚ gro Z yi bsil grib la// rje mnga' bdag chen po bzhugs pa mthong*// sa dang po lta bu'i dga' ba skyes// ḍā ki mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul// bla ma mnyes pa'i maṇ+ḍal la// gu ling gser gyi me tog bkod// lus kyis thal sbyar brkyang phyag 'tshal// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba btab// rgyud zab mo bstod pa glur blangs thos// yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje zhus// don mthar thug phyag rgya chen po zhus// dpal gnyis med a wa ZÓ ti pa// pha rje btsun de yis thugs rjes bzung*// nang zab mo brda yi dbang bzhi bskur// rgyud yongs su dag pa'i byin rlabs zhugs// gzhi 'dun pa'i sa bon gting nas g.yos// nang rig pa sems kyi 'dug tshul de// 'od gsal skye 'gag med pa'i phyir// gzhi ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bo bstan// glo bur gyi rnam rtog dbyings su thim// zag med kyi bde chen nang du shar// gdod nas dag pa de bzhin nyid// gzhi la sku gsum gtan la phab// sems chos nyid ma dang zhal yang mjal// dus da res ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas// sgron shing mar me mdzub gang la// zhag bdun bar du snang ba byung*// bem por gyur pa'i ljon shing gis// rab tu ma bzod g.yo 'gul byas// /lar mi nga rang ngan te bla ma bzang*// chos lta ba'i yang rtse phu thag chod// lam grub mtha' dman gyi dogs ma mchis// rje mai tri pa dang mjal lugs yin// dam pa'i kyi thugs dgyes de la mdzod// ces bla ma mi mnyam rdo rjes dbu mdzad pa'i mched grogs rnams la skyes su phul bar gda'/

de'i dgun rje mar pas thugs dgongs ltar b.li lan du rje mar pas mgur 'di bzhes par gda'/ ༈ rje gong ma rnams kyis byin brlabs pa// bod kyi sgra sgyur lo tsā ba// skyes pa mon bod mtshams su skyes// las 'phro mang mkhar phyogs su sad// sgra sgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la// sgra thang klog skad kyi yig tshang bslabs// dam chos rgya gar yul nas btsal// rkang pa rlung gi 'khor lo 'dis// yong ba bod kyi yul nas 'ong*// khong sangs rgyas nā ro paṇa chen dang*// nga bod kyi mar pa lo tsā gnyis// sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su mjal// dbang yongs su rdzogs par lan bdun zhus// lar ni bla ma bcu gsum la// nā ro mai tri nyi zla 'dra// gtso bo nā ro paṇa chen bzhugs// ngo mtshar che ba 'di 'dra mthong*// shing tsan dan sman gyi sdong po la// dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang*// yum lhan cig skyes ma'i thugs ka nas// aWba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di// g.yo med nam mkha'i khyim du tshud// bag chags rmi lam snang ba de// 'od gsal ngang du yal te thal// sgron shing mar me mdzub gang la// zhag bdun bar du snang ba byung*// lam 'bral med sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mai tri chen po'i zhabs la reg /nga bram ze chen po'i brgyud pa 'dzin// ngo mtshar che ba de 'dra mthong*// bdag gi rtogs pa bshad na yang*// khyed 'ga'i thugs la mi shong ste// zur tsam bshad na 'di ltar gda'// 'od gsal gdeng dang ldan lags pas// lta ba la phyogs ris med do ang*// sgom rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung*// thun bzhir sgom du mi snang gi /tshul 'chos rtog pa bor ba yis// mnyam rjes rtog pa mi 'dug ga bcad nas mang po bshum zhing bzhugs pa las/ de nub tho rangs kyi mtshan lam du gos shing lo gyon pa'i bud med mdzes ma zhig gis phyag mar pa'i dbu thog tu bzhag nas/ khyod da rgya gar du 'gro ba bas bod du log na 'gro don che ste/

gdul bya skal ldan mang po yang yod cing*/ bod du ma phyin gyi bar la bar chad mi 'byung ngo zhes lung bstan pa las/ mnal sad pa dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro nā ro mai tri'i thugs rjes bskul nas btang bar thag chod pas/ thugs spro ba'i nyams shig kyang shar zhing*/ bod la 'byon par thugs thag bcad de/ bal yul rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang na/ bla ma pen ta ba las ral gcig ma'i mngon rtogs dang*/ bdud rtsi 'od ldan gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ rdzogs rim kha thor ba 'ga' gsan cing bzhugs pa las/ nub gcig gi mnal lam du rje mnga' bdag mai tri pa seng ge la chibs nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa rmis/ pha rje btsun thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes 'o dod bos pa las/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas mtshon pa'i brda bstan/ dpe dang bral ba'i chos gsungs/ mtha' las 'das pa'i don rtogs/ sngar ma skyes pa'i nyams shar ba rmis/ der mnal sad pa dang nam langs 'dug pas/ bla ma dran nas mang du bshums/ de'i phyi nub bla ma pen ta ba la chos thon pa'i gtang rag dang*/ mai tri pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshogs mchod bzang po zhig bshams pa'i gral du pen ta ba'i zhal nas/ do nub kyi tshogs gral 'dir/ khyed rang gi thugs la 'khrungs pa'i mgur gcig cis kyang len dgos gsungs pas/ rje mar pas mtshan ltas bzlos pa'i mgur/ yid bying ba gseng bar byed pa chu lcags zil pa can gyi skad la rta drangs pa'i mgur chen 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje snying po don rtogs chos kyi sku// mtshan yongs su grags pa'i mai tri pa// khong bsam zhing sku drin che ba'i phyir// mi kho bo'i yid la shin tu gcags// nga rtse gcig gdung ba rgyun mi chad// pha byin gyis rlobs shig sprul pa'i sku// khyed 'dren pa'i bla ma sku drin can// dpal pen ta ba yis dbu mdzad nas// khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi rnal 'byor pho mo rnams// glu 'di la dar cig snyan gson mdzod// dbyangs 'di la mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs chags// nga mar ston chos kyi blo gros 'di// tshe sum cha rgya gar yul du bskyal// lo bzhi bcu'i bar du thos bsam byas// dus na ning gdug pa sbrul gyi lo// cho 'phrul khra yi zla ba la// mi kho bo lam la zhugs nas mchis// chu 'jigs su rung ba'i gaṅgakhyad par yar ngo'i tshes bcu la// dur khrod ra ma Zsam// nam tho rangs tham thum rmi lam na// gos shing lo gyon pa'i bud med gcig

/phyag g.yas pa brkyang mdzad sor mo rnams// mi kho bo'i mgo la reg mdzad de// khyod rgya gar yul du ma ldog par// slar bod yul dbus su song zhig gsungs// ljongs kha ba can du ma phyin bar// phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// gdul bya snod ldan yod do zhes// lung bstan byin gyis brlabs par mdzad// de zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro yin par nges// de yang rje btsun khyed kyi drin// mdang bag chags gnyid kyi rmi lam na// rje mnga' bdag rgyal sras mai tri pa// khong seng ge chibs nas mkha' la gshegs// mi kho bo'i mdun du byon nas kyang*// skye med mtshon pa'i brda gsum bstan// yi ge med pa'i chos gcig gsungs// brjod du med pa'i don gcig rtogs// sngon chad med pa'i nyams gcig shar// nam langs gnyid de sad tsa na// rje yang yang dran no mai tri pa// mi kho bo'i mig sngar bral ma phod// gdong mchi mas gang ba'i ngu 'bod shor// dbugs kha nas ma thon byang khog rgyangs// pha snying la 'dod do skom chu ltar// mi kho bo'i gdung sems mkhyen lags sam// pha yis lam sna drongs shig sprul pa'i sku// lar rmi lam bag chags yin mod kyang*// pha rje btsun byon pa ngo mtshar che// sems dga' la mi dga' mtho dman byung*// khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi snyan du zhus pa lags// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang pen ta bas/ rje mar pa brod pa bskyed cing*// bla ma'i ngo bo gcig la rang rang gi mthong snang ltar las yon tan tha dad du 'byung ba dang*/ rmi lam de rnams ji ltar byung tshul dri ba'i phyir lan gsungs pa/ ༈ grogs snying dang 'dra ba'i lo tsā ba// bu khyed la dad pa gting nas yod// gzhi rang dbang thob pa'i 'dun ma yod// yid lhag par brtse ba'i snying rje yod// rgyud yongs su dag pa'i sems bskyed yod// rigs khyad par can gyi skyes bu khyed// sngon chad bla ma ma rnyed pas// da lta grub thob dngos dang mjal// de yang grogs po nga yi drin// byas pa drin gzo yod pa'i phyir// mi nga yang gtsug gi nor bur mthong*// bu byas pa shes pa ngo mtshar che// gsang sngags rgyal po mchog gi lam// bgrod pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// lhag pa'i dam tshig khyed la yod// lha dang mkha' 'gros rjes gnang zhing*// bla ma'i man ngag snying la bzhugs// dus 'dir bde ba thob par rigs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma rje// sprul sku mchog gi rje btsun la// nam mkha' lta bur ngo shes na// skye ba med pa'i don rtogs gyur// nyi ma lta bur ngo shes na// gdal ba'i snying rje chen po 'byung*// zla ba lta bur ngo shes na// nyon mongs gdung ba sel bar byed// rgya mtsho lta bur ngo shes na// mi g.yo mchog gi ting 'dzin brnyes// nor bu lta bur ngo shes na// dgos 'dod re ba lhun gyis grub// ded dpon lta bur ngo shes na// thar pa'i rin chen gling du skyel// dmag dpon lta bur ngo shes na// log lta dgra yi g.yul ngo 'joms// ral gri lta bur ngo shes na// dngos 'dzin 'ching ba gcod par byed// 'khor lo lta bur ngo shes na// mtha' la mi gnas don rtogs 'gyur// seṅgas// chos kyi rgyal srid rgyun mi chad// bu khyod kyi bag chags rmi lam na// rje mnga' bdag chen po byon nas kyang*// skye med mtshon pa'i brda bstan zhing*// yi ge med pa'i chos gsungs pas// mtha' las 'das pa'i don rtogs nas// sngar ma skyes pa'i nyams shar ba// de don gang lags smra bar rigs// ces gsungs pas// yang rje mar pas/

rmiZིsa dbu mdzad pa'i// gral g.yas la bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo gson// de 'og sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma// lcam su ka badz+ras dbu mdzad pa'i// gral g.yon na bzhugs pa'i dpa' mo gson// ིra chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma ste// rmi lam sgyu ma khyad par 'phags// nam srod la bag chags rmi lam 'byung*// de la gza' gtad ci yang med// nam gung bdud kyi sprul pa ston// de la yid brtan byar mi rung*// tho rangs lha yis lung bstan pa// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// dgung da nangs skya rengs shar ba la// rje mnga' bdagaṅge dang*// bram ze khri snyan mthong ngam gsungs// brda yis mtshon pa'i don rtogs pa// 'khor 'das gnyis su mi 'dzin cing*// spang blang rgyud la mi sbyor ba// gzhan nas 'bras bu mi re zhing*// med la byar med spros dang bral// mtha' bzhi dag tu lhung ba med// sgom du med cing yengs su med// dran du med cing brjod du'ang med// gang gis kyang ni mtshon du med// bla ma'i drin gyis de ltar rtogs// de don rtogs pa'i nyams sharabs// sems dang sems byung 'gags pa yi// dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med de// skyon dang yon tan skye bri med// bde stong gsal la ma 'gags pa// 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med par shar// gnyug ma ngo sprod lta ba'i gnad// skye med mtshon pa'i brda don rnams// rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhal nas thos// ngag brjod pa glu ru mi blang du// rje gong du bka' nan che ba dang*// mched grogs rnams kyi zhal ma lcog /mkha' 'gros ko long mi mdzad zhu// zhes pen ta bas dbu mdzad pa'i mched grogs rnams la bal yul rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa rmi lam du byon nas phyag rgya chen po brda'i don bstan pa rnams mgur du bzhes pa'o// gsung mgur 'di nyid rje mar pas bod du rje btsun mi la dang*/ mar pa mgo legs gnyis ma gtogs gzhan la ma gnang zhing*/

rje mched gnyis kyis ngan rdzong ston pa byang chub rgyal po la gnang ba/ sems can gyi don du kun la grags pa bgyis pa lags so// de nas rje mar pas bal yul gyi bla ma rnams la phyi phyag phul nas bod la byon par gda'/ de'i tshe lho brag gi bu slob rnams bla ma phebs bsu re ba'i thugs 'dun drag po la brten/ bal por mjal ba'ang srid dam/ ma mjal rung skad cha 'dra thos su re bas ma zug par mar pa mgo legs bal por 'byon dgongs nas byon pa dang*/ bla ma tshur byon pa skyid grong gi ma zad ma ma zhes bya ba'i yul dgon zhig tu dpon slob gnyis mjal te phyag phyi byas byon pa las/ mang yul glang po mkhar du sngar gyi bu slob rnams kyis sna len byas chos zhus/ zhag shas bsnyel gso mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i bar la g.yu la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang dag byung*/ de nas gtsang du byon pas nyang stod stag tshang gi me ston tshon po'i dgon pa ru phebs pas/ sna len gyi tshogs mchod bzang po zhig bshams pa'i tshe/ me ston gyis bla ma lags/ do nub kyi tshogs 'khor 'di la bla ma 'byon lam sa thag ring po nas byon pa'i stabs kyis/ sku 'o brgyal na'ang gsang sngags phyag len gyis che ba lags pas/ cho ga'i phyag len dang cho ga rgyas pa phyis kyi mig ltos la phan thogs pa zhig thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu/ zhes zhus pas/ rje mar pas kyang phyag len dang bcas cho ga rgyas par mdzad pas/ tshogs gral du me ston sngar mos bzhin pa'i khar snang ba 'gyur nas bla ma lags/ slar yang tshogs 'khor ji tsam zhig mdzad pa las/ bdag la do nub kyi 'di yid 'gyur stobs che ba zhig byung*/ rje rin po ches rgya gar du tshogs 'khor mang po gzigs shing mdzad yod pa gzhir bzhag pas/ tshogs 'khor dgos pa'i dus dang*/ ngo mtshar che ba gang gzigs pa rnams gsung du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ de'i lan du/ rje mar pas tshogs kyi dgos pa dang gzigs tshul gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈

tshogs kyi 'khor lo skad pa de// smin lam dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshe// tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin// rab tu gnas pa byed pa'i tshe// tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin// mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i tshe// tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin// rgyud sde'i nyan bshad byed pa'i tshe// tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin// gdams ngag zab mo zhu ba'i tshe// tshogs kyi 'khai lis// rin chen 'khar ba'i maṇ+ḍi lha tshogs dang*// grangs mnyam gsang sngags rnal 'byor pa// pho mo drug cu rtsa gnyis tshogs// zab mo brda dang skad kyis 'dri// rje nā ro chen po'i thugs ka nas// bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams// dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su legs par bzhugs// cho ga'i rim pa rgyas par mdzad// rje btsun nā ro chen po des// rdo rje dril bu phyag tu bsnams// rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol// khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la// g.yas brkyang gar gyi rol pas bzhugs// rnal 'byor pho mo gzhan rnams kyang*// phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*// g.yon pa ting ting shags bsnams nas// gar gyi nyams kyis rol ba mthong*// kho bo mar pa lo tsā ngas// lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// zab mo dbang bzhi'i ngo bo mthong*// nga de 'dra'i rje dang mjal ba yin// tshogs 'khor de 'dra mthong ba yin// phal dang phal gyi chos ma yin// de ngo mtshar che'am gtsang ston pa// zhes gsungs pas dad pa lhag par skyes te/ bla ma lags/ da lan gyi 'byon skor 'di yang thog mar bdag rang dang mjal byung bas/ sngar ma gsan pa'i dbang gdams pa khyad bcas mgur gcig gsung bar zhu/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i lan du rje mar pas bla ma rnams la bstod pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje mi bskyod bde ba chen po'i sku// rdo rje mkha' 'gros mnyam sbyor ba// dpa' bo rnams kyi gtsor gyur pa'i// he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod// bka' gsang sngags ma lus sdud pa po// gsang ba'i bdagud// rje sangs rgyas mi gzugs khyod la bstod// mi phyed phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bo 'chang*// spros bral bde ba'i don rtogs pa// rje rgyal sras mai tri'i zhabs la bstod// bstan pa bka' yi brgyud pa 'chang*// gsang 'dus zab mo'i dngos grub brnyes// mkhyen pa thugs rjer ldan pa yi// ye shes snying po'i zhabs la bstod// dur khrod dgon dang shing drung na// ro bcud gsol ba'i ku su lu// mkha' la gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// ku ku ri pa'i sku la bstod// phun sum tshogs pa'i don rtogs pas// zla ba 'od kyi bcud dang ldan// mthong ba'i bde bas tshim mdzad pa// rnal 'byor ma yi sku la bstod// gser gyi cod paṇa rab mdzes pa'i// gdugs mchog bsil na bzhugs pa yi// mkha' ldan nyi zla mnga' brnyes pa'i// rje btsun bal po'i sku la bstod// 'jig rten gzung 'dzin 'khri ba chod// bla ma bsten pa'i phan yon can// byang chub sgrub la gtsor ldan pa'i// theg chen slob gnyer mgo 'don dang*// gegs dang log 'dren bar chad sel// bla ma bzang dang sprod pa'i grogs// 'dren pa'i slob dpon rnams la bstod// bla ma bstod pa'i phan yon ni// dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod dang mtshungs// slob dpon bstod pa'i bsod nams des// 'gro kun bshes gnyen bsten par shog

/ces gsungs pas/ me ston 'khor bcas dga' mgu yi rangs par gyur to// rje mar pas me ston la chos gnang ba'i bar la/ mar pa mgo legs kyis lho brag tu gtam snyan khyer te sngon la phyin/ mgo legs rang gi longs ོda kyi thog nas sna len sta gon byas/ gzhan grwa pa mang pos nyang stodaphebs pa 'di las ngo mtshar che rgyu gzhan med pas/ thugs rjes tshad med pa bzung*/ bla ma dang mjal rting*/ sngar dang da res la gdams ngag gi khyad ci gda'/ ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas ci 'dra gzigs/ bdag 'dir tshogs rnams spro ba bskyed pa'i slad du gsung du gsol/ zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ rje mar pas dpal nā ro pa chen po dang mjal nas gdams ngag lhag lus med par gnang zhing thob lugs rnams/ snang ba zil gyis gnon pa'i dpa' bo snang glu bsgyur ba'i skad la rta drangs te/ mdzad ོda rdzu 'phrul yon tan ngo mtshar can gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje sprul sku'i bzhugs gnas rgya gar yin// ljongs yangs pa can gyi ma gha Zra// mu stegs rgol ba tshar bcad de// sgo srung chen por mtshan gsol ba// rje nā ro zhes byar grags pa yi// pha sprul sku de yi zhabs la 'dud// shar khri sgo brtsegs pa'i pho brang na// rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje la// mi nga rang lta rtogs byed pa'i tshe// sems shig ma bde yid cig 'phyo// sems gzhu ltar bkug kyang mda' ltar shor// paṇa chen nā ro tur gyis dran// gdungs pa'i sems las bzod glags med// sa mtha' nags la 'tshol du phyin// rgyus med rigs ngan grong du chud// rgyal po drag pos btson du bzung*// dpal me tog spungs pa'i pho brang du// zhag gsum rgyal ba'i mchod gnas byas// 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg thab khung du// ci 'dod bza' btung 'byung ba mthong*// che na ngo mtshar de che snyam// yang gciltas rnams mthong*// shing tsan dan sman gyi sdong po la// dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu rnams// cung zad ma reg reg la khad// 'ja' yi gur phub lta bur mthong*// ltad mo ngo mtshar de che mod// yum lhan cig skyes ma'i thugs ka nas// aW sngags kyi 'khor lo de// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// phyi sku yis ma bsgribs gsal bar mthong*// ltad mo che na de che mod// shin tu sa mkhregs rdo rje'i brag

/dkar gong shel gyi pha bong la// rje nā ro chen po'i zhabs rjes de// spu shad ri mo rdzogs par mthong*// ltad mo ngo mtshar de che mod// da ni ring por mi thogs snyam// zhag bdun bar du gsol ba btab// pha gzhan rig mngon mkhyen mnga' ba'i phyir// de nas rje btsun dngos su byon// rab tu dga' che ngu 'bod shor// dman pas zhabs mthil gtsug tu blangs// thugs rje chung zhes smre sngags bton// gdung ba'i mchi ma khrag ltar zags// ltad mo ngo mtshar de che mod// lus btsun mo lta bur sku la 'khyud// thugs la snying gtad dpral bar gtugs// dus der dbang rdzogs sems la bskur// chos rdzogs sems kyi nying khu phyung*// ltad mo ngo mtshar de che mod// lar rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen dang*// nga bod kyi mar ston blo gros gnyis// sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis su mjal// grub thob mi 'byung gi don ma mchis// cad rdzongs su btab// tshe phyi ma'i rgyags phye gter du sbas// de phyir bsam zhing ngo mtshar che// bu pha bas lhag pa'i gdung sems can// khyed mar pa mgo legs ma lags sam// nor sgyu ma gtong ba smos ci dgos// srog sgyu ma gtong ba smos ci dgos// srog phangs pa med pa khyod kyi lugs// ngo mtshar de las che thabs med// lam shul thag ring bas ga la brjed/ lho kha nags bal bod gnyis kyi mtshams// dgun lo gsar sgang la me tog skye// 'bras dkar sa lu 'debs pa'i sa// mon skad rigs mi gcig yul khams su// nad 'tsho bar dka' ba'i tshad pa la// shi chad kyis mi 'jigs srog la bsdos// bu dka' ba'i dam tshig bsrung ba'i phyir// pha ngas kyang ma brjed sems la 'jog /dus 'di la mi 'bral a cang che// tshe phyi ma mi mjal thabs med pas// yi dam mkha' 'gro'athugs kyi yon tan lnga'i las rnam pa lnga'i mthong snang ngo mtshar can rnams sras kyi thu bor gyur pa/ mar pa mgo legs la byas pa drin lan bsab pa'i mgur du gsungs pa'o// der mar pa mgo legs la/

rje nā ro pa chen po'i thugs dam paV dmar po'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i phyag sor gyi rdo rje'i gu ya zung gcig gnang nas/ bu khyed nga la byas pa che ba yin pas/ nga ma shi bar la lhan du sdod dgos/ tshe phyi mar mi mjal thabs med kyi smon lam btab/ dam tshig gnad kyis bsdus pa'i phyir// 'o skol pha bu skye gnas mtshungs te mchi// ces gsungs pa ltar// mar pa mgo legs kyis kyang bla ma'i phyi bzhin 'brangs te/ bla ma sku ma gshegs bar la zhag gcig kyang ma bral bar zhabs tog bgyis pa lags so// nā ro pa dang mjal lugs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rnams kyi mgur 'di dag don gcig la tshig mi 'dra ba lan gsum du bskyar ba ni/ don gcig la zhu mkhan mi 'dra ba gsum gyi lan du gsungs pas shes par bya'o// de nas bla ma rngog pa dang*/ tshur ston yang bu slob mang pos bskor/ bla ma sku ma nongs par snyan grags dang bcas phebs pa'i dga' ston gtang rag 'bul ba dang*/ chos zhu ba la byon te/ khong gnyis kyis 'bul ba bgyis pa'i tshogs gral du/ bla ma lags/ da lan rje'i sku tshe la bar chad med par phebs pas/ bdag slobape bshad na// khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi jo bo ston chen rnams// chos sla bar ma dgongs tshul bzhin bsgrubs// kho bo mar pa lo tsā 'di// skyes pa lho brag mthil du skyes// las 'phro dkar po'i chos la sad// dpal myu gu lung gi dgon pa der// sgra sgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la// sgra thang klog skad kyi yig tshang bslabs// khong sku drin mi chung che bar khums// dam chos rgya gar yul nas btsal// bdag bal po'i lam du zhugs tsa na/ bca' 'phrang dang chu la thar dus med// nags 'thug po zhig la thon dus med// lam ring po zhig la bgrod dus med// shing sdong po mi ro rengs pa 'dra// lam de kun gyi sdug bsngal mthong tsa na// bya dgung la 'phur ba gshog pa 'dar// 'on kyang ngal dub byas rin chog

/yul lha las babs pa'i bal po mthong*// phyi 'dod yon lta bas chog mi shes// mi 'dod khams kyi lha bran yin no snyam// dus bskal pa bzang por 'dug go snyam// lam bgrod par dka' yang phyin pas legs// nga de nas rgya gar phyin tsa na// mtha' 'khob kyi jag pa shi skyid la// srog ci bder thon pa'i re ma mchis// gcan gzan gyi ngar skad thos tsa na// lus gtsang sar thon pa cung ma bsam// sbrul 'gram chen gyi kha rlangs mthong ba'i tshe// yid brtan par phyin kyang gom tshugs 'khyor// lam de kun gyi 'jigs pa mthong ba rnams// dus da lta dran yang glo snying 'dar// chu grags pa can gyi gaṅgi thang la phyin to snyam// yid chos la bsams kyang snying rlung 'phyo// nad 'tsho bar dka' ba'i tshad pas thebs// do shi do chad bcu gsum byung*// kha chems tshig gsum bzhag sa med// dbugs 'gyu ba chad pa lan gsum myong*// dus de kun gyi sdug bsngal mthong tsa na// sdang dgra'i mig nas mchi ma 'chor// 'on kyang srog bsdos byas rin choṅga'i 'gram du phyin// rje mai tri pa yi byin rlabs kyis// gzhi chos nyid skye ba med par rtogs// sems stong pa nyid la sbar zin byas// don spros bral gnyug ma'i ngo bo mthong*// sku gsum ma dang dngos su mjal// mi kho bo'i spros pa de nas chod// slar bod yul dbus su log tsa na// gdams ngag kyang nga rang che'o snyam// grub thobagyis thog drangs pa'i slob ma dang*/ yon bdag mang pos gtang rag gi tshogs mchod bzang po zhig phul ba'i tshe gzims khang gi nye 'khor na phug ron gyi tshang yod pa/ phru gu ma'i phyi bzhin 'phur song ba khras ded pa tshang du bros rung*/ hal nas shi ba'i ro gcig byung ba la/ ngas khyed rnams la de ring grong 'jug gi ltad mo bstan nam gsungs pa la/ kun gyis phyag phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ phug ron gyi ro'i rkang pa la thi gu btags nas gtong ba la grong 'jug mdzad pas/

phug ron langs nas theb theb 'phur grabs byed pa'i phru gu yang ma la 'khor nas snying rje rje ltar byed pa'i tshe/ rgyang ro zhang ston gyis bla ma'i sku la bltas pas/ spur gyi rnam pa byung ba ma bzod par 'jigs pa'i rnam pa dang*/ ngu ngag gis sku drung du/ bla ma rin po che da 'di 'dra ma mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ phan gnod ma byung bas/ de bas kyang 'jigs su song ste/ yang phug ron gyi drung du phyin nas zhu ba phul bas/ phug ron 'gyel 'phral bla ma bzhengs nas// rang lus khang stong bzhin bor nas// phug ron gzhan lus grong du zhugs// gshog brkyang mkha' la do 'phur byas// bya ma bu 'phrad nas brtse ba de// kun gyis mthong ba ngo mtshar che// zhes gsungs shing bzhad pas/ der tshogs pa kun grong 'jug la nges shes 'drongs pas mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes par gyur to// de ltar grong 'jug mdzad pa'i lo rgyus jo bos thos pas/ zer zer min pa bden rang mi bden nam// bden na ya mtshan de 'dra bas che ba mi yong zer zhing*/ yid la yang nar mar grong 'jug bden rdzun nga rang gis mthong ba zhig byed dgos snyam yod pa'i tshe/ nam zhig jo bo'i tha ga ma zhig gi rtsar lu gu ltang dkar zhig zho yis bgrangs drags shi ba'i ro gcig 'dug pas/ rje mar pa la/ jo bo na re/ khyed kyis 'di la phug ron ltar grong 'jug gyis dang zer bas/ ngas rgya gar nas yum rdo rje phag mo'i bcud len shi sos kyi gdams ngag ye shes kyi sman sbyor cig yod de byed pa yin gsungs/ jo bo la sogs bu slob dang yon bdag mang po 'dzoms par rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ ngas 'dir bsdad nas 'jug pas/ lu gu ci byed cing 'dug ltos shig gsungs pa ltar/ jo bo sogs mi kun gyis lu gu'i ro'i sar phyin/ bla ma ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs tshe lu gu har langs te 'khrabs pas/ tha ga ma ha las te/ g.ya' 'o na/ kho shi tshar tshar ba langs te 'khrab pa 'di 'dra zer/

'ol lu brdeg grabs byed cing 'dug dus/ ltas mi rnams kyis slebs te ma brdeg cig bla ma mar pas grong 'jug mdzad pa yin no byas pas/ mo na re/ sngar rna bas thos pa de ring mig gis mthong ba ya mtshan la ang zer/ thags bkral nas lu gu dang*/ rje mar pa'i phyogs la phyag phul lo// jo bos grwa pa rnams la lu gu sos pa bla ma yod sar slebs pa'i thabs gyis shig byas/ jo bo rang gis bla ma'i drung du phyin pas grongs pa'i tshul du 'dug grwa pa rnams kyis lu gu sku yod sar slebs par mdzad dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pas/ sku yod sar byon nas yang 'khrab/ de nas sku bzhengs te/ ༈ dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed yum gyi// bcud len 'chi med ye shes ni// grong 'jug bdud rtsi'i sman sbyar bas// lu gu shi sos gar dang ldan// ces gsungs pas/ jo bo dad pa lhag par skyes te// chos dbang zhus te slob 'bangs su gyur to// de ltar gyur pa mar pa bya ze zhes bya ba rje mar pa rang gi gdung tshan shin tu mi mos shing sdang ba zhig yod pa de na re/ jo bo la yang klad pa ye mi 'dug khos rgya gar la phyin pa skad byas/ mig 'khrul bslabs nas byas pas mgo 'khor 'dug ste/ grong 'jug gam de rnam dag zhig yin na/ mar pa kho/ da nyon mongs pa gra ma chag gru ma nyams par khra lam me ba'i ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro ba yin zer/ kha skyur dri chil chil/ 'dom sre dri chil chil/ dkor 'di tsam za zhing ci sdod de tsam sangs rgyas thob nas rang re tshos mig la yang thogs rgyu min zer zhing skur 'debs byas pa/ rje mar pas gsan tshe/ grong 'jug rnam dag yin pas rkang de bzhin byed pa yin/ 'dod yon ma spangs lam du ma 'khyer na/ gsang sngags thabs mang zhing dka' tshegs chung ngus sangs rgyas thob pa'i che khyad dang zab khyad mi thon pas/ gsang sngags kyi zab khyad shes bzhin 'dod yon lam du mi 'khyer bar spong na rang la sdig ces/

gsang sngags lam gyi che khyad du mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ kho bo mar pa lo tsā ngas// rgyud kyi rgyal po dgyes rdor shes// nā ro paṇa chen gyi gdams ngag yod// dgon par mi sdod rang la sdig /rgyud kyi rgyal po gdan bzhi shes// 'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams ngag yod// tha mal du shi na rang la sdig /bsam gtan gnyid dang bsre ba shes// rmi lam 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag yod// tha mal du nyal na rang la sdig /sems 'dzin gyi rgyal po gtum mo shes// sems gnad du bsnun pa'i gdams ngag yod// don nyams su mi len rang la sdig /rlung gi de nyid bdun cu shes// na tsha bogs 'don gyi gdams ngag yod// sman pa 'gugs na rang la sdig /rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor shes// rtsa rlung thig le rgyas bya'i phyir// sha chang mi bsten rang la sdig /gzhan lus lam du slong tsa na// las kyi phyag rgya'i gdams ngag yod// phyag rgya mi bsten rang la sdig /ces gsungs pas/ bu slob kun rgyud sde zab mo'i dgongs par thag chod pas mos gus cher skyes kyang*/ mar pa bya ze na re/ kho rang de ltar byed pa'i rgyab chos la de skad los zer/ gzhan yid ches su skye zer ba de grwa pa 'gas thos pa blor ma 'thad nas/ bla ma rngog pa la sogs pa'i bu slob mang dag 'dzoms pa'i tshogs gral zhig tu/ grwa pa gcig gis/ mar pa bya ze'i zer lugs rnams zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ rngog pa la sogs pa'i+ed mkhan mang dag yod pas/ de dag gi rjes su rtogs pa ma 'jug par snying rje dang sgyu lus kyi ngang du gang 'gar bor zhog rang dag la song nas sdig mi gsog ste/ rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin gsungs mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen de// lnga brgya phrag bcu'i snyigs ma la// las can smin grol mdzad pa'i tshe// rje nā ro chen por sku sprul pas// mkhos chung mar pa lo tsā 'di// gsan nam gzigs sam thugs kyis mkhyen// pha thugs rjes zung dang sprul pa'i sku// ZÓ ti byang chub gsung lam du// rlung sems bde drod zung du chud// zag med bde ba chen por 'gro// sgrib bral rig pa'i ye shes shar// bla na med do bla ma'i gsung*// ma rig mun pa dbyings su dag

/gzung du 'dzin pa'i sgrib gnyis bral// bde gsal spros dang bral bar shar// rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba 'di// rang bzhin med pa'i gzugs brnyan te// de ltar rtogs pa'i snang ba rnams// rmi lam snang ba ji bzhin du// chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur shar// lha dang lha min mi rnams dang*// dmyal ba yi gas dud 'gro dang*// sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i snang ba 'di// sgyu ma lta bur med par rtogs// yul dang yul can dmigs pa dang*// 'byung ba'i sgo dang rlung gnas kyis// gang 'dod kyi don du 'gyur 'gyur 'dra// bsre 'pho dri ma med par shar// skye ba'i dus su ma bcos bzhag /rmi lam dus su ma bslad dran// bar do'i dus su ma bcings rig /'bras bu'i dus su ma bsgribs shar// nā ro'i rjes 'brangs skyes bu rnams// gdams ngag zab pa nyams su longs// rig pa yod kyis nges shes bskyed// blo chung log par rtog pa rnams// sangs rgyas la yang skur 'debs shing*// rang grib la yang gshe byed pa'i// skye bo g.yam la rgyug pa la// don la 'di yin 'di min med// blun po 'bod rgyug byed pa la// mkhas rnams de yi rjes mi 'brang*// tha snyad tshig gi chos rnams stong*// nga sku 'di lha yi 'khor lo yin// gsung 'di chos kyi rang bzhin yin// thugs 'di ye shes ngo bo yin// bu sun pa med par nyams su longs// the tshom med par byang chub 'grub// ces gsungs pas nges shes skyes so// yang lan gcig rje mar pa phyag phyi ba dang bcas pa chu 'gram zhig na phar zhabs 'chag tu byon pas/ khyi ra ba'i khyis shwa ba ded byung ba chu nang du shi ba la/ ngas grong 'jug bya'o// khyod 'ga' zhig gis shwa ba'i phyi bzhin shog la khyir bsrung*/ 'ga' zhig lus 'di'i rtsa ru sdod gsungs/ shwa ba la grong 'jug mdzad nas chu'i rjes nar mar gzims khang gi bla g.ye'i phyi ru shwa ba'i ro bskyal nas/

bla ma bzhengs byon te/ bla ma dang bu slob nye 'khor phyi mi mang po shwa ba'i ro la lta zhing yod pa'i tshe/ khyi ra ba rnams kyis slebs nas bsha' grabs byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga rang gis chu'i khang nas rnyed pa'i shwa ba'i ro khyed kyis 'phrog tu mi 'dod gsungs nas bre mo mdzad/ grwa pa dang mi mang gis/ bla mas grong 'jug mdzad pa'i lo rgyus byas pas/ khyi ra ba rnams la na re/ 'o na nged kyi mthong sar grong 'jug mdzad par zhu/ shwa ba'i ro phul bas chog zer/ la la na re/ de 'dra byung zhing mthong na dag shwa ba'i ror ma zad/ gzhan yang phul bas chog zer ba la/ yang rje mar pas/ shwa ba la grong 'jug mdzad de/ sgo la 'dzul/ bla g.ye'i nang du bskyal nas bzhengs te/ ༈ bla ma'i bka' drin grong 'jug gis// tshogs kyi yo byad dam tshig rdzas// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba yi// shwa ba yid bzhin nord par mar pa bya ze yod pa yang dad pa skyes te/ sngar log lta byas pa la 'gyod pas mthol bshags byas/ khyod la sha chang bud med ma bsten na rang la sdig gsungs pa de/ nged rnams kyi snang ngor nged tsho dang khyad med pa zhig las mi yong bar 'dug ste/ da khyed rang la gdeng zhig yod pa 'dug pa de gsung ba zhu dang zhus pas/ khyed rnams kyis tshe rtsa rlung bsgoms// lus sems gcun zhing gcun zhing bsgoms// 'byung ba 'khrugs kyang nyam nga med// bogs 'don du shes pa'i gdeng zhig yod// gnyid kyi dus su 'od gsal bsgoms// snang ba sdud cing sdud cing bsgoms// gti mug tu song yang nyam nga med// zung 'jug tu shes pa'i gdeng zhig yod// rmi lam gyi dus su sgyu lus bsgoms// snang ba spro zhing spro zhing bsgoms// rnam rtog tu song yang nyam nga med// sgyu mar shes pa'i gdeng zhig yod// 'dod yon da tshe lha skur bsgoms// ro bro myang zhing myang zhing bsgoms// bza' btung du mthong rung nyam nga med// tshogs mchod du shes pa'i gdeng gcig yod// thabs lam gyi skabs su gzhan lus bsgoms// bde ba bskyed cing bskyed cing bsgoms// tha mal du 'dug kyang nyam nga med// lhan skyes su shes pa'i gdeng gcig yod// 'chi ba'i dus su 'pho ba bsgoms// 'pho ba sbyong zhing sbyong zhing bsgoms// 'chi ltas byung yang nyam nga med// rdzogs rim du shes pa'i gdeng gcig yod// shi ba'i dus su bar do 'dzin// bar do sprin dang na bun 'dra// chags sdang skyes kyang nyam nga med// rang grol du shes pa'i gdeng gcig yod// ces gsungs pas/

bya ze mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes nas chos dbang zhus/ phyis zhabs tog phul phyin bgyid pa'i yon bdag zhi+ig byung ba lags so// yang ston zhig gi tshe mi mang po tshogs pa'i sar/ g.yag gum nas shi ba'i ro gcig byung dus las mi kun g.yag ro len par 'gro bar chas pa la/ nga'i las skal la g.yag ro blang gi gsungs/ grong 'jug mdzad de g.yag ro bla dbye ru bkal nas/ ༈ mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang*// rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi rta// ro snyoms lcag gis yongs bskul nas// g.yag rgan 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las phral// ces gsungs pas/ grong 'jug la nges shes 'drongs pa rang gis kyang kun gyis rtsod med kyi grub thob tu yongs su grags par gyur to// de ltar grong 'jug gi gdams pa zab pa chig brgyud khyad par can de sras dar ma mdo sde la gnang ba lags so//

sras dar ma mdo sde sku yal tshul/ sgo nas kun gyi thugs dam pa bogs thon tshul/ bstan pa la dar rgyas 'byung bar lung bstan nas/ gdams ngag dang byin rlabs kyi rten zhal gdams dang bcas te gnang tshul/ 'gro kun dang ba 'dren phyir bkod pa sku'i rdzu 'phrul bstan tshul dang gsum gyi dang po/ sras sku yal bas skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi sgo nas kun gyis thugs dam la bogs thon tshul ni/ bla mas rgya gar 'khor ba'i gtang rag rnams grub nas slob 'bangs phal cher rang rang gi gnas su phebs shing*/ bla ma yab sras kun nā ro pa'i bka' lung ltar sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs/ de yang bla ma sras mkhar gyi steng du bzhugs/ de'i 'og tu sras dar ma mdo sde bzhugs/ de'i 'og tu bu chen 'ga' bzhugs shing*/ sras gzhan rnams kyang sku mtshams dam po'i ngang nas bsnyen sgrub la bzhugs/ yum dang mar pa mgo legs/ ba rang lba ba can rnams kyis phyag phyi bgyis pa las/ yab kyis sras dar ma mdo sde la 'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams pa gnang nas/ gdams ngag la rang byan tshud cing gdeng thob pa'i tshe/ khyi sgra dang bcas gzims khang gi sgo brdung ba zhig byung ba las/ sras kyis rgya skar nas gzigs pas/ mi reng dkar po mda' gzhu khyer ba zhig gi tsa na yum phebs 'dug pa la/ mi de na re/ rnga mo chu shul gyi ltad mo lo re la lan re yod pa de gnang sa yod pas/ khyed rang gi jo jos yon bdag byas/ ltad mo dang ston mo gnyis ka byed pa'i gral dbu la sngar snyan gcig phul ba ltar/ bla ma yab sras gnyis gang rung zhig gdan 'dren du yong ba yin pas/ cis kyang phebs dgos zer nan tan lab cing 'dug pa la/ zas chang bzang po gnang ba za ba'i bar la yum gyi zhal nas/ khyed rnams ltad mo dang ston mo gnyis ka byed pa ngo mtshar che ste/ sngar byas pa ltar nged kyi bla ma mar pa la/ jo bo nā ro pa'i bka' lung yin gsungs/ yab sras kun sku mtshams dam po la lo gsum bzhugs dgos pa la/

sngar lo gcig las ma song bas/ yab sras gnyis 'byon pa mi 'ong*/ de 'og gi bu chen drag pa gcig btang gi gsungs/ yum gyis kyang zhal ta nan tan gnang ba la/ kho bzi ba'i gtam la/ yab sras gnyis dgos pa ma gtogs gral dbu ma 'byon pa min/ bla ma 'byon na phyag phyi byas nas 'gro rgyu yin te/ mi 'byon na nga 'gro ngas 'phrin 'khyol yod do// ma 'khyol ma zer cig zer thu ba sprugs nas song ngo*// der sras kyi thugs la nga da lta 'jig rten thad nas pha ma bzang po ni 'dzoms/ pha spun dang nye 'brel grung gsum gyi sgo nas mya ngan dang sems las ni med/ chos ni mkhas/ da lam gyi ltad mo la 'gro ba'i 'os su nga bzang bar 'dug ste/ yab yum gnyis la zhus rung gnang ni mi gnang*/ bros nas 'gro dgos dgongs pa las/ de'i gnangs nyin du song tshe/ phu'i mi thams cad rgyan bkod gzab pa dar bcas ltad mo la 'gro zhing 'dug pa la/ sras kyang yab yum gnyis kyis ma tshor bar 'byon dgos dgongs/ gzims mal nas bzhengs 'byon grabs mdzad pas/ yang thugs dgongs phyi ma gcig la/ ri che sa na g.yang che/ khe che na nyen che/ chos sa na bdud zab bya ba yin/ yab kyi bka' bkyon yang yong*/ bdud kyi bar chad byung nyen yang yong dgongs/ gzims mal du bzhugs pa las/ rgan mo kha na so med pa/ mgo dung ltar song ba gsum yang lho brag rnga mo chu shul gyi ltad mo chen po 'di sngar yang yang mthong ste/ tshim pa rang mi 'dug cing*/ da nam 'chi cha med pas da lan las e mthong mi shes zer/ mkhar stabs ling nge sgyid pa gyo ler 'gro bar gzigs te/ rgan mo gsum po bdud kyi cho 'phrul yin pa de ma dgongs par/ sras kyi thugs la rgan mo ma gi 'dra ba tsho yang 'gro na/ nga gzhon pa pha ma gnyis 'dzom gyi gces phrug ci'i phyir mi 'gro dgongs nas mtshams la har 'don byas/ na bza' ber dkar gcig yod pa de phrag la bkal nas byon pa dang*/

yum tsha ba 'dren du byung ba thug byung bas/ yum gyi zhal nas/ bu mtshams la har 'don byas pa'i khrims med/ gang du 'gro bsam pa yin/ yar log la bsgrub pa la sdod gsungs pa las/ sras yum gyis bzung gi dogs pas skas la phyi babs zhol ra byon song*/ yum gyi phyag gsol chos kyi 'gags pas 'dzin pa ma byung bar sras bros pas/ sras kyi thugs la ga re yum gyis bslab bya mdzad na ni nyan dgos/ sdod gsungs na ni bros dgos dgongs/ sgo'i them pa la rta bzhon log ger bzhugs dus/ yum gyi thugs la/ ngas bu zin pa dang nyan pa byung na bskyil dgos/ ma zin zhing mi nyan na bslab bya zhig byed dgos dgongs/ bu a ma la gsan la yar log byon dang gsungs pas/ sras kyi zhal nas/ yum lags/ bdag zla ba dkar ba zla stod yin/ pha ma tshang ba tshe stod yin/ bya ba lags pas/ bdag la na tsha dang sdug bsngal ni med/ ltad mo la 'gro 'os su bdag bzang ba gda' bas/ da res cis kyang 'gro ba zhu zhus pas/ yum gyi zhal nas/ khyod kyis yab la zhus sam gsungs pas/ ma zhus lags te/ yum la zhus pas khyab che zer/ gshegs grabs mdzad cing 'dug pa las/ yum gyis bu khyod rang ma gsan par 'byon na 'o cag ma bu gnyis dam bca' zhig byed pa yin pas/ 'di dag snying gi dkyil du chongs shig /de ring gi nyin mo la bu gral 'go ru ma sdod/ 'bul ba bla sder ma len/ bsngo ba yon bshad ma byed/ chos gtam ma byed/ chang ma 'thung*/ rta ma rgyugs/ nyi ma phyed tshun nas log byon cig bdun po 'di 'u cag ma bu gnyis kyi dam tshig lags pas/ thugs la cis kyang dgongs 'tshal lo gsungs pas/ sras kyis de ltar 'tshal lo zhes gsungs nas bros ma stabs su gshegs so// der yum gyis sras kyi phyi bzhin rje btsun mi la dang*/ mar pa mgo legs kyi gtso byas pa'i grwa pa'adi lta bu'i sems mi dga' ba yong lugs kyis/ bar chad yong ba min yong snyam pa thugs la shar bar gda'/

sras dpon slob rnams kyi rnga mo chu shul du phebs pa la gral pa mang po tshogs 'dug pa las/ dpon slob rnams kyis bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi gral 'og skye bo mi nag pa rnams kyi gral 'go zhig tu bzhugs pa las/ gral 'go na yod pa'i bla ma bgres shing thugs dgongs mtho ba rnams/ sras dar ma mdo sde yin min gyi the tshom zhig zos nas/ ltar btang bas sras yin par shes nas gral dbu la gdan drangs pa 'byon du ma 'dod pas/ gral 'go ma rnams na re/ rje btsun mar pa'i sras kyi gral 'go ru sdod pa 'di gang nas bltas kyang mi 'thad zer/ bla ma gral 'go ma rnams kyis rang rang gi gdan khyer nas sras kyi gral 'og tu bya 'phur skyas byas byung bas/ sras gral 'go ru byung*/ de'i stobs kyis bla sder dang*/ 'bul ba len dgos dang*/ bsngo ba yon bshad dang*/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis dri ba byas pa'i lan du/ chos gtam mdzad dgos byung bas mkhas pa'i thog chod/ der mi drag pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin chang drangs pa nan ches pas cung zad re 'thung dgos byung*/ de'i tshe nyi ma yang phyed yol du song ba la/ rje btsun mi las/ bla ma rin po che/ ltad mo dang ston mo che gar gyis/ khrom gzhug 'thab mos sdud bya ba lags/ yum gyi bka' gnang phal cher thal gda'/ da nyi ma yang phyed yol tsam du song gda' bas cis kyang phebs par zhu zhus pas/ sras kyi zhal nas/ a pho mthu chen cis kyang bden gsungs/ 'byon par chas pa las/ sras rang gi sku zhang lho brag na nor phyug pa dang ro btsa' ba'i thog chod cing bu med pa des/ rta pho rog dpung dkar zhes bya ba lho brag na mgyogs pa zhig yod pa de la/ sga chas legs pa gcig byas nas sras kyi drung du 'khrid song ste/ tsha bo yar bzhengs shig bsngo ba yon bshad sogs chos mkhas pa'i thog chod/ da rta la bde ba'i thog chod pa byed cig byas pas/ rta rgyug cig zer srab mda' phyag tu phul bas/

sras kyi zhal nas phyis nas zhang pos/ gang zer gyi kha la nyan/ da lan rta rgyugs mi gsung bar zhu/ bdag yong dus yum gyi zhal ta 'ga' yod pa lags te/ phal cher shor thal/ da rta rgyug na kun 'chor ba 'dug gsungs pas/ zhang po na re/ yum bdag med ma dbang che yang nga'i sring mo yin/ nga ji ltar zhan rung jo jo yin/ mo'i kha la nyan nas nga'i kha la ci la mi nyan/ gtam dpe la yang*/ zhang po chus 'khyer ba'i skra nas ma 'dzin bya ba/ kha drag pa'i don yin pas/ cis kyang rta rgyugs dgos/ rgyug rting sga cha dang bcas pa 'bul bar 'bul zer/ phyag nas 'then te/ rta la bskyon nas mi rgyugs pa'i dbang ma byung bar/ rta rgyugs pas/ sku 'bras mtshar ba rtsal che ba la sogs te/ chos 'jig rten gnyis ka'i khrom thog kun chod de/ de nas sras la phud zhu ba mang po rub rub la byung bas/ cung zad bad pa'i nyams kyang byung ba'i tshe/ rje btsun mas dang nad pa rta la mi chags pa ni min/ rta 'thur nas bzung mi dgos/ khyed rang rnams sngon la song zhig gsungs/ grwa pa rnams sngon la rgyang nge byon pas/ lung pa zhan zhes bya ba'i nang na mar phebs pa las/ de'i lam gyi phyogs gcig na brag la chu 'thab kyi 'phrang yod pa/ phyogs gcig la rdza brag gi gseb la bra ma'i nags yod pa/ de'i gseb na sreg pa'i tshang yod pa der phebs pas/ rta'i rmig sgras sreg pa ma bu bdun 'grogs pa'i gshog pa'i sgra dang*/ rtsi sgras chibs 'grogs sras chibs thog nas yar/ zhabs kyi yob bya 'das nas rdza gseb la sras rta yis mda' rgyang gang tsam drud pas dbu chag dbu klad dang khrag mang po 'thor zhing rta bang rgyugs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun mi las/ phyi mig gzigs pas/ mi med pa'i rta de rgyang rgyang rgyugs pa gzigs pas/ sras chibs kyis bskyur bar dgongs te/ rlung bzung nas rgyugs pas chibs zin pa nags la btags/ zhabs yob nang nas bton te thugs dran med du song ba dpang du blangs nas gzigs pas tshad pa brgyad du chag

dbu klad dang mtshal khrag tshabs che ba 'dug pas gzhan bya thabs ni ma byung*// pho ltogs kyang khyung ru deng nge bya ba yin pas/ ngas rta la e chags lta yis/ ske rags 'di 'khrol la phyed mar gshog cig gsungs/ gsungs pa ltar bkrol nas bshags pas phyed dbu la bcings/ phyed sku sked la bcings te/ nga rta la bskyon cig gsungs/ chibs pa la bskyon pas a khu mgo legs na 'then pas nga'i rta sna 'khrid/ gzhan gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon bskyor/ a bo mthu chen sngon la song la yab yum gnyis la nga cung zad bsnad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ lo rgyus zhus shog cig gsungs pa ltar dpon slob rnams phyi nas ga le gu le byon/ rje btsun mi las sngon la byon nas sku mkhar gyi rtse mor bla ma'i drung du phebs te/ phyag btsal nas/ bla ma rin po che/ bdag la zhu mi spol phyin nam gsungs/ phyin lags zhus pas/ mgo gang du chag gsungs/ zhan lung pa'i nang du chag zhus pas/ lung pa zhan zer ba de rang gis chog da lta shi ba med dam gsungs/ ma grongs par 'byon zhing yod zhus pas/ rma bcos ji ltar byas gsungs/ sku chings rgya ma de phyed mar bshags nas phyed kyis dbu bsdams/ phyed sku la bcings yod zhus pas/ rten 'brel la rang pha bu gyes dgos pa 'dug mdang nga'i rmi lam du yang mi nag po zhig byung ste/ kho na re/ nā ro pa'i bka' zhal la/ khyod kyi snying thon la nga la bskur gsungs pa yin zer ba la/ ngas kyang bla ma'i bka' bsgrub snyam/ snying bton nas kho la sprad pas/ kho dga' nas/ thod pa'i nang du bcug gri gug gis kha bcad nas song ba zhig rmis/ gzhan yang maṇ+ḍal gyi dkyil rdol ba/ nyi zla nam mkha'i dbyings su rgas pa/ rak+ta'i mtsho skams pa rnams rmis/ nga rang phyin rung phan gnod cig med pa 'dra/ 'on kyang ngas ma phyin na pha bu'i dam tshig yin pas snying rje/ phyir 'gro dgos gsungs byon pa dang*/ sras bla yer phebs pa mjal ba las/ sras kyi zhal nas bdag gis da nangs ltad mo la phyin pa lags te/

mgo bsnad gda' bas/ skyon mi skyon gzigs par zhu/ zhes dbu yab kyi sku pang du phul bas/ yab kyis dbu chings kyi ske rags bkrol nas gzigs pas dbu thod tshal pa brgyad du chag dbu klad kyi rgya ral zhing 'thor ba gzigs pas/ da bu 'di yun ring ma 'gor ba 'dug dgongs pa'i tshe/ slar yang sras sku rlung gi rnam pas thugs dran nyams pa las/ yab kyi sku pang du sras kyi dbu bzhag gzhogs g.yas 'og tu bcug pa'i snyan khung na mar/ 'pho ba gsal 'debs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bu gsan cig jo sras mdo sde 'bum/ kho bo mar pa lo tsā bas// rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyin// mtshan ldan bla ma gus pas bsten// rje nā ro mai tri rnam gnyis la// rgyud 'grel gdams pa mang du zhus// dbang bzhi'i gnad la ngo sprod byas/ mthar thug nā ro'i thabs lam zhus// khyad chos sre 'pho'i gdams ngag zhus// khyad par 'pho ba grong 'jug zhus// de ma gsang gong du bu la bstan// gdams pa dran nam mdo sde 'bum// 'dus byas ི yi mtshan nyid 'di// mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can las// bu sgyu ma lus kyis rtag ma thub/ glo bur bdud kyi bar chad byung*// thod pa dung dkar gyi 'khor lo chag /klad rgya dar dkar gyi yol ba ral/ klad pa bu Kི'i lha tshogs 'thor// bu sgyu lus 'jig pa shin tu bden// pha jo lha yi dkyil 'khor yin// rnam shes tshangs pa'i lam nas thon// da lan pha jo'i thugs kar 'phos// zhes gsungs pa de/ yum nang na bzhugs pas gsan te/ bla ma sku mkhar rtse na bsgrub pa la bzhugs pa la/ da lta bla g.yer na 'pho ba gsal 'debs kyi mgur gsung gi grags/ nga'i bu de la bar chad byung ba yin nam dgongs/ rings stabs su bla g.yer byon pas/ sras dbu khrag ral nyil lir yab kyi pang na 'dug pa gzigs pas/

re zhig thugs dran med du rgyal/ sangs pa dang yab la/ sman yan lag brgyad pa la ni khyed rang mkhas/ bu 'di 'tsho ba gda' 'am/ mi 'tsho ba gda' zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ sman yan lag brgyad pa la nga mkhas rung*/ ro mgo med pa la gso thabs mi 'dug khams gsum sems can gyi las slebs tshe/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi mthu rdugs bya ba ltar ngas gso thabs mi 'dug shes na khyod kyis gsos dang gsungs/ sras kyi dbu yum gyi pang du gnang ste/ chu zangs gang gi nang na zhag nya mig tsam zhig yod pa de rtsig logs la gtor tshar 'dug bu mtshams kyi sgang la ltad mo la gtong mkhan khyed min pa su yod/ lar rang bud med kyi gros mgo ra'i lam sna/ phyi ba'i bya ra/ thal ba'i la rdzas/ mar gyi nyi 'de rnams la dga' mo byung ba'i dpe med gsungs te dbu bstums nas bzhugs par gda'/ der yum gyi thugs la ngas dag ma nyes te/ da lam shags 'bul ba'i dus su mi 'dug cing*/ bu 'di'i mtshams sbyor la yang gnod pa 'dug pha jo khong sems ngo sprod pa'i bla ma dang yab yin pa la mi 'phos rung*/ nga lus sems skyes pa'i a ma yin pas/ snying brtse bas 'phos te 'ong snyam nas/ yum gyis sras kyi snyan khung la zhal gtad nas bshum zhing*/ 'pho ba gsal 'debs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// mchog gi sprul pa rin po che// mtshan ldan mar pa lo tsā yi// zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// bu 'di nas pha rol gshegs pa'i phyir// 'dus byas phung po 'jig pa la/ thugs khral cung zad yod de mchi// pha jo mar pa lo tsā yis// rgya gar yul la lan gsum byon// sku srog la ma ltos dam chos btsal// mtshan ldan bla ma du ma bsten// khyad par nā ro paṇa chen la*// snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa ma lus gsan// pha jos ma gsang bu la gsungs// dus da lta thugs la gsal mi gsal// nā ro paṇa chen gyi gdams ngag soms// da lta gdeng dang ldan mi ldan// khyad chos bsre 'pho'i gdams ngag la// da lta nges shes skyes ma skyes// skye med phyag rgya chen po la// da lta mnyam bzhag brtan mi brtan// 'pho ba grong 'jug gdams ngag la// da lta gdeng dang ldan mi ldan// 'dus byas sha khrag phung po 'di// mi rtag nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra// sgyu ma lus kyis rtag ma thub// yum nga rang lha mo bdag med ma// dus gsum sangs rgyas skyes pa'i yum// snying paV 'dab brgyad seng ge'i khri// nyi zla paV'i gdan steng na// skyes mchog mar pa bde bas phyis dang gsungs pas/

rje btsun gyi na bzas sras kyi zhal ras phyis tshe/ sras de nyid kyi zhal nas/ ngas skye ba 'di la pha ma gnyis po'i drin lan 'jol ba zhig yong ngam bsam ste/ drin lan ma 'jol ba'i khar/ yab yum gnyis thugs khral la bkod pa 'di 'dra zhig byung bas/ yab yum gnyis la thugs khral mi bgyid pa zhu zer ba'i jur mig lta bu'i 'phrang ring 'jigs pa can srid pa bar do bya ba der/ skye 'gro phal cher la 'jigs skrag gi sdug bsngal myong dgos na'ang*/ nga la pha jo mar pa'i bka' drin gyis gar skye rang dbang yod pas/ srid pa bar do'i sdug bsngal myong ma dgos pa 'dug ste/ lar rang mi lus thob nas chos mi byed pa 'di kun snying rje ste bya thabs mi 'dug de bas yab yum thugs khral du mi 'gro ba'i zhu ba zhig 'bul bas/ a pos ram thig cig gsungs/ zhu don gyi mgur 'di phul lo// ༈ rje sum ldan gyi bla ma rin po che// dpal rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i// yab dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang*// yum sangs rgyas skye byed bdag med ma// yab yum gnyis la gus phyag 'tshal// yab yum gyis dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// nga 'di nas pha rol 'gro ba 'di// ya nga dang bag tsha mi bdog ste// yab yum drin lan ma 'khor 'chi ba 'di// cung tsam sems la 'phreng bar gda'// 'on kyang ma phan 'chi ba la// yab yum thugs khral mi bgyid 'tshal// yab pha jos gsungs pa'i rgyud 'grel rnams// dus da lta semasi bu 'di bzhugs na phyogs thams cad du lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/ char chu dus su babs pa/ mi nad phyugs nad rgyun chad pa dang*/ khyad par du ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba grong 'jug gi gdams pa 'di bod yul du dar ba zhig yong ba yod cing*/ sems can la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i phan thogs pa zhig yong ba yod de/ glo bur bdud kyis bar chad byung gsungs/ de nas sras nang du gdan drangs/

yab yum bu slob rnams kyis mtha' bskor nas bzhugs pa la/ nya ma dpa' mo la sogs pa dad can 'gas sems can gyi don du grong 'jug mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ sras kyi zhal nas/ 'o na ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams pa 'di bod du dar ba zhig 'dod na/ khye'u gtsang ma'i ro la rma med pa gcig 'tshol gsungs pas/ der bu slob rnams kyis phyogs bzhir kha bkram ste btsal bas/ ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba grong 'jug gi chos bod du dar ba'i skal ba med pa la brten nas/ skyes pa khyo ga'i ro rma med pa ni gcig kyang ma rnyed/ slob ma sngags pa zhig gis rgan mo lba ba log nas shi ba'i ro gcig khur byung ste/ 'di la 'pho ba zhu zhus pas/ 'gro don mi nus pas mi 'pho gsungs/ ma 'phos pas/ yang slob ma lug rdzi gcig gis lha khang gog po gcig gi nang nas/ phug ron khras ded de hal nas shi ba'i ro gcig rnyed pa khyer byung ste/ 'di la 'pho ba zhu zhus pas/ dud 'gro la 'phos kyang 'gro don ma yong*/ nga skye ba je dma' la btang ba la khyed la dgos pa yod dam/ nga phug ron la mi 'pho gsungs/ 'pho ru ma 'dod pas/ der slob ma 'ga' dang lug rdzi log lta skyes te/ skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā la/ tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag yod zer te mi bden par 'dug go /sngar bla ma rang gis mdzad pa de rnams kyang ma rgya gar nas bsgyur ba'i chos la mi bden pa ga la srid/ sgos su yang pha jos gsungs pa'i chos la mi bden pa ga la srid/ bla ma la log lta ma byed/ bla ma la log par bltas na ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyu yin no// da ིra gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i phyir dang*/ sgos su yang pha jos gsungs pa'i chosarnams bka' btsan pa'i phyir dang*/ yang sgos su'ang lug rdzi khyod sogs ngan song du mi ltung ba'i phyir du ngas phug ron la 'pho bar bya'o// de la da lta nga bskyed rim la yod/

rdzogs rim du bsdu nas 'pho ba yin/ bskyed rim gyi ngang nas 'phos na yi dam gyi lha bsad pa'i ltung ba yod pa yin pas/ ngas rdzogs rim du bsdus kyis/ phug ron de nga'i sngas mgor zhog la mchod pa shoms shig gsungs pa ltar mchod pa bshams nas/ sras kyis bskyed rim gsal btab tshe/ dgyes pa rdo rje sprul pa'i lha dgu phra lham mer yod pa tha mal pa kun gyis kyang mthong bar byung ngo*// rdzogs rim du bsdus nas 'pho ba mdzad tshe sku'i mdangs yal sang ba dang phug ron cung zad 'gul ba byung*/ sras sku yal ba dang phug ron har langs nas sprug cing*/ yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ bskor ba gsum byas nas gro bo lung gi phu na yar 'phur song ba las/ yab kyi zhal nas/ bu tshur log shog cig gsungs pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i 'phro la log byung ste/ sras mkhar la bskor ba byas nas/ yab kyi sku dpung g.yas pa'i steng du babs nas bzhugs par gda'/ der yab kyi zhal nas/ bdag med ma 'o skol la bu phug ron la re ba'i dus byung bas/ da mchod khang du gdan drongs la mchod pa phul cig gsungs/ dbu rtser gdan drangs mchod pa phul te bzhugs su bcug spur dang gshegs rdzongs dus gcig mdzad pa la/ sras kyi spur khang brtsigs nas yab dang bu chen rnams kyis me mchod mdzad pas/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas 'od zer mi 'dra sna brgyad zug lha dang lha ma yin gyi sgra dang*/ rol mo sna tshogs dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyi char babs pa mis mngon sum du mthong ba byung*/ de'i tshe 'pho ba mdzad pa'i phug ron de dar lam la gdan drangs pa la/ yab kyi zhal nas/ bu spur khang la bskor ba gyis shig gsungs pa ltar/ phug ron gyis spur khang la bskor ba mdzad pas/ der tshogs pa'i skye bo rnams ya mtshan zhing ngo mtshar che bas/ bla ma yab sras la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes par gyur to// de'i tshe yum bdag med ma gang nas byung cha med pa la phebs te/

spur khang la mchong grabs mdzad pa grwa pa rnams kyis bzung pa'i tshe/ nga me la mchong du mi 'jug rung*/ bu'i spur la bskor ba byed du chug gsungs/ bshums pa dang bcas thugs 'byung ba'i gsung sna tshogs 'don zhing*/ bu chen rnams kyis sku skyor te spur khang la bskor ba mdzad pas/ de la brten lho brag gi mi der 'dus pa thams cad mchi ma ma shor ba gcigasdug bsngal byed pa yin/ de dang da lta'i bu la khyad med pas/ rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin snyam pa gyis la sems khral ma byed/ ces gsungs pa'i rgan rgon de gnyis byung ste/ bla ma lags/ bdag cag gnyis kyi bu gcig po shi ba'i tshe/ rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin pas sems khral ma byed gsungs kyi gda' ba/ bla ma la ni da dung yang*/ sras dar ma bsam gtan gyis thog drangs pa'i sras po drug tsam gda' bas/ sras dar ma mdo sde grongs pa yang*/ rmi lam lags mod sgyu ma lags mod/ thugs khral mi mdzad pa zhu zer byung bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga'i de khyed gnyis la yin lugs kyi chos bshad pa yin/ nga la bden bden mo dngos por 'dzin pa'i sdug bsngal med/ khyed gnyis kyi bus/ dang po lus kyi mdangs dang kha'i zas 'phrog bar du lag gi nor dang khang gzhis 'phrog mthar ngan song gsum du skyur bar byed pa de dang nga'i bu mi 'dra/ nga'i bu de ma shi na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ sems can la phan thogs pa zhig yong ba yod pas/ rmi lam gyi nang nas rmi rgod/ sgyu ma'i nang nas sgyu rgod cig yong ba yod pa yin te gsungs/ de nas mchod 'bul rnams grub pa'i tshe/ rje mar pa dgongs pa la bzhugs te/ sras kyi 'gro don gang na yod gzigs pas rgya gar na yod pa mkhyen te/ phug ron la mchod pa phul zhal bkod mdzad nas/ khrom kun gyis mthong sar rgya gar la 'phur btang ste/ dgongs pa la bzhugs pa las/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bdag med ma mchod pa rnying pa rnams bsdus la gsar pa shoms shig

nga'i bu'i lam nor song gsungs/ phyag thal mo brdab dbu bstums nas dgongs pa la bzhugs pas nyi ma dgong mor song ba dang*/ phug ron de thang chad pa'i tshul dang bcas yab kyi pang du 'tshangs byung bas/ do nub phug ron mchod khang du gdan drongs la mchod pa phul gsungs pa ltar mchod pa phul bas/ nangs par yang mi mang po tshogs pa'i sar phug ron de gdan drangs te/ yab kyi zhal nas/ bu khyod kyi kha sang gi lam de nor ba yin no// da dung yang g.yon ri dug sbrul thur du rgyugs pa 'dra ba 'di la phyin na slar yang mu stegs gling du sleb yod pas de la ma 'gro bar/ g.yas ri glang po che gres {

gral } na nyal ba 'dra ba 'di'i rgyud zung la song zhig 'di'i ri rgyud rdzogs mtshams su yi dam gyi 'od kyi lam sna zhig yod/ de'i phyi bzhin byon pas/ bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod na/ bram ze'i khye'u lo bcu gsum tsam lon pa'i ro bskyel ba dang 'phrad yong ba 'dug pas/ de la grong 'jug mdzod la sems can gyi don mdzod cig gsungs pas/ phug ron des yam yum la bskor ba lan gsum dang*/ phyi phyag gi tshul du dbu gug gug pa lan gsum mdzad nas/ yab kyi bka' bzhin 'phur song bas/ mi kun mchi ma shor zhing*/ grong 'jug la nges shes 'drongs pas/ rje btsun mar pa la kun sangs rgyas dngos su mthong bar gyur to// de nas phug ron des yab kyi bka' bzhin byon pas/ bar chad med par bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ bram ze bza' mi gnyis la bu gcig yod pa de shi ba'i ro bskyel ba dang thug ste/ skyel mi rnams ro tshogs byed tshe phebs pa/ de ma thag ro la grong 'jug mdzad nas/ bzhengs pas/ ro skyel mi rnams 'jigs pa las/ sngar yab kyi thugs rjes rgya skad brda 'phrod tsam mkhyen pas/ nga ro langs min nga rang sos pa yin/ khyim du 'gro gsungs pas khong rnams dga' grags ha las ngo mtshar du gyur pa dang bsdebs byon pas/ sngar gyi byis pa rtsed grogs rnams na re/ kho ma shi bar 'dug zer mdun du byung*/ yul mi rnams na re/ rim 'gro la dur khrod du phyin par 'dug zer/ pha ma gnyis dang phrad pas 'changs te brgyal ba las sangs pa dang*/ shi ba sos pa las dga' lugs ji ltar yod pa ltar dga' ste/ ro skyel mi rnams la sos lugs ji ltar byung dris pas/ bu'i ro'i gam du phug ron gcig 'phur byung ba de mgo gug gug byas shi song ba dang*/ bu sos byung zer ro// pha mas sngar ltar brtse bas skyong zhing 'grogs pa las/ sngar gyi bu de bas shes rgyud dal zhing chos la dkar ba/ pha ma la gus shing dbul phongs la byams pa/

dkon mchog la mos shing dge las la brtson pa zhig 'dug pas/ sngar gyi bu de min par shes te ji ltar yin dris pas/ phug ron gyi grong 'jug byas pa sogs lo rgyus rgyas par bshad pas/ rgya gar gyi yul de'i skad du/ phug ron la te phu zer bas/ de la ya mtshan par byas/ mtshan te phur chags pa las/ bu'i 'du shes med par bla ma zer te/ rgan rgon gnyis pos zhabs tog byas pa las/ tshe 'dir yang bu dang 'dra ba'i phan thogs byung zhing*/ mthar rab tu byung nas thos bsam bsgom gsum mdzad pa mkhas grub kyi skyes chen te phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po zhes bya ba de byung bar gda'/ rgya gar gyi lo rgyus 'di dag phyis ras chung ba la te phu bas gnang ba lags so// de nas sras kyi spur khang zhal phye bas dbu thod kyi dum bu la bde mchog lha lnga byon pa sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten ring bsrel mang po byung ba las/ sems las med pa'i mi 'ga' zhig na re/ bla ma mar pa la gdung brgyud 'dzin pa la ni da dung jo sras drug tsam 'dug chos brgyud 'dzin pa la ni bu chen bzang la mang ba 'dug grong 'jug gi ngo mtshar yid ches pa de'am/ rten ring bsrel ngo mtshar can 'di dag la bsam na sras dar ma mdo sde bzhugs pa bas/ sku yal ba sems can gyi don che ba 'dug zer ba yang byung ngo*// de nas phyogs phyogs kyi bu chen sngar ma phebs pa rnams phebs/ 'bul ba rnams mdzad/ thugs sos rung yum bdag med ma thugs khral shin tu che ba las/ bu chen rnams 'dzom tshe/ sras kyi dus mchod cig mdzad pa'i tshogs gral du bla ma'i zhal nas/ bdag med ma phyogs phyogs kyi grwa pa rnams kyang sems 'tshab pa las mi yong ba 'dug ིra 'dus byas thams cad kyi mtshan nyid 'di ga yin zhing*/ rang re la sgos su byung ba ni min la/ bla ma'i lung bstan dang yang mthun par 'dug pas/ bu la phan rgyu med pa'i khar khyod rang sdug pa dang*/ gzhan la chos bshod pa la gnod pa rgan rgon gnyis kyi dpe dang mtshungs pas/

da mya ngan ma byed cig gsungs/ mya ngan sangs byed kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos bshad cing go ba'i shes rab ma// bdag med ma la gros shig 'debs// tha mal dang ma bsres dran pa bsten// nges shes bskyed la mya ngan spongs// bu gces par bskyangs pa'i mdo sde 'bum// 'od gsal dbyings su gshegs pa de// rje dang bka' drin mnyam pa byung*// dran 'dun sgyu ma'i gsal thebs phyir// mya ngan la bya yul mi 'dug cing*/ sems can la nye ring mi 'dug pas// 'gro kun brtse bas skyongs shig bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// gser las bzhengs pa'i mdo mang sogs// sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchod rnams// bu mdo sde'i don du bzhengs lags kyang*// mdo sde 'odapo dang*// sgra thang klog skad kyi lo tsā rnams// bu mdo sde'i don du bslab lags kyang*// mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs// chos bdag med gteragyi kha byang 'dra// chos mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa des// kun la ster ro bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// ser snas bsags pa'i zas nor dang*// grwa pas phul ba'i gnag lug rnams// bu mdo sde'i don du spel lags kyang*// mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs// nor bdag med sa 'og gi gter dang 'dra// phyugs bdi grong khyer 'dra// yul snang stong sgyu mar rtogs pa des// 'dzin spras la byed don mi 'dug pas// mkhar gyi 'dzin spras bor cig bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// pha spun mar tsho'i ngo 'dzin dang*// dgra sun skye bo rgyab bskyur tshul// bu mdo sde'i don du byas lags kyang*// mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshi las skal la// mya ngan ma byed bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// rang la bya rgyu chos las med// brtse bas dbul phongs kyi 'gro ba dang*// shul na lus pa'i bu drug la// bstan 'dzin gyi re bzhed ma mchis te// mdo sde bzhin du brtse bas skyongs// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// paṇa chen nā ro'i lung bstan ltar// kho bo'i bu slob brgyud bcas rnams// zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du// gong nas gong du 'phel rgyas pas// bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar rgyas 'byung*// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen grub// nyams dga' 'o skyid do bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// zhes pa'i mgur gsungs pas/

yum bdag med ma la sogs pa kun gyi thugs khral sangs shing*/ thugs dam la bogs thon par gyur to// bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i lung bstan mdzad tshul/༈ gnyis pa bstan pa la dar rgyas 'byung bar lung bstan nas/ gdams ngag byin rlabs kyi rten zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang tshul ni/ grwa bu slob kyang 'dzoms nas sras kyi dus mchod cig bgyis pa'i tshogs gral du bla ma la slob ma bu chen rnams kyis zhus pa/ bla ma rin po che/ sras dus gsum sangs rgyas lta bu de ni bdag cag sems can rnams kyi bsod nams kyis ma thub/ bla ma rang ni sku ni bgres gda' bas/ da bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che ji ltar dar bar 'gyur ba dang*/ bdag cag slob ma rnams la gdul bya phrin las ji ltar 'byung ba'i lung bstan cig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga nā ro paṇa chen gyi bu brgyud 'di rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pa yin zhing*/ bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la paṇa chen nā ro'i lung bstan bzang po yang yod/ khyed bu chen rnams kyis rmi lam sgugs shog cig gsungs/ der bu chen rnams kyis rmi lam bzung nas bzhugs pas/ kun la rmi lam bzang po 'ga' byung na'ang*/ lung bstan phog pa ma byung ste/ rje btsun mi la la ka chen bzhi'i rmi lam byung tshul rnams bla ma'i drung du phul ba 'di ltar ro// ༈ rje rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du// mdang gsum nyal ba'i rmi lam na// byung tshul bla ma'i drung du 'bul// snyan dar cig bdag la gsan par zhu// 'dzam gling yangs pa'i byang phyogs 'dir// lhun stug gangs ri chags pa rmis// gangs rtse mo gung la reg pa rmis// rtse la nyi zla 'khor ba rmis// 'od kyis nam ུsa pas/ bla ma shin tu mnyes te/ rmi lam bzang 'dug gsungs/ yum bdag med ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzang po gcig grabs gyis gsungs/ der yum gyis yo byad rnams 'dzom pa dang*/ slob ma bu chen rnams bsags nas/

tshogs 'khor bzang po zhig mdzad pa'i gral du bla ma'i zhal nas/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan la rmi lam bzang po 'di 'dra byung 'dug pa ngo mtshar che ang gsungs pa la/ bu chen rnams kyis rmi lam de dag gi brda don bkrol nas lung bstan gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ skyes mchog sgra bsgyur chen pos bu slob rnams la brda sprod rgyal po'i skad la drangs te/ bstan pa la dar rgyas 'byung ba ma 'ongs lung bstan/ rmi lam ka bzhi brda 'grol gyi mgur chen 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// paṇa chen nā ro'i zhabs la 'dud// 'dir bzhugs gdan gang bu slob kun// rmi lam brda las byung ba yi// ngo mtshar ma 'ongs lung bstan 'di// pha rgan nga yis bshad kyis nyon// 'dzam gling byang phyogs sa steng de// bod na dar ba'i thub bstan yin// de steng gangs ri chags pa de// pha rgan mar pa lo tsā dang*// bka' brgyud yongs kyi bstan pa yin// gangs rtse mo dgung la reg pa de// lta ba 'gran zla med pa yin// rtse la nyi zla 'khor ba de// sgom pa 'od gsal mkhyen brtse yin// 'od kyis nam mkha' gang ba de// thugs rje ma rig mun sel yin// rtsa bas sa gzhi khyab pa de// phrin las kyi sa gzhi khyab pa yin// phyogs bzhir chu rgyun 'bab pa de// smin grol dbang bzhi'i gdams ngag yin// chu des 'gro kun tshim pa de// gdul bya smin cing grol ba yin// chu sna rgya mtshor 'bab pa de// 'od gsal ma bu mjal ba yin// me tog sna tshogs bkra ba de// 'bras bu skyon bral nyams myong yin// ིra rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// 'dir tshogs grwa pa bu slob kun// sgos lhun stug gangs ri mthon po de'i// shar du ka chen btsugs pa de// dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge yin// ka thog tu seng chen 'gying ba de// khong mi gzhi seng dang 'dra ba yin// seng g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa de// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin// sder bzhi gangs la bgrad pa de// tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa yin// na mig
