gyen la gzigs pa de// 'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin// seng gangs dkar ltongs su 'phyo ba de// thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin// shar rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// 'dir tshogs grwa pa bu slob kun// lho ru ka chen btsugs pa de// gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor yin// ka thog tu stag mo ngar ba de// khong mi gzhaphyo ba de// thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin// thang shing rgyud du 'brel ba de// bu tsha bos brgyud pa zin pa yin// lho rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// 'dir tshogs grwa pa bu slob kun// nub tu ka chen btsugs pa de// gtsang rong gi me ston tshon po yin// ka thog tu khyung chen lding ba de// khong mi gzhi khyung dang 'dra ba yang*// 'dir tshogs grwa pa bu slob kun// byang du ka chen btsugs pa de// gung thang gi mi la ras pa yin// ka thog tu rgod po lding ba de// khong mi gzhi rgod dang 'dra ba yin// rgod rtse sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa de// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin// rgod tshang brag la bcas pa de// tshe srog brag las sra ba yin// rgod de la bu gas rnams la bshad pa yin// nga pha rgan gyi bya ba byas shing tshar// da khyed bu slob kyi dus la bab nas gda'// nga mi rgan gyi kha la gtad yod na// phyis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar nas yong*// zhes gsungs pas/

tshogs pa kun dga' spro dpag tu med pa thob bo// de nas bla mas bu chen rnams la chos dang gdams ngag gi skor mdzod rnams kha phyes te/ nyin 'chad cing mtshan bsgom du bcug nas/ kun thugs dam dmar bar yod pa'i tshe/ skabs skabs su bu slob rnams kyis tshogs dang 'bul ba byed pa las/ mes ston phyi nas slebs pas tshogs bshams te/ 'bul ba bar pa bgyis pa'i tshogs gral du/ mes ston gyis/ bla ma lags/ sras sangs rgyas lta bu de bdag cag rnams kyi bsod nams kyis ma thub rung*/ bla ma rang nyi zla lta bu la/ bla ma rngog pas dbu mdzad thugs sras bu chen rgyu skar lta bus bskor nas/ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa nyin mor bgyid pa yong*/ ngo mtshar chen po lags pas/ do nub kyi tshogs gral 'dir bla ma rang gi mdzad pa/ bdag cag rnams kyi mig rgyan la phan pa'i mgur zhig thugs la 'dogs pa zhu zhes zhus pas/ srog dang do bsdos pa'i// zab mo'i gdams ngag nub par phangs// mes ston dang rngog ston ma gtogs pa// khong gzhan la gzhung bshad byas pa med// chos 'dod pa rnams la shod cig byas// nor dbul ba can gyi slob mas kyang*// bla ma la bka' rgyas btab pa med// nor ci yang med pa'i mthu chen dang*// zhabs tog can gyi rngog ston la// gdams ngag la dam lhod ma byas pas// dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa gyis// mi nga yis dka' las 'di tsam byas// nor chud zos can du ma song ba// lag tu gser srang brgya cu 'khyer// rten khyad par can la mchod pa phul// bla ma rnams la 'bul bar bgyis// gnas khyad par can du tshogs gtor byas// bu khyed kyis byas pa'i zhabs tog la// drin lan dam chos dpag med sbyin// chos kyi zho sha nyams su longs// 'gro ba gzhan la ci phan mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ mes ston nges shes 'drongs te/ thugs bskyed chen po byung ngo*// de nas rje mar pas/ bdag med ma'i zab dbang gcig mdzad pa'i nub mo thugs dgongs la bu slob 'di rnams la/

khyad par du chos gang la gang gi bka' babs pas phrin las yong ba de dang de la de ster dgongs pas/ nangs par tho rangs kyi rten 'brel brtag par bya dgongs nas/ tho rangs 'od gsal gyi ngang nas/ bu chen rnams la gzigs pas/ gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor gyis rgyud 'grel 'ga' la bshar sbyang mdzad/ dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nges 'pho ba bsgom/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon pos 'od gsal bsgom/ rje btsun mi las gtum mo bsgom pa gzigs pas/ chos so so'i bka' babs dang phrin las gang yod mkhyen te/ bla ma rngog pa la/ mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sgo nas rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag mu tig star la brgyus pa lta bu zhig yod pa de dang*/ nā ro'i rgyan drug thugs dam pa V rā ga dgang bzar dgang blugs/ rgya 'grel gyi phyag dpe dang bcas pa gnang nas bshad pa'i sgo nas 'gro don gyis shig gsungs/ dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge la 'pho ba rgya mthongs kha bye ba la bya 'phur ba lta bu zhig yod pa de dang*/ nā ro'i dbu lo/ phyag sen/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rnams gnang ste/ 'pho ba sbyongs shig gsungs/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po la 'od gsal mun nang du mar me sbar ba lta bu zhig yod pa de dang*/ nā ro'i rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ nya phyis kyi ka pa la rnams gnang nas/ bar do chod cig gsungs/ rje btsun mi la la gtum mo'i khyad chos shing bshags pa la me sbar ba lta bu dang*/ mai tri pa'i dbu zhwa/ nā ro'i na bza' rnams gnang nas/ gnas g.ya' khrod dang*/ gangs khrod 'grims la lta sgom nyams su longs shig gsungs/ de nas grwa pa kun 'dzom pa'i tshogs 'khor gcig mdzad pa'i gral du/ ngas khyed rnams la rten 'brel dang mthun pa'i gdams ngag byin pa bzhin/ slob brgyud rnams la yang gtso bor rang rang gi gdams ngag gis/ phan thogs dang 'phrin las rgya cher 'byung ba yin no// da mdo sde 'bum ni med/

nga'i bka' brgyud kyi pha rabs kyi gdams ngag dang*/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa khyed rnams la gtad pa yin pas 'bungs shig 'gro don 'phel bar yong ngo gsungs/ de'i rjes su mes ston gyis/ 'bul ba gsum pa bgyis pa'i tshogs gral du/ mes ston gyis bla ma lags/ de ring bdag la thugs brtse bas dgongs te/ paṇa chen nā ra kyi phyag len dang*/ nyams len la do gal chen po byas pas/ rgya che la nges pa khong du chud pa la mgu/ gdams ngag la bka' dog po rang 'di ma byed par/ dad can gyi gang zag chos chud mi gson pa rnams/ dbang gdams ngag la yongs su chug cig gsungs/ mes ston rang gi 'dod zhus dang*/ bka' yongs su gtong ba la ched du gtad pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bde ba'i dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon// sprul sku zung 'jug he ru ka// gar mgu'i nyams len bde stong ngang*// zhal sbyor lhan cig skyes la 'dud// brda mthong tsam gyis don rtogs shing*// zur gyis go ba'i gang zag la// thos pa tsam gyis grol bar 'gyur// tha snyad tshig gis mi mtshon pa// zag med don gyi ye shes ster// bskyod pa bde ba'i skad cig la// sdug bsngal med pa de lta bur// zag bcas yid 'di mi ches pas// bde stong ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun// rtogs pa bral ba'i sems la zhog /sangs rgyas lta bu'i bla ma'i gsung*// yang brgyud pa gzhan nas 'di skad gsungs// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma la// sgyu rtsal goms par gyur pa yi// skyes bu bya la mda' rtse bzhin// goms pa rgyud la rtag brten la// ji ltar zhan pa'i bag chags 'byung*// gdod nas dag pa'i sems rgyud 'di// glo bur rkyen gyis ma bslad na// nam mkha' bzhin du 'dus ma byas// phyin ci ma log gnas lugs yin// yid la bya rgyu rdul dang bral// bzung du rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang*// man ngag rgyud la goms pa yis// tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe// pha rol phyin pa'i dbyings su thim// de la skye ba yod ma yin// nam mkha' lta bu'i rang sems de// na bun rtog pas ma bslad cig

/rje nā ro paṇa chen 'di skad gsungs// chos tshul bzhin nyams su len pa la// snyug dong bcug pa'i sbrul bzhin du// rtsol ba bral ba'i lus mi 'gul// yid la chags pa'i mya ngan rnams// gnad la phog pa'i zug rngu ltar// bya ba btang ba'i sems mi yong*// sems gnyug ma'i rang bzhin gdod nas stor// tho bas dngos po 'joms pa bzhin// mthong dang reg dang dran pas grol// don 'di la legs par go bar mdzod// 'di phyag rgya chen po'i sgom dbyangs yin// dam chos gzhan la phan gyur na// sho sbar ma bsdams mes ston pa// skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag la// sba bar mi bya man ngag sbyin// ces gsungs so// de nas bu chen rnams so so tha dad kyi gdan sar phebs pa las// rje btsun mi la la zhag shas sdod gsungs pa ltar bzhugs pas/ rje mar pa la thugs sras skal ldan gyi bu slob ji snyed yod pa rnams la snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag ma gnang bar/ nā ro'i lung bstan ltar rje btsun mi la la/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi dbang gdams ngag cha lag dang bcas rdzogs par gnang zhing*/ gzhan yang snyan brgyud kyi che brjod sogs zhal gdams mang du gnang nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ brgyud pa kun la yod mod kyi// mkha' 'gro yod na yod pa yin// mes po kun la yod mod kyi// tai lo yod na yod pa yin// bla ma kun la yod mod kyi// nā ro yod na yod pa yin// gdams ngag kun la yod mod kyi// snyan brgyud yod na yod pa yin// bsgoms te sangs rgyas kun la yod// ma bsgoms rgya na rgya ba yin// ces gsungs pas/ rje btsun mi las/ rang re'i brgyud pa dang gdams ngag rnams la/ rgya bod kun na grags che ba gzhir bzhag cing*/ de'i stobs kyis bod na ni snyan grags brgyud pa gong ma rnams dang khyad med pa 'di ga yin/ rje rang gi bla ma rnams la mos gus kyi gdung shugs dang mdzad 'phrin 'dis/

bla ma rin po che la rgya gar na yang snyan par grags pa 'dra lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga'i brgyud pa dang gdams ngag la rgya yin// bla ma snyan par mi grags rgyu// nā ro chos kyi sgron me yin// mi nga rang snyan par mi grags rgyu// nā ro'i thugs kyi sras gcig yin// gdams ngag snyan par mi grags rgyu// snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu 'di// gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos yin// ces gsungs pas/ rje btsun mi las/ gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos snyan brgyud thob pas/ rje btsun mar pa'i gdams pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du byung bas thugs tshim zhing*/ de 'bras kyis bod gangs can gyi khrod 'dir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi ma shar bas/ 'gro ba kun gyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas ye shes snang bas nyin mor bgyid pa lags so//

gsum pa 'gro kun dang ba 'dren phyir bkod pa sku'i rdzu 'phrul bstan tshul ni/ ༈ rje btsun mi la bla ma'i drung nas 'byon dus bla mas sku lha sku du ma dang*/ 'byung bzhi dang*/ ci yang mi snang ba dang*/ 'ja' tshon dang 'od du snang ba la sogs te rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas mthong bas yid ches sam gsungs/ mthong lags/ yid mi ches pa'i rang dbang mi gda' bas/ bdag rang yang bsgoms nas 'di 'dra byed dgos snyam pa byung lags/ zhus pas/ bu de yin da 'gro na yang song zhig gsungs nas/ rje btsun mi las 'khrungs yul du byon par gda'/ de'i rjes su mar pa mgo legs la sogs pa'i bu slob 'ga' dang 'gas bla ma'i sku dgyes pa rdo rje/ 'khor lo bde mchog gsang ba 'dus pa/ rdo rje phag mo sogs su mthong ba mang po rang byung ba la/ ji ltar lags zhus pas/ de ltar ka yin yong gsungs/ bskyar nas ji ltar lags pa gsung du gsol ces gsol ba btab pas/ nga yi dam gyi bskyed rim gsal bdo ba dang*/ khyod rang rnams la dag snang shar ba gnyis dus mtshungs su mthong ba yin gsungs/ yang la las rje btsun mar pa'i gzims mal dang*/ gzhan yang gang bzhugs sar sku dngos ma mthong bar ga gsungs pa ltar 'gro gsungs/ 'das ma 'ongs thogs med du mkhyen pa dang*/ gzims khang nang nas phyir 'byon pa dang*/ phyi nas nang du 'byon pa la skas dang sgo la 'byon mi dgos par/ gang 'dod la thogs rdugs med parabyon pas/ sras dpal 'od na re/ rang re'i pha jo rtsig pa dang sgo yis kyang mi thub pas/ bsrung dgos byung na gang gis kyang mi thub par 'dug gsungs pa ltar/ snang ba la thogs rdugs med pa la sogs te/ zad par zil gnon gyi thugs dam mngon du gyur pas/ rtags dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa bstan pa'i mthar/ yum bdag med ma 'od du zhu nas rje mar pa'i thugs la thim par gyur ro// gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim tshul/༈ lnga pa bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzad nas gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim tshul ni/

sku tshe hril por bstan pa dang sems can gyi don kho na mdzad rjes/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad bya lo rta'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma rtse shar la bsnyung gzhi med cing*/ thugs spro ba'i nyams dang ldan pa las/ nam mkha' la 'ja'i gur phub/ me tal nā ro pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas/ zhal bzhes ltar kho bo bsu ba la phebs byung*/ da ni phyag phyi byas dag pa mkha' ོda la 'gro gsungs mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang la bzhugs shing*/ mar pa mgo legs la sogs pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis mchod pa dpag tu med pa bshams nas phul ba'i tshe/ me tog gi char/ rolakyi bka' drin gyis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnams las gsang sngags kyi dbang gdams pa rnams thob/ nang 'od gsal gyi rtsal 'byongs shing rlung sems la rang dbang thob pas/ grong 'jug dang rdzu 'phrul/ mngon par mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag med mngon gyur du mnga' yang*/ sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs nas/ phyi rol tha mal pa rnams dang snang ba mthun pa'i tshul du/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang*/ 'jig rten chos brgyad la dgyes bzhin rol pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas/ snod ldan gyi gang zag mang po'i don mdzad pa de rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' 'ga' zhig la ni pha dang ma dgos la/ chung ma mi dgos pa yod do// byang chub sems dpa' 'ga' zhig la ni pha ma dang chu+od mthun pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa lags so// yang rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi le'u bdun pa las/ ༈ bu mo shin tu brgyan pa'am// de bzhin chung ma sdug pa dag /phul nas rin gyis bsrung ba ni// sangs rgyas byang chub mchog gi yon// rin chen bdag gis phul nas su// slar yang rin gyis bslu ba ni// rdo rje 'dzin pas sbyor ba yi// yon de yon gyi mchog yin no// zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par yon phul zhing bzhes pa'i sgo nas/ sems can gyi don mdzad pas sgrub brgyud rtogs pa'i bstan pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa bgyis pa lags so// rje mar pa de nyid kyi yongs su grags shing bka' drin che ba'i bla ma bcu gsum ni/

mkhas grub nā ro paṇa chen/ rgyal sras mai tri pa/ dpal zhi ba bzang po/ ye shes snying po/ rnal 'byor ma rus pa'i rgya can/ ko so ri pa dang*/ ri ri pa ste sing gha gling pa sku mched/ dze ta ri pa/ ku su lu cha ba/ pradz+nyā/ las can gyi slob ma bzhi ni/ gtsang gyer phu'i klog skya chen po/ 'phan yul gyi nya ma dpal mo/ 'dam snying drung gi mar pa mgo legs/ lho la yag gi ba rang lba ba can rnams lags so// rje sgra sgyur chen po de nyid kyi gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim rjes kun sangs rgyas su yid ches nas/ dbu lo/ phyag sen/ na bza' la sogs pa'i dum bu la yang*/ yon chen po mang dag 'bul mkhan byung ba la brten/ sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu ma zhu bar dar zab kyis dril nas 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol ba la/ sras dpal 'od la sogs pa rnams kyis sku sha gdung dang bcas pa gnang nas yon blangs pa las/ zhal lko'i 'phan yul gyi dgon pa zhig tu phebs pa/ bla ma rngog pas gsan te ma bzod par/ sras rnams la 'bul ba chen po 'bul/ gdung 'dir gnang dgos gsungs pas/ 'o na 'bul ba'i gtso bor pha jo rang la/ nā ro pas gnang ba'i thugs dam pa V rā ga dgos gsungs pa ltar/ thugs dam paV de ltar rje btsun mar ston chos kyi blo gros kyi rnam par thar pa mthong ba don ldan 'di nyid/ rje btsun mi la dang mar pa mgo legs gnyis kyis/ ngan rdzong ston pa la zhib rgyas zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa dang*/ rje btsun mi las ras chung pa la yang gnang bas/ ras chung pa dang ngan rdzong ston pa byang chub rgyal po gnyis bka' bgros nas bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar phyi mo'i gtso bor bzhugs pa las/ bla ma rngog pa/ mtshur ston/ mes ston rnams kyi zhal nas byung ba'i yig cha la sogs rnam dag 'dzom pa'i nang nas/ skye 'gro dang ba'i mig rgyan mchog tu gyur pas/ don la srid zhi'i dgos 'dod 'byung ba rin po che bai ḍū

4'i phreng ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i mig la/ lhag bsam gyi lung tshig sdeb sbyor legs par brgyan nas/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyan 'dod rnams kyi yid 'phrog par byed pa'i rin chen rgyan gyi phreng ba 'di nyid/ dur khrod nyul ba'i rnal 'byor ba khrag 'thung rgyal pos/ dbang phyug mi la ras pa mngon par rtogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas mchog chu dbar sprul sku'i pho brang du yi ger bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni shri lo paṇa pa 'jam dpal chos lha'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// / 009) ༄// mar pa lo tsā'i rnam mgur/ sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsās bla ma la rtogs pa phul ba'i mgur/ ༈ dpal nā ro pa'i drung du dbyangs ring te pu'i ri'i khong rgyud kyi skad la rta drangs te/ rtogs pa 'di mgur du phul ba lags so// rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che// khyed sngon sbyangs bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir// sprul sku tai lo dngos dang mjal// spang dka' srid pa'i sdug bsngal la// khyad du bsad pa bcu gnyis mdzad// dka' ba da pa'i thugs dam de// skad cig nyid la bden pa gzigs/ shrī dz+nya na si K'i zhabs la 'dud// sgra sgyur bod kyi ban chung nga*// sbyangs pa snga ma'i las 'brel gyis// nā ro paṇa chen khyed dang mjal// rgyud zab mor grags pa'i dgyes rdor bslabs// snying po ma hā ma ya gnang*// yang snying bde mchog 'khor lo zhus// lar rgyud sde bzhi yi khong snying phyung*/ ma skal ba bzang mos rjes gnang ba'i// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma chad pa'i// dbang gzhi'i don la ngo sprod mdzad// zag pa med pa'i ting 'dzin skyes// zhag bdun bar du brtan pa thob// srog rtsol 'pho ba nyi zla gnyis// g.yo med nam mkha'i khyim du tshud// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams// bde gsal mi rtogs khong nas shar// bag chags gnyid kyi 'khrul pa de// 'od gsal lam gyi ngo bor rtogs// yid kyi g.yo ba gzung 'dzin gnyis// spros bral chos kyi sku ru thim// phyi nang sgyu ma'i 'khru+ul 'khor 'di// skye med phyag rgya chen por rtogs// nang 'dzin pa yid kyi rnam shes 'di// sngon chad mdza' bo 'phrad pa bzhin// sems nyid rang ngo rang gis shes// lkugs par rmi lam rmis pa bzhin// brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar// gzhon nus bde ba myong ba bzhin// smra ru med pa'i don zhig rtogs// rje sku drin che'o nā ro pa// sngar yang dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs// da dung bka' drin bskyab tu gsol// zhes phul/a ha ri ma gtogs pa'i// dgon pa brgya dang brgya bcu gcig

/'di ma gcig bas kyang shul na 'phreng*// rdo rje gdan drung ma gtogs pa// rten bzang po brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di ma gcig bas kyang shul na 'phreng*// rgya gar 'ji gol ma gtogs pa// chang sna brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di ma gcig bas kyang shul na 'phreng*// 'bras sa lu gzhung sngon ma gtogs pa'i// zas sna brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di ma gcig bas kyang shul na 'phreng*// gnas po 'ba' ro ma gtogs pa// gnas po brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di ma gcig bas kyang shul na 'phreng*// 'di drug 'phreng ba'i 'phreng drug lags// dug mtsho nag mo ma gtogs pa'i// mtsho phran brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di dngul chu bas kyang mdun na mtsher// chu bo gang ga ma gtogs pa'i// chu phran brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di dngul chu bas kyang mdun na mtsher// mon pa glo bag ma gtogs pa'i// mi rkun brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di dngul chu bas kyang mdun na mtsher// bal po'i 'phrang rdzas ma gtogs pa// sho gam brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di dngul chu bas kyang mdun na mtsher/ kha la dang bya la ma gtogs pa'i// la phran brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di dngul chu bas kyang mdun na mtsher// dpal mo dang dpal thang ma gtogasapa'i// thang phran brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /'di dngul chu bas kyang mdun na mtsher// de tsho mtsher ba'i mtsher drug lags// dgyes rdor gdan bzhi ma gtogs pa'i// rgyud phran brgya dang brgya bcu gcig /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'pho ba dang grong 'jug ma gtogs pa'i// man ngag brgya dang brgya bcu shes// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// gtum mo lhun grub ma gtogs pa'i// sems 'dzin brgya dang brgya bcu shes// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// na tsha bogs dbyung ma gtogs pa// gegs sel brgya dang brgya bcu shes/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'od gsal sgyu lus ma gtogs pa// bsam gtan gnyid dang bsre ba shes/

e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// rnam rtog lam du lhong tsa na// las kyi phyag rgya'i gdams ngag shes// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ de ngo mtshar che ba'i che drug lags// rgyud kyi rgyal po dgyes rdor shes// nā ro paṇa chen gyi gdams ngag yod/ da dgon par mi sdod na rang la sdig /rgyud kyi rgyal po gdan bzhi shes// 'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams ngag yod/ tha mal du 'chi na rang la sdig /sems 'dzin gyi rgyal po gtum mo shes// btsan thabs gnad kyi gdams ngag yod/ nyams su mi len na rang la sdig /rlung gi de nyid bdun cu shes// na tsha bogs dbyung gi gdams ngag yod/ sman pa 'gug na rang la sdig /'od gsal sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag yod// bsam gtan gnyid dang bsre ba shes// tha mal du nyal na rang la sdig /rnam rtog lam du lhong tsa na// las kyi phyag rgya'i gdams ngag yod// bu mo spel na rang la sdig /'di drug sdig pa'i sdig drug lags/ zhes bod du 'byon khar gsungs so// rje mar pa chen po/ dpal chen po nā ro pa'i zhabs drung du lo drug zla ba bdun du bzhugs nas/ da zangs kyi bod du byon khar/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gro la gtang rag gi mchod pa phul ba'i rjes su thugs dgongs btang bas/ yong bla ma grub thob dang mjal/ bka' rgyud sde zab mo la nyan bshad byas/ gdams ngag ngo mtshar can thob/ nyams khyad par can skyes/ dus de ring tsam las dga' ba mi 'ong snyam nas/ bla ma dz+nya na siKི'i zhabs la 'dud// nga sgra sgyur bod kyi ban chung 'di// sbyangs pa snga ma'i las 'brel gyis// nā ro paṇa chen khyed dang mjal// rgyud zab mor grags pa'i dgyes rdor bslab// snying po ma hā ma ya gnang*// yang snying bde mchog snyan brgyud zhus// lar rgyud sde bzhi'i khong snying phyung*// ma skal ba bzang mos rjes gnang ba'i// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma chad pas// dbang bzhi'i don la ngo sprod mdzad// zag pa med pa'i ting 'dzin skyes// zhag bdun bar du brtan pa thob// srog rtsol 'pho ba nyi zla gnyis// g.yo med nam mkha'i khyim du chud// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams/

/bde gsal mi rtog khong nas shar// bag chags gnyid kyi 'khrul pa de// 'od gsal lam gyi ngo bor rtogs// yid kyi 'gyur ba gzung 'dzin gnyis// spros bral chos kyi dbyings su thim// phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di// skye med bde ba chen por rtogs// nang 'dzin pa sems kyi ngo bo de/ sngon chad mdza' bo 'phrad pa bzhin// sems nyid rang ngo rang gis shes// lkugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin/ brjod du med pa'i don zhig rtogs// gzhon nus bde ba myong ba bzhin// smra ru med pa'i nyams shig shar/ pha sku drin che'o po nā ro pa/ sngar yang dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs// da yang sku drin skyab tu gsol// zhes rtogs pa phul bas rje nā ro pa shin tu mnyes pa yin gsungs/ rje mar pa'i dbang gi rtogs pa phul ba'i mgur yin no// ༈ tho rangs khar dga' ba'i nyams rdo rje glu'i maṇ+ḍal 'di bla ma la phul bar gda'o// rje sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'i sku// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhing dag pa nā ro paṇa chen dang*// dpal ye shes snying po'i zhabs la 'dud// nga lho brag bod du las dbang gis// pha ma gnyis kyis lus skyes pa'i// mar pa blo gros bgyi ba'ang*// chos la bkod pa'i bka' drin can// yab yum gnyis la gus phyag 'tshal// drin chos kyis 'khor bar byin gyis rlobs// rang bzhin skye med kyi maṇ+ḍal la// snang ba sna tshogs kyi me tog bkod// bla ma'i sku la mchod pa 'bul// bdag gi lus la byin gyis rlobs// nam mkha' rnam dag gi maṇ+ḍal la// 'gag med rten 'brel gyi me tog bkod// bla ma'i gsung la mchod pa 'bul// bdag gi ngag la byin gyis rlobs// rang sems bde chen gyi maṇ+ḍal la// rnam rtog phral 'joms kyi me tog bkod// bla ma'i thugs la mchod pa 'bul// bdag gi yid la byin gyis rlobs// rin chen sa gzhi'i maṇ+ḍal la// ri rab gling gzhi'i me tog bkod// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs// zhing khams sa gzhi rab 'byams la// 'byung ba lnga las skyes pa yi// mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo la sogs mchod rdzas rnams// legs par grub pa ji snyed pa// bla ma rje la mchod pa 'bul// bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo dang*// bla bres yol ba la sogs pa// blo yis sprul nas mchod pa 'bul// rtogs pa 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas ye shes snying po la// rgyud chen gsang ba 'dus pa nyan// thabs shes zung du 'jug par go

/chos kyi lde mig yin par go// rgyud kyi rgya mtsho yin par go /chos dang zang zing sbyin pa byung*// snying gi ljon shing rgyas byed cing*// tshig tshogs dri med lo 'dabs rgyas// ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i don rnams mtha' dag 'byung*// rim lnga'i lam mchog bgrod pas bde// 'od gsal sgyu lus rmi lam gyi// gdams ngag rin chen thugs la btags// sku drin che'o dz+nyā na ba// 'di nas bzung ste mthar thug gi /bla med byang chub ma thob par// ི gtsug bde ba chen po'i rgyan du bzhugs// snying gi dkyil du 'bral thabs med// skyo 'jigs med par skyabs su mchi// thugs rje'i lcags kyu 'od zer can// ma rig mun pa bsal nas kyang*// lus ngag yid gsum bzung du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa lags// ༈ bla ma la chos rdzogs par thob pa gtang rag gi dga' ston bshams pa'i tshogs gral du/ mar pa thugs spro ba'i ngang nas bla ma dang mched lcam rnams kyi drung du gnang ba zhus nas mgur 'di phul lo// rje sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi sras// 'gro ba kun gyi rdo rje 'chang*// rgyud gnyan po rnams kyi gter bdag po// dpal zhi ba bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud// sku mthong bas nga rgyal ri bo bsnyil// gsung thos pas tha mal sems rgyud grol// thugs dran pas phyi nang mun pa bsal// deng sang dus kyi skal ldan bdag /bod nas rgya gar yul du mchis// bshul thag ring ba'i mi zhig yin// dam chos paṇ+ḍi ta la zhus// brgyud pa nye ba'i dam chos thob// rje dngos grub can gyi zhabs la btugs// mi dang mi min bar chad zhi// gsang sngags pha rgyud ma rgyud thob// gdams ngag che ba'i ston pa yin// dpal zhi ba bzang pos thugs la btags// bla ma bzang po'i bu gcig yin// bar chad med par lho bal bgrod// las 'phro can gyi ban Zེ yin// bde mchog rgyud rgyal bde blag khums// sgrub thag nye ba'i dam chos yin// bkra shis lung bstan zhal nas thos// mi lus thob pa'i don go yin// lho brag bod du lte ba bcad// dkar po'i rgya la las 'phro sad// grub thob mkhas pa rnams dang mjal// dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag thob// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug zhabs drung du// rnal 'byor gsum gyi don la bslabs// sgyu ma chen po'i ma dang mjal// kun tu bzang po'i pha rgan bsten// chags lam ting 'dzin nyams su bdar// shes rab gsum gyi sgron me rgyas// gti mug gsum gyi mun pa bsal// sgrib pa gsum gyi bud shing bsregs// ngan song gsum gyi dur sa stongs// bka' drin che'o bla ma rje// skyid do chos kyi blo gros bdag

/dga' 'o 'dir bzhugs mched lcam kun// zhes pa'i glu bod skad du blangs/ ༈ bla ma la phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa dang dga' spro dpag tu med pa zhig thob nas/ mar pas phyi phyag gi tshul du/ bla ma dang chos grogs rnams la yang rtogs pa 'di mgur du phul lo// 'di na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rnams// snying grogs spun rnams snyan gsan 'tshal// mgo rgod mar pa lo tsā ngas// las 'brel sad pas lho bal phyin/ dngos grub can gyi bal po dang*// ye shes snying po zhi bzang la// gdan bzhi gsang 'dus bde mchog skor// rgyud dang man ngag gter kha phyes// da lta slob dpon zhal snga nas// zhus pa gnang ba'i dam chos tshar// lung bstan bkra shis dus gcig thob// mdang sang thal ba'i khar nub tu// maṇ+ḍal yid kyis bshams nas kyang*// mai tri pa la gsol btab snyam// 'khrul pa'i bag chags rmi lam du// mnga' bdag mai tri'i pho nya mo// bud med lus la bzhin rgyas ma// lag na bum pa thogs pa yis// mi kho bo'i mgo la reg pa rmis// thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs pa 'dra// sngon smon lam las kyi 'brel lam bsam// de phyir dad 'dun drags la bstod pa'i mgur 'di phul lo// khyed 'gro ba'i don du 'dzam gling 'dir// rgyal po'i rigs su skye ba bzhes// phyi nang sgrub thabs sna tshogs mkhyen// mai tri pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun sgrol mas lung bstan nas// bar chad med par byin gyis brlabs// ri khrod dbang phyug zhabs rdul reg /a wa ZÓ ti khyod la bstod// sku ni rin chen gser gyi ri// ye shes smon sogs rnam dag pa// nyon mongs nad rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i// chos kyi nyi ma khyed la bstod// thugs ni stong nyid rdo rje yis// bdag lta'i ri bo chen po 'joms// chos rnams mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa'i// mnyam med bla ma rje la bstod// sprul sku 'dzam gling kun gyi rgyan// rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid// thugs rje'i gter ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// gtsug gi rgyan gyur khyod la bstod// mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs// gang zhig dregs can ma lus pa// brtul zhugs nus pas bka' nyan mdzad// rdo rje 'dzin pa khyed la bstod// bde gshegs bla ma thugs rje can// mnga' 'bangs bor nas dam chos mdzad// paṇa chen nā ro la sogs pa'i// bla ma kun las gdams ngag zhus// rgyud sde'i slob gnyer 'ga' re tshar// lho dug mtsho khol ma'i do ri la// dpal zhi ba bzang po'i zhabs drung du// dam pa khyed kyis thugs rjes bzung*// srog phangs pa med par drung du 'ong*// ri bo me 'bar gyi dgon pa na// shing ‚ gro Z'i bsil grib la// mnga' bdag rgyal sras mai tri pa// pha sangs rgyas khyed dang da lta mjal// nyi ma shar 'dra'i dad pa skyes// shi yang phod pa'i dad pa g.yos// kha gting med par gsol ba btab// rgyun chad med par byin gyis brlabs// bram ze chen po'i srol 'dzin cing*// sprul pa'i ri khrod dbang phyug drung*// legs par 'ong ba dam pa'i choV nyi zla la// bla ma mnga' bdag byams mgon bzhugs// bdag gi sems rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// yi dam lha tshogs ji snyed pa// dbyer med dpal ldan ZÓ ti pa// snying gi paVོsa tshul bzhin zhus// khyad par phyag rgya chen po zhus// chos shes pa rnams kyi sgro 'dogs bcad// mi shes pa rnams slob gnyer byas// rje sa ra ha yi bka' srol gyi// byin rlabs dang rtogs pa dus gcig byung*// rje la rtogs 'bul gyi dbyangs shig len// phyi nang grub mtha' sna tshogs kun// rtogs shing phyag rgya chen por 'dus// snang ba bad// gzhi sems nyid chos skur da gzod go

/mi kho bo'i the tshom da gzod zad// 'khrul pa'i gzhi rtsa da gzod zhig /tha snyad la sangs rgyas mi re bas// rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhabs drung du// don nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu dang*// brgyud pa rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// go ba nyams myong rtogs pa 'di// phul ba bla ma rje btsun dang*// mched grogs 'dir bzhugs dgyes par mdzod// ces phul/

rgya gar phar 'byon gyi mgur/ ༈ dpal nā ro mai tri'i zhabs la 'dud// ngas nā ro'i drung du dam bcas pa'i// dgos pa mchog cig yod pa'i phyir// gsung mkha' 'gros brda bkrol bskul mdzad pas// bla ma dran te bzod glags med// nga las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro /dpal mo dpal thang du che lags kyang*// nga la rnam shes rlung bzhon gyi gdams pa yod// 'di mdo phrug phal gyis do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// la kha la bya la shin tu grang lags kyang*// nga la gtum mo me 'bar gyi gdams ngag yod// 'di snal gos phal gyis do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// bal po shin tu tshad pa che lags kyang*// nga la 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag yod// 'di bzang drug phal gyis do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// chu bo gaṅga chu ru che lags kyang*// nga la rnam shes mkha' lding gi gdams ngag yod// 'di gru gzings phal gyis do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// rgya gar mtha' 'khob mu ge che lags kyang*// nga la dka' thub chu 'thung gi gdams ngag yod// 'di bza' btung phal gyis do zla min/ las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// lam bar dang yul phran 'jigs pa che lags kyang*// nga la ma mo jag chings kyi gdams ngag yod// 'di zla skyel phal gyis do zla min/ las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro /bla ma nā ro dang mai tri yang rgya gar na bzhugs// dpal zhi ba bzang po yang rgya gar na bzhugs// rten ma hā bo Zི yang rgya gar na bzhugs/

nga las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la babs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// zhes gsungs shing thag chod pa'i tshe/ sngar 'bul sdud las byung ba'i gser dang*/ slob ma rnams kyi 'bul ba thams cad gser du bsgril bas/ gser dkar yol gang byung ba bsnams te/ gzhan phyag phyi la gtong ba'i zhu ba phul yang ma gnang bar gcig pu rgya gar la byon no// lta ba thugs la 'khrungs tshul gyi mgur/ ༈ lta ba bzang po phyin ci ma log pa 'khrungs pa'i rtags yin pas/ lta ba mthar phyin pa gzhung gi tshig la ma brten par khyed rang gi thugs la 'khrungs pa'i mgur zhig gsung 'tshal zhus pa la 'di gsungs so// 'dren pa'i bla ma dam pa dang*// ha du dkar pos dbu mdzad pa'i// khyod mdo sngags kyi slob gnyer tshang ba rnams// yud tsam zhig bod kyi glu la nyon// mthar thug gi lta ba khyad par can// zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin// thabs shes ya bral 'dod pa gang*// mtha' ru lhung bas dgag bya'i phyir// khyed mkhyen pa'i drung du brjod dka' yang*// dbyangs sngon chad ma blangs sdug par 'gro// bstan bcos dbyangs su blang gi gsan// dngos po 'dzin pa dgag bya'i phyir// bdud sde bcom pas med ces gsungs// don de 'dra bzhin du bzung bas bsgribs// 'khor mang yon tan 'byung ba'i dpal// khyad par thabs ni gyur pa spangs// rmongs pa stong pa chad par 'dod// dge tshogs sun 'byin chad pa'i mtha'// nam mkha'i me tog zhen pa rnams// dkar po'i lo tog 'joms pa yi// ser ba log pa'i lta ba yin// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid shes par gyis// stong pa mi shes skyes bu kun// med la yod par sgra yis btags// log pa mig rgyu chu 'dzin cing*// don la rmongs pa 'khor ba'i rgyu// sems tsam mu stegs grangs can sogs// thabs dang shes rab ya bral 'dod// so so rang rang grub mtha' yang*// shing skam me tog 'dod dang mtshungs// khas len thams cad bral ba yi// don de rab tu mi gnas pa'i// rab tu shes pa shes phyin te// mi gnas srid dang zhi ba'i mtha'// snying rje stong pa'i snying po can// thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug

/de ni rang byung lhan cig skyes// de ltar bde dang stong pa dang*// rig pa dang ni stong pa nyid// tha dad med par bdag gis go /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang*// gdod nas rang bzhin stong pa nyid// dbyer med rang bzhin spros bral du// chos rnams de ltar go bar mdzod// lta bas mtshon pa'i tshig tsam du// zhen pa'i yul du bdag gir mdzod// 'jig rten pa yi lta ba de// rgyu 'bras las la yid ches byas// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za// mkhyen pa mchog gis de skad gsungs// mi gang snying rje med pa rnams// til 'bras me yis tshig pa la// de la 'bras bu ga la 'byung*// gzhi med khyad par ga la yod// de la theg chen yod ma yin// mkhyen rab na ga dzu nas gsungs// dmigs yul lta ba ma mchis na// dam chos gnang ba don med yin// sbun pa 'bras bu med dang mtshungs// de skad mar pa lo tsā zer// khyed mkhyen pa'i don la thugs rgyas rnams// don go bar gda' na bzod par gsol// zhes pa gsungs pas/ bla ma bal po pa dang*/ grogs ha du dkar po la sogs pa rnams dgyes par gda'o// gnyos la khrel 'debs kyi mgur/na te// gzhan la dkon pa'i khyad chos dga'// gzhan phan med pas blo ma bde// 'on kyang nan tan zhu dag gis// chos dang rang gi sems rgyud 'dres// tshig don ma brjed wa ler bdog /slar yang rgya gar yul du yong*// paṇa chen nā ro la sogs pa'i// grub thob rnams las zhus pas chog /mi khyed rang deng nas bla ma dang*/ chos bshad lo tsā'i khur bor la// gnong 'gyod dang bcas yul la byon// sdig la mthol bshags drag po gyis// bsam sbyor de 'dra byed bzhin du// bla ma'i rlom sems byas lags kyang*// blun po 'ga' yi mgo skor las// skal ldan smin grol ga la 'byung*// mi lus rin chen rnyed dka' 'dis// ngan song gsum po mi sgrub 'tshal// ces de skad gsungs/

bkra shis byon skyems su phul ba'i mgur/ ༈ rje mar pa lo tsā bas/ dus phyis rting rgya gar nas byon nas bal por gdan phebs dgung zhag 'ga' tsam lon pa dang*/ me 'ja' gling na bla ma mi mnyam rdo rje zhes bya ba/ mnga' bdag mai tri pas bsdus pa'i mched grogs shig bzhugs pa la phyag skyel du byon nas/ khong rang gi grogs po kha che yi lha bzo zhig gis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhig bzhengs nas rab gnas mdzad cing gda' ba la/ de'i tshogs gral du khong rnams na re bla ma lo tsā ba khyed rgya gar du yun ring po bsdad na/ khyed kyi jo bo nā ro pa de sku snyan pa shin tu che bar gda' bas khong gi zhabs drung du ji tsam bsdad/ chos ni gang dang gang mnyan/ nyid rang la khong du chud pa'i gdeng ci yod/ khyed rgya gar nas tshur byon pa'i skyes su'i glu zhig longs dang zer bas/ de'i dus su nā ro pa dang mjal lugs kyi glu 'di gsung pa yin gsungs/ ༈ rje grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// da mos pa'i bu 'di lam sna drongs// lar mi nga la glu long mi rigs te/ khyed mched grogs gong ma'i zhal mi chog /da ni 'chi brod kyi dbyangs zhig len/ khyed gdan gang gi thugs la 'di bzhes la// chos tshul bzhin nyams su bzhes par zhu// nga bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā dang*// rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen gnyis// ljongs me tog brgyan pa'i grong khyer dang*// ri bo gser gyi dgon par mjal// de tshe rabs kyi smon lam dag pa 'dra// gnas byin rlabs can du grags pa der// sku snyan pa can gyi rje btsun la// lo drug zla ba bdun du bsten// dbang yongs su rdzogs par lan bdun zhus// dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i byin rlabs mdzad// rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje zhus// yi dam lhan skyes jo mo gnang*// gdams ngag bskor tshe bskor tshe zhus// lam rtsa dang rlung la sbar nga mjal bar nges// da ni 'chi yang nga re brod/

khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi jo bo sngags pa rnams// don snyan brgyud kyi ngo sprod mi mnga' bar// bshad rgyud tshig gi tha snyad la// tshe gcig sangs rgyas ma re mdzod// lar snying nas dam chos mdzad dgongs na// rje nā ro dang mai tri'i brgyud pa bzung*// bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// bde+i lta bu mthong*/ gdams pa'i gtso bo rang gang kho na zhus/ zhes 'drir byung ba la/ yang mgur 'di bzhengs pa/ rje bram ze'i brgyud pa'i gdung 'tshob cing*// mtha' bral gnyug ma'i don rtogs phyir// dpe med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// mtshan mai tri zhes byar yongs su grags// pha rje btsun de'i bka' srol 'dzin// lam 'bral med sgom pa bco brgyad bzhugs/ khyad par grub thob zhal lnga bzhugs// rje 'gran gyi do med rnam gnyis bzhugs// gtso bo paṇa chen nā ro pa// de 'og rgyal sras mai tri pa/ khong lhag par ma bas brtse ba'i phyir// nga yang yang sems la 'phreng nas kyang*// shar chu bo gaṅga'i 'gram du phyin// ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod du// shing ‚ gro ta'i bsil grib la// rje mnga' bdag chen po bzhugs pa mthong*// sa dang po lta bu'i dga' ba skyes// mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i mchod pa bsham// bla ma mnyes pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul// gu rang gser gyi me tog bkod// lus kyis thal sbyar rkyang phyag 'tshal// sems rtse gcig gdung ba'i gsol ba btab// rgyud zab mo bstod pa glur blangs thos// yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje zhus// don mthar thug phyag rgya chen po zhus// dpal gnyis med a ba ZÓ ti ba// pha rje btsun de'i thugs rjes gzigs// nang zab mo brda'i dbang bzhi bskur// rgyud yongs su dag pa'i byin rlabs zhugs// gzhi 'dun pa'i sa bon gting nas g.yos// nang rig pa sems kyi 'dug tshul de// 'od gsal skye 'gag med pa'i phyir// gzhi ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bor bstan// glo bur gyi rnam rtog dbyings su thim// zag med kyi bde chen nang du shar// gdod nas dag pa'i de bzhin nyid// gzhi la sku gsum gtan la phab// sems chos nyid ma dang zhal yang mjal// dus da res ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas// sgron shing mar me mdzub gang la// zhag bdun bar du snang ba byung*// bem por gyur pa'i ljon shing gis// rab tu ma bzod g.yo 'gul byas// /lar mi nga rang ngan te bla ma bzang*// chos lta ba'i yang rtse phu thag chod// lam grub mtha' dman gyi dogs ma mchis// rje mai tri pa dang mjal lugs yin// dam pa'i thugs dgyes de la mdzod// zhes rje btsun mar pa lho brag pas bla ma mi mnyam rdo rjes dbu mdzad pa'i mched grogs rnal 'byor pa rnams la/

bkra shis byon skyems su phul ba'i mgur gnyis pa lags so// bla ma pen ta ba dang dris pa dad lan gyi mgur/ ༈ rje btsun gyi zhal nas kyang brgyud pa 'di rang gi srol 'dzin cing*/ nyams su len nges pa'i sgom chen gcig gam gnyis las ma gtogs pa gzhan la spel na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung*/ chos la ser sna byed pa ma yin te/ snod dang mi ldan pas thos nas rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'phog dus deng sang gi skye bo phrag dog che bas co 'dri zhing sgro skur 'deb/ sdig gsog tu 'ong bas/ yi ge la shin tu dam par bgyi 'tshal lo gsungs so// ༈ rje lho brag pa bal yul rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang gi brang khang zhig na bla ma pen ta ba la ral gcig ma'i rtogs pa dang*/ bdud rtsi 'od kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ rdzogs rim kha 'thor 'ga' gsan cing bzhugs pa la/ nub gcig gi mtshan lam la rje mnga' bdag mai tri pa seṅge la bcibs nas/ nam mkha' la gshegs pa rmis/ pha rje btsun thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes 'o dod bos pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas/ nam mkha' mtshon pa'i brda bstan/ dpe dang bral ba'i chos gsungs/ mtha' las 'das pa'i don rtogs/ sngar ma skyes pa'i nyams la shar ba rmis nas der rnal sad tsa na nam langs nas 'dug pa la/ bla ma dran nas mang du bshum/ de'i phyi de nub mo bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i mchod chung zhig bshams nas/ de'i tshogs gral du mtshan ltas bzang po'i mgur 'di bzhengs pa yin gsung ngo*// ༈ rje snying po'i don rtogs chos kyi sku// mtshan yongs su grags pa mai tri ba'i/ khong bsam gyin sku drin che ba'i phyir/ kho bo'i yid la shin tu bcags// nga rtse gcig gdung ba rgyun mi gcod// pha byin gyis rlobs shig sprul pa'i sku/ khyed 'dren pa'i bla ma sku drin can// dpal pan ta ba yis dbu mdzad nas/ khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi rnal 'byor pho mo rnams// glu 'di la dar cig snyan gsan 'tshal// nga mar ston chos kyi blo gros 'dis// tshe sum gnyis rgya gar yul du bskyal// lo bzhi bcu'i bar du thos bsam byas// dus na ning gdug pa sbrul gyi lo// cho 'phrul rta'i zla ba la// mi kho bo lam du zhugs nas mchis// chu 'jigs su rung ba'i gaṅgal// dpal dur khrod ra ma

Zda cig /phyag g.yas pa brkyang mdzad sor mo rnams// mi kho bo'i mgo la reg mdzad de/ khyod rgya gar yul du ma ldog par// bod yul dbus su song zhig gsungs// ljongs kha ba can du ma phyin bar// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// gdul bya snod ldan yod do zhes// lung bstan byin gyis brlabs par mdzad/ de zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro yin par nges// de yang rje btsun khyed kyi drin// mdang bag chags gnyid kyi rmi lam na// mnga' bdag rgyal sras mai tri ba// seṅge zhon nas mkha' la gshegs// mi kho bo'i mdun du byon pa rmis// skye med mtshon pa'i brda gsum bstan// yi ge med pa'i chos shig gsungs// brjod du med pa'i don cig rtogs// sngon chad med pa'i nyams shig skyes// da nangs gnyid de sad tsa na// rje yang yang dran no mai tri pa// mi kho bo'i yid la 'bral ma phod// gdong mchi mas gang ba'i ngud mo shor// dbugs kha nas ma thon byang khog brgyangs// pha snying la 'dod de chu bas skom// mi kho bo'i gdung sems mkhyen lags sam// pha lam sna drongs shig sprul pa'i sku// lar rmi lam bag chags yin mod kyang*// mdang rje btsun byon pa thugs la btags// sems dga' la mi dga' mtho dman byung*/ khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi snyan du zhus pa lags/ zhes pa'i mgur bzhengs pa'o// bla ma pen ta bas kho bo'i brod pa skyed cing bla ma'i ngo bo gcig la rang gi mthong tshul la yon tan tha dad 'byung ba dang*/ kho bo'i rmi lam de dag 'dri ba'i phyir lan gsungs pa/ grogs snying dang 'dra ba'i lo tsā ba// bu khyed la dad pa gting nas yod// gzhi rang dbang med pa'i 'dun pa yod/ /yid lhag par brtse ba'i snying rje yod// rgyud yongs su sbyangs pa'i sems bskyed yod// rigs khyad par can gyi skyes bu yod// sngon chad bla ma ma brnyas pas// da lta grub thob dngos dang mjal// de yang grogs po nga yi drin// mi nga la gtsug gi nor bur mthong*// bu byas pa shes pa ngo mtshar che// gsang sngags rgyal po mchog gi lam// bgrod pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// lhag pa'i dam tshig gi khyod la yod// lha dang mkha' 'gros rjes gnang zhing*// bla ma'i man ngag snying la zhugs// dus 'dir bde ba thob par rigs

/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma rje// sprul sku mchog gi rje btsun la// nam mkha' lta bur ngo shes na// skye med stong pa'i don rtogs 'gyur// nyi ma lta bur ngo shes na// bdal ba'i snying rje chen po 'byung*/ zla ba lta bur ngo shes na// nyon mongs gdung ba sel bar byed// rgya mtsho lta bur ngo shes na// mi g.yo mchog gi ting nge 'dzin// nor bu lta bur ngo shes na// dgos 'dod re ba lhun gyis grub// ded dpon lta bur ngo shes na// thar pa'i rin chen gling du sgrol// dmag dpon lta bur ngo shes na// log rtog dgra'i g.yul ngo 'joms// ral gri lta bur ngo shes na// dngos 'dzin 'ching ba gcod par byed// 'khor lo lta bur ngo shes na// mtha' la mi gnas don rtogs 'gyur// seṅgapas// chos kyi rgyal srid rgyun mi 'chad// bu khyod kyi bag chags rmi lam na// rje mnga' bdag chen po byon nas kyang*// skye med mtshon pa'i brda' bstan cing*// yi ge med pa'i chos gsungs te// mtha' las 'das pa'i don rtogs nas// sngar ma skyes pa'i nyams shar ba// de don gang lags smra bar rigs// rje pen ta bas de skad gsungs pas/ིsa dbu mdzad nas// gdan gang gi dpa' bo snyan gsan mdzod// de 'og sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma// lcam su ka badz+rams cad sgyu ma ste// rmi lam sgyu ma khyad par 'phags// nam srod la bag chags kyi rmi lam 'byung*// de la bza' gtad ci yang med// nam gung bdud kyi sprul pa ston// de la yid rton byar mi rung*// nam tho rangs lha yis lung ston pa// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// dgung da nangs skya rengs shar ba la// rje mnga' bdag chen po byon nas kyang*// mthar thug ston pa'i chos gsungs pa// de ma brjed dran pa 'di ltar gda'// chos rnams thams cad sems nyid de// rang sems nyid las bla ma byung*// sems las gud na gzhan med pas// cir snang thams cad sems nyid ngang*// de yang gdod nas ma grub pas// ma skyes gnyug ma'i gnas lugs la// rnam rtog rtsol bas spang du med// ma bcos rang sor lhug par bzhag

/de nyid brda yis mtshon pa'i phyir// mi ro gdol pa khyi dang phag /bu chung smyon pa glang chen dang*/ nor bu rin chen u,ṅge dang*// bram ze khri snyan mthong ngam gsungs// brda yis mtshon pa'i don rtogs pa// 'khor 'das gnyis su mi 'dzin cing*// spang blang rgyud la mi sbyor ba// gzhan nas 'bras bu mi re ba// yid la byar med spros dang bral// mtha' bzhi dag tu lhung ba med// sgom du med cing yengs su med// dran du med cing brjod du med/ gang gis kyang ni mtshon du med// bla ma'i drin gyis de ltar rtogs// don de rtogs pa'i nyams shar ba// sems dang sems byung 'gags pa yin// dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med de// skyon dang yon tan skyed 'bri med// bde stong gsal la ma 'gags pa// bde gsal 'gro 'ong med par shar// gnyug ma ngo sprod lta ba'i gnad// skye med mtshon pa'i brda' don rnams// rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhal nas thos// ngag brjod pa glu ru mi blang rgyu// rje gong nas bka' nan che ba dang*// gdan gang mched grogs kyi zhal ma chog /mkha' 'gro'i ko long mi mdzad zhu// zhes bla ma lo tsā ba des/ rje pen ta ba yis dbu mdzad pa'i mched grogs rnams la yul rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du mnga' bdag me tri pa rmi lam du byon nas phyag rgya chen po'i brda' don bstan pa rnams mgur du bzhengs pa yin gsungs/༈ rje mar pa lo tsā bas mar pa mgo yag dang*/ mi la ma gtogs pa gzhan la gnang ba med/ rje btsun zhal gnyis las/ ngan rdzong ston pa bo Zི ra dzās zhus te dgyes bzhin du gnang ngo*// bla ma lo tsā ba la rje mnga' bdag chen po rmi lam du byon nas phyag rgya chen po'i brda thog babs kyi man ngag yi ge med pa'i ngo sprod 'di la bla ma bzhi yis mtshon te go /grub thob brgyud pa'i bla mas zab mo'i don nyid man ngag gnad kyi ngo sprod la/

dri med bka'i bla mas snying rje'i don gyi lung la yid ches par bstan/ snang ba brda'i bla mas gnyug ma'i don te/ brda thams cad kyis mtshon pa'i go bar gyis/ dag pa rang sems kyi bla mas gzhi gnas lugs rang la yod par ngo shes pa'o// dang po ni mnga' bdag gis nam mkha' mtshon pa'i brda bstan te/ yi ge med pa'i chos gsungs pa ni/ chos rnams thams cad sems nyid de zhes pa'i tshig gis bstan/ gnyis pa ni snying rje don gyi rgyud dpal rnyog pa med pa nas gsungs pa dri med bka'i lung gis yid ches par byas pa ni/ gdod nas ma grub gnyug ma'i sems// ci yang mi rtog phyag rgya che// chos rnams kun gyis ma reg pa/ ma bcos de nyid ngang la zhog /ces gsungs la/ gsum pa ni mi ro gdol pa la sogs pa'i brda bco lngas bstan te/ re shig des mtshon pa tsam du zad kyi/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad gnas lugs brda'i go bar byed pa'o// bzhi pa ni bla ma'i snang ba'i dpe yang*/ rang gi sems las ma gtogs pa gud na med ces gong du gsungs pa'i rang sems nyid las bla ma byung zhes don go bar bya la/ rang grol bzhi'i bla ma dang dngos su mjal ba ni/ 'khor 'das gnyis su mi 'dzin pa la sogs pa rtogs pa'i don bstan pa rnams kyi go bar bya'o*// gsung ngo*// rje mar pa lo tsā ba chen po de la rtogs tshad glu'i bsam gtan dgu zhes bya ba/ rgya gar nas bod tshun chad du gsungs pa yod de/ bla ma la rtogs pa phul ba'i mgur dbyangs ring ta±àṅgan pa la snying po don gyi man ngag do ha rdo rje'i mgur/ lta ba khyung chen gyi gshog rgyangs so// 'di rnams bla ma gzhung pa chen po la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang*/ sku 'bag gi rgyab logs dang*/ gdugs kyi yu ba la gser gyis bris nas yod gsungs/ 'di rnams len pa'i dus kyang dbang bskur dang*/ rab gnas dang tshogs 'khor la sogs pa'i nang ma yin pa gzhan du ma gnang*/

de yang chen po rnams kyi gsung yin pas shin tu gzab dgos/ dang po 'dren bde la skad 'phang ma chag pa zhig dang*/ sdeb mkhas la gnad du skyol zhing brda 'phrod pa zhig dgos/ de yang lus ngag gnyis bcos mar ma song ba ni shin tu yang gces/ de ltar 'di ni rigs kyi bu mdzes shing gsal ba rnams ༈ grub thob rin chen brgyud pa yi/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje mar pa lo tsā ba chen po de bla ma 'brog mi chen po'i zhabs drung na bzhugs pa'i dus na/ lo tsā ba gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs byung nas/ rta nag po seṅge+e srab med dang*/ zab chen yug gcig dang*/ seng ldeng gi sga gcig dang gsum/ stag ris su gser la 'tshong du byon te tshur byon par bzhed nas grogs med par yod pa la/ gtsang gi dgyer phu'i dge bshes klog skya chen po de stag sde mig mangs su slob ma gcig gis chos gra la gdan drangs te/ 'bul ba mang po byung nas de tshur byon pa dang dus mtshungs te lam grogs zhus pas/ dge bshes des thugs gnyer mdzad nas lam du rgyags dang bya na yang gnang skad/ skabs su dre'u la zhabs sor yang mdzad nas dgyer phu bar du lhan cig tu 'grogs nas byon/ der bla ma mar pas jo bo dam tshig yod par gzigs nas/ nga lho bal du lo tsā la 'gro ba yin pas/ da res khyed kyis shin tu thugs la btags/ tshe'i bar chad ma byung na phyis kyang kho bo'i sne len dang 'bab sa bgyid par zhu gsungs pas/ dge bshes na re nga na so rgas pas khyed dang 'phrad de mi 'ong*/ nga'i jo sras 'di dang 'di kun sne len dang bsu skyel byed du gzhug pas/ cis kyang 'dir 'byon par zhu dgos gsungs nas/ gser srang phyed dang*/ re'u snam bub gcig brdzangs bar gda'/ der bla ma mar pas lho bal du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas/ yang rgyags chad de bod du gser 'tshol du byon/ der dge bshes yab ni sku 'das/ jo sras che shos kyis dpal mo rdo 'phreng gi bar bsu ba mdzad nas gtsang gi dgyer phur byon/

sne len bzang po byas/ zla ba phyed chos gra btsugs pa la/ de'i dus su yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa zhig mdzad de/ de'i dus su bla ma la jo sras kyis zhu ba phul/ nged pha spad kyis bla ma sngon chad kyang bsnyen bkur mi chung ba byas/ da yang byed dgos pas sngon chad bzhengs ma myong ba'i mgur cig bzhengs par zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ de'i dus su kho bo khar nyin dpyid ka bal po'i mthi su mjal/ de'i dus su yid la mi byed pa snying po'i don/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas kho bos 'di ltar thos so zhes mgur du bzhengs pa'o//

do ha rdo rje'i mgur/༈ dpal de ring bkra shis yar gyi ngo*// dus khyad par can gyi tshes bcu la// dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshogs gral du// bu 'gyur ba med pa'i dam tshig can/ khyod klog skya ston pas zhu phul ba// rje sngar ma thos pa'i glu long skad// nga bshul ring lam nas gshar ba des// lus ngal dub dbang du thal ba'i phyir// glu yid 'phrog snyan pa cung mi mchis// tshig sdeb sbyor mkhas pa mi 'tshal yang*// bu khyed las ngo che med pa'i phyir// zhu chen gyi dpral ba mi zlog pas// don sngar ma thos pa'i ngo mtshar can// rje bram ze'i bzhed dgongs glu len gyis/ khyed gdan gang bzhugs kyi mdo sngags rnams/ snyan lhan ne gson la thugs dgongs 'tshal// dus khar nyin dpyid zla tha chung la// gzhi bal po'i mthil nas yar 'das pa// gdugs dro lam mchis pa'i shul ka na// bal po gling gi sho ka ri// mtha' gdol pa can gyi grong khyer du// mi brda mi 'jal gyi sho gam pas// 'gron kha nyen po'i bod rnams bskyil// mi ngas kyang dbang med zhag lnga bsdad// dgung nub gcig tham thum rmi lam na// rigs kyi mtshan ldan tshangs skud can// bram ze'i bu mo mdzes ma gnyis/ /cung zad 'dzum zhing zur mig lta// mi kho bos drung du 'ongs nas kyang*// lho dpal gyi ri la 'gro dgos skad/ kho bo sngon chad phyin ma myong*// rgyus med lam yang mi shes smras// bu mo gnyis kyi mched na re// ming pos dka' ba mi dgos so// nged kyi 'phrag la khur ro zer// do li dar gyi lding khri der// gdugs bzhin mkha' la btegs nas kyang*// glog 'gyu skad cig yud tsam gyis// lho dpal gyi ri la phyin pa rmis// shing blag sha ljon pa'i bsil grib la// sti ra ro'i gdan steng na// bram ze chen po sa ra ha// zhal sngar ma mthong ba'i gzi mdangs can// btsun mo gnyis kyis sku brten cing*// sku la dur khrodabo'i bzhag tsam gyis// zag med bde bas ra ro ba// glang chen chang gis myos pa bzhin// lus g.yo 'gul mi shes nyams shig skyes// ngag la gsung gis byin brlabs pas// stong nyid seṅge'i nga ro yis// yi ge bzhi'i don gsungs pa// lkugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin// ngag smrar mi btub pa'i nyams shig shar// yid la thugs kyis byin brlabs pas// lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// 'gro 'ong med pa'i don rtogs pas// dur khrod nyal ba'i mi ro ltar// bsam du med pa'i don cig rtogs// de rjes bde chen dag pa'i gsung*// rin chen mgul gyi bum pa nas// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi brda skad kyis// dpe bral nam mkha' stong pa'i don// gnas lugs mtshon pa rdo rje'i glu// skye med rang sgra 'di ltar thos// na moḥstong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// rgyun mi 'chad pa gnyug ma'i sems// gdod nas dag pa de bzhin nyid// nam mkhas nam mkha' sbyor ba mthong*// rtsa ba khyim la gnas pa'i phyir// yid kyi rnam shes btson du bzung*// sgom pa'i shes pa phyi ma yis/

sems la lhan pa gdab tu med// snang srid sems kyi rang bzhin zhes// gnyen po gsar pa bsgom du med/ sems kyi gnas lugs dran du med// der snang ba ma bcos ngang la bzhag /de don mthong na ngang la bzhag de don maṅge ltar// bung ba me tog rgyu la ltos// sems kyi glang po yan du chug /'khor bar skyon du mi lta zhing*// mya ngan 'das la mi re ba// tha mal shes pa rang lugs de// ma bcos so ma nyid du zhog /bya ba rnams la dpyod ma rtog /phyogs dang cha la mi gnas pa// spros bral nam mkha'i dkyil du ltos// chos zad sar skyol ba snying po'i don/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong yang*// phyin chad dri rgyu med do snyam// sems phu thag chod pa'i nyams shig skyes// yid 'gyu ba zad pa ngo mtshar che// lar yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang*// rje bla mas lung bstan zab mo'i don// smra ru mi btub gsang na yang*// dgung do nub mi blang thabs ma byung*// dus da res tsam las ma gtogs pa// sngon chad ngag tu brjod ma myong*// phyis kyang zlos sam rna bas nyon// nga sngon chad bshul ring rgyang gi mi// mdza' bshes gnyen med grogs kyang med// ngal dub bkres par gyur pa'i tshe// bu khyod kyis ci byas yid la yod// de brjed du ma btub yid la bcags// drin 'khor bar thal lo snying gi grogs// glu 'di la mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs chags// rje gong na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// bar chad bsrung ba'i zhing skyong rnams// mi spun la bka' bkyon mi gsung 'tshal// ces pa rje mar pa lo tsā ba rmi lam du lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la byon nas bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang mjal te/ sems gnad du bsnun pa'i snying po'i don gyi gdams ngag Zོ ha rdo rje'i mgur gsan pa de rnams lags skad/ rje mar pa las/ mar pa mgo yag gis maṇ+ḍal yang yang phul nas zhus pa/ rmi lam lung bstan gyi mgur/ bla ma mgo yag la lcim lung gi ngan rdzong ras pas zhus pa'o//

ngo mtshar che rgu'i mgur/ ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ bla ma mar pa chen po des rgya gar yul du lan gsum/ bal po mthil du lan gsum ste drug byon pa las/ dang po 'brog mi myu gu lung pa'i sar lo gcig khyud bskor du lo tsā bslab/ der khong zhal tsha ba dang*/ bka' dog pa gnyis 'dzom ste/ ha cang sdod snying ma 'dod nas lho bal du sems btegs/ gser srang bcaṇ+ḍi ta ye shes snying po dang*/ dpal ku su lu pa dang*/ rje pen ta ba sku mched la pha rgyud kri ya mang du mnyan/ pha rgyud kyi sgrub yig dang gdams ngag sha stag gsan nas/ lo lnga na rgyags chad de tshur byon pas/ bal yul du gser skyel ba dang 'phrad nas yang phar log ste+e byon pas/ bla ma rnams la srang dang*/ zho shas kyi maṇ+ḍal phul bas/ rje pen ta ba na re khyod la dam tshig yod par 'dug pas nga'i bla ma las ma rgyud nyon cig gsungs nas/ pu a ha rir bskyal/ jo bo nā ro pa dang mjal/ de'i res la dpal na ro dang*/ mai tris dbu mdzad pas bla ma dgu dang mjal/ slob gnyer gyi gtso bo ma rgyud la byas/ lo bdun bzhugs/ dril bas snga res lo lnga/ phyis lo bdun te bcu gnyis bzhugs nas/ yang rgyags zad de bal por blta nyul la byon nas/ rgyags bskyal med de bod du zangs kyis phyin/ la stod gtsang gi dgyer phur klog skya ston pa zhig gis sne len byas nas chos zhus/ de nas dbu ru byang phyogs su byon/ byang nam ra'i gser brdol ba dang kha thug ste/ 'phan yul du mar pa mgo yag gis gser srang bcu gnyis phul nas dbang bskur zhus pa la/ sha mar/ gos snam tshun chad rtsis mig tu bcug pas/ gser srang bzhi bcu'i zhabs tog byas/ gzhan yang sgrub yig kha yar gyis gser mang po rnyed de/ lo gsum lon nas yang rgya gar du byon nas/ dpal rdo rje gdan rten khyad par can rnams la mchod pa rgyas par byas/ sku drin che chung gi bla ma thams cad thugs mnyes pa'i bsnyen bkur byas/

rje 'gran gyi do med nā ro pa dang*/ mai tri pa gnyis/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa lnga yis khyad par du yang thugs la btags/ dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa thams cad rdzogs par gnang ngo*// bar du skal ba dang ldan pa'i stobs kyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis bsten pa yin no// de lta bu'i rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ rje lo tsā ba mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i mar pa chos kyi blo gros des rgya gar du lo bcu dgu bzhugs te/ nangs kyi tha ma bod du byon pa'i dus su mar pa mgo yag gis/ bla ma sku tshe'i bar chod byung ngam ma byung dang*/ bod du 'byon nam mi 'byon gyi gtam 'dri ba la bal po thug par 'gro snyam nas 'ongs pas/ bla ma dang mang yul gyi grong gi ma zad du mjal/ der bla ma'i zhabs tog mdzad cing 'grogs nas byon pas/ myang stod bzhengs kyi mkhar kong dkar po bya ba na/ mar pa mgo yag gis mes po phyug po zhig yod pas sne len byas nas zla ba gcig chos gsung zhing bzhugs/ de nas dbus su zangs kyi gshegs khar bla ma rgya gar nas sku ma nongs par byon pa'i gtang rag tu tshogs kyi mchod pa zhig btang nas/ de'i dus su zhus pa bla ma lags/ bla ma'i rje btsun chen po nā ro pa de dang da res zhal legs par mjal lam/ thugs mnyes par thal lam/ sngar dang da res gnyis la gdams ngag gi lhag lus sam/ khyad par ci gda' zhus pas/ yang bla ma lo tsā bas rje nā ro pa dang mjal lugs dang*/ gdams ngag lhag lus med par ci ltar gnang lugs rnams mgur du bzhengs pa/ ༈ sprul sku'i bzhugs gnas rgya gar yul// ljongs yangs pa can gyi ma gha tar// mu stegs rgol ba tshar gcod cing*// sgo srung chen por mnga' gsol ba// dpal nā ro zhes byar grags pa yi// rje sprul sku de'i zhabs la 'dud// shar khri sgo brtsegs pa'i pho brang na// mi nga rang lta rtogs byed pa'i tshe// sems gcig ma bde yid gcig 'phyos// dpal chen nā ro tur gyis dran// gdung ba'i sems la bzod thabs med// bas mtha'i nags la tshol du phyin// rgyus med rigs ngan grong du zhugs// rgyal po dregs pas btson du bzung*// zhag gsum rgyal po'i mchod gnas byas// 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg thab khung nas// ci 'dod bza' btung byung ba mthong*// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// yang gcig bskyar nas tshol du phyin// 'bras dkar mo bre gsumagyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu rnams// cung zad ma reg reg la khad// 'ja' yi gur phub lta bur mthong*// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// ma lhan cig skyes pa'i thugs ka nas// aW sngags kyi 'khor lo de// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// phyi lus kyis ma sgrib gsal bar mthong*// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// shin tu sra mkhregs rdo rje'i brag

/mkhar sgong shel gyi pha bong la// rje nā ro gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes de// spu shad ri mo rdzogs par mthong*// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// da ni ring por mod// lus btsun mo lta bur sku la 'khyud// snying la snying sprad dpral bar gtugs// dus der dbang rdzogs sems la bskur// chos rdzogs thugs kyi nying khu phyung*// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// rtogs pa nang gi nyams shar ba// nyon mongs ye shes gcig tu 'dres// rnam rtog rba rlabs dbyings su nub// yid 'gyu ba sems kyi phu thadus su// rin chen gser gyi yol mo bkang*// gtam grags su rung ba ngo mtshar che/ khyod gtong ba phangs sems med pa'i phyir// lus gos dang lham gyis mjug bsdus nas// ci 'dod thams cad rdzongs su btab// tshe phyi ma'i rgyags phye gter du sbas// de phyi phyir bsam zhing ngo mtshar che// bu pha bas lhag pa'i gdung sems can/ khyod mar pa mgo yag ma yin nam/ nor sgyu ma gtong ba smos ci dgos// srog phangs pa med pa khyod kyi lugs// yong ngo mtshar 'di bas che ba med// dus da res gdong nas bsu ba de// lam bshul thag ring ba rnams kyang bden// lho kha nag bal bod gnyis kyi mtshams/ dgun lo gsar sgang la me tog skye// 'bras dkar sa lu 'deb pa'i sa// bod skad rigs mi gcig gi yul khams su// nad brda' mi 'jal gyi tshad pa la// shi chad kyi 'ami sgrog gsang bar zhu// drin lan gyi chos skyes da gzod gter// snying gtam yod de khad kyis bzla// 'o skol sngon la 'phrad pa grogs kyi mchog /da ma shi bar du 'grogs par bya// zhes dpal nā ro pa chen po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i mthong ltas ngo mtshar can rnams/ sras kyi thu bor gyur pa mar pa mgo yag la byas pa'i drin lan gsab pa'i mgur du bzhengs nas/ dpal na ro pa'i thugs dam paV dmar po'i 'phreng ba brgya rtsa gcig dang*/

mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i phyag sor gyi rdo rje'i 'gu ya zung gcig nang nas/ bu khyod nga la byas pa che ba yin pas/ nga ma shi bar du lhan cig tu sdod dgos/ tshe phyi ma la mi mjal ba'i thabs med du smon lam gdab/ dam tshig gi gnad kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'o skol pha spad skye gnas mtshungs nas mchi/ yang rten 'brel dag pa'i stobs kyis sbyangs pa sngon ma'i las sad nas 'ong bas/ de'i dus su lam bskyed rdzogs kyi bstan pa mthar phyung ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par gsungs/ der mar pa mgo yag gis kyang bla ma'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs te lho brag tu yar byon nas/ bla ma ma 'das kyi bar du nyin gcig kyang ma bral bar bsten pa lags skad/ lar bla ma lo tsā ba chen po des ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dang*/ dpa' bo rnams la gsang sngags rjes su bstan pa'i gnang ba thob/ chu'i bum pa dang*/ shing thog kha bye ba'i nang nas thugs dam gyi dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs/ nang du 'od gsal gyi rtsal sbyong zhing rnam shes 'pho ba dang*/ grong 'jug la sogs pa mthar phyin pa'i ོda pa'i 'og min gyi gnas su gshegs so// rje mar pa'i mgur 'di rnams bla ma mi la dang*/ mar pa mgo yag gnyis ma yin pa gzhan la gnang ba med do// rje btsun zhal gnyis la dge bsnyen bo Zི rā dza'i zhabs kyi paV la yun ring du bsten cing*/ thugs yongs su mnyes par byas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la maṇ+ḍal phul/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma btang*/ tshul bzhin du zhus shing*/ bla mas kyang dgyes bzhin du gnang ba ma lags pa/ kho bos rang dgar bris pa cung zad tsam yang med do// /nga lho brag mar pa blo gros 'di// lo bcu gsum lon nas chos dang 'phrad// de sngon sbyang gi bag chags sad pa 'dra// dang po yi ge ka kha bslab// bar du sgra sgyur lo tsā bslab// tha ma lho bal rgya la phyin// lo gsum bal po'i mthil du bsdad// pha byin rlabs can gyi bal po la// rgyud gnyan par grags pa'i gdan bzhi mnyan// 'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams ngag thob// chos skyong dud sol gyi lha mo zhus/

kho bo des kyang 'dod pa cung ma tshims// yul rgya gar dbus su chos la phyin// chu mi zan dug gi chu la rgal// lus dug sbrul bzhin du pags pa brjes// srog 'dor bar phod de chos la bsam// nub du la khe tra'i grong khyer du// dpal ye shes snying po'i zhabs la gtugs// pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa mnyan// lam rim pa lnga'i don la bslab// sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag thob// lho dug mtsho khol ma'i gling du phyin// dus nyi ma gung la smag tu sros// lam da ci gsal ba da lta stor// srog yal bar dor nas rje btsun btsal// dpal zhi ba bzang po dngos dang mjal// ma rgyud ma hā ma ya thos/ /dbyibs rnal 'byor gsum gyi don la bslab// rgyu ma gsum gyi gdams ngag thob// shar dngos grub kyi chu bo gang gā brgal// ri rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod dang*// me tog mdangs 'phrog dgon pa ru// rje gang gā mai tri'i zhabs la gtugs// rgyud zab mo ston pa glur blangs thos// chos phyag rgya che la rtogs pa sbyangs// sems dngos po'i bzhugs tshul gtan la phab// gzhi ma bcos don gyi ngo bo mthong*// gnas ngo mtshar mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i// byang phyogs pua ha rir phyin// dpal dngos sgrub can gyi dgon pa ru// sgo srung nā ro paṇa chen la// rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje thos// bsre 'pho mtshams sbyor gyi gdams ngag thob/ khyad par gtum mo'i las rgya zhus// snyan brgyud kyi gnad la ngo sprod byas// de yan chad 'dzam gling dbus su grags// phyogs bzhir brgyud pa'i chu bo yin/ /lar dur khrod nyul ba'i rnal 'byor dang*// shing drung gnas pa'i ku sā li// yongs su ma grags 'ga' yod do// rdzogs rim kha 'thor mang du zhus// ngo mtshar can gyi sgrub thabs dang*// phran tshegs kyi gdams ngag rtsis las 'das// lam bal po'i mthil du phyin tsa na// nga lho brag gi mar pa lo tsā dang*/

kha rag gnyos kyi lo tsā gnyis// lo tsā gang mkhas gang mkhas zer// gdams ngag gang che gang che zer// yar bal bod mtshams su thon tsa na// nor zang zing gi sku bsod khong la skyes// la stod tsho bzhir phyin tsa na// sgra sgyur gyi grags pa mnyam por thob// bod dbus gtsang gi mthil du phebs tsa na// gdams ngag gi snyan pa kho bos thob/ /bla ma grub thob dang mjal lags pas// gdams ngag la mi che'i dogs ma mchis// bdag tha snyad la byang chub mi re bas// gzhung bshad kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// la myu gu lung gi dgon pa ru// sgra sgyur 'brog mi'i lo tsā la// sgra thang log skad kyi yig tshad bslab/ khong sku drin mi chung che bar khums// slob gnyer lho bal phyogs su bgyis// bdag bal yul gyi lam du zhugs tsa na// gcan 'phrang dang chu la brgal dus med// nags 'thug po gcig la thon dus med// lam ring po gcig la bgrodabo de nas rgya gar du 'gro tsa na// mtha' 'khob kyi jag pa shi skyid la// srog ci bder thon pa cung ma bsam// gcan gzan gyi ngar skad thos tsa na// lus gtsang sar thon pa yid la med// sbrul chen gyi kha rlangs mthong tsa na// yid brtan por phyin yang goms tshugs 'khyor// lam de kun gyi tsha grang bshad tsa na// dus da lta dran yang glo snying 'dar// chu grags pa can gyi gaṅgin no snyam// chos yid la bsam yang snying rlung 'phyo// nad 'tsho bar dka' ba'i tshad pas theb// lar de'u shi de'u chad bcu gsum byas/ kha chems tshig gsum bzhag pa med// dbugs rgyu ba chad pa lan gsum byas// dus de'i skyid sdug mthong tsa na// sdang dgra'i mig na mchi ma 'chor// 'on kyang srog phod byas rin chog /rje nā ro chen*// zhabs la 'khor lo'i rgyan gyis brgyan// rgya gar bgrod pa de tsug lugs// bla ma sku sun ma bton pas// mkha' 'gro dbyings nas dgyes pa yis// bar chad med pa de tsug lags// theg pa che la blo bzhag nas// 'gro ba yongs la sems bskyed byas// bod du phan pa de tsug lags// nā ro dang mai tri thar lam gsum// 'di gsum rtsa ba'i bla ma yin// gdams ngag che ba de tsug lags// glog ston mgo yag mes rngog bzhi// snying dang 'dra ba'i bu bzhi yin// bstan pa dar ba de tsug lags// tshul dang mthun par bsgoms pa de// mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan lags// gdams ngag sprug pa de tsug lags/
rje mar pa'i mgur ro//

sras la bka' non gyi mgur/ ngag zab pa de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// ngas sngon bla ma thugs sun ma phyung pas// mkha' 'gro mnyes phyir bu bzhin skyong*// rkyen ngan bar chad med pa de ltar lags// ngas chos theg pa che la blo sbyangs pas// sems bskyed kyis 'gro ba yongs la khyab// dam chos bod du dar ba de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// ngas sngon bla ma bsu skyel byas pa yis// rkang pa 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan// yul rgya gar 'khor ba de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// ngas rgyud dang rgyud 'grel man ngag gsum// tshig don ma nor mkhas par bslabs// bstan pa dar ba de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// mes rngog tshur ston mgo legs bzhi// snying dang 'dra ba'i bu bzhi yin// rgyud 'grel 'chad pa de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// bla mas ci gsungs bsgrubs pa de// mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan yin// gdams ngag ster ba de ltar lags// bu gsan dang jo sras mdo sde 'bum// pha jo nga na so rgas nas gda'// chos nyid kyang zad sar 'khyol nas gda'// mdo sde'i dus la bab gda' bas// che mkhas kyis bstan pa spel mdzod cig /mi rgan gyi bsam pa 'grub pa lags// zhes gsungs pas/ kun rje mar pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes so// de nas rab gnas dang bkra shis mdzad tshe/ yang rje btsun mar pas bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// jo sras mdo sde la 'pho ba gdab pa'i mgur/ ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ jo sras mdo sde'i dbu rtas drud nas tshal pa gsum du song*/ grongs la khad pa dang*/ yab yum gnyis po byon nas gdams ngag ma lus pa ni gong du bstan/ da thugs la gsal lam mi gsal/ 'pho ba gdab dgos sam dgongs nas mgur 'di bzhengs pa// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/

kho bo mar pa lo tsā 'dis/ rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyin// mtshan ldan bla ma gus pas bsten/ khyad par nā ro mai tri la// rgyud 'grel gdams pa mang du zhus// dbang bzhi'i don la phyag mdzub btsugs// mthar thug nā ro'i thabs lam zhus/ khyad chos bsre 'pho'i gdams ngag zhus// rje nā ro paṇa chen gyi bka' stsal thob// ma bsgom sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i gnad// ma gsang bu la gong du bshad// bu thugs la dran nam rigs kyi bu// 'dus byas ི'i mtshan nyid ni// mi rtag 'jig par gyur na yang*// bu sgyu ma'i lus pos rtag ma thub// klad pa dung khang 'khor lo chag /klad rgya dar dkar yol ba ral// bu 'di nas pha rol 'gro ba la// gdams pa dran nam mdo sde ba/ kho bo mar pa lo tsā 'di// sems skye med spros bral phyag rgya che// phung po khams dang skye mched rnams// lha dang lha mo'i rnam par gsal// pha jo lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yin// bu sgyu lus 'jog pa bden na yang*/ da res pha jo'i thugs kar 'phos/ de skad gsung pa dang*/ yum gyis ma snying thag nye ba yin pas nga la 'phos nas sla ste 'ong snyam nas mgur 'di bzhengs pa/ ༈ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mchog gi sprul pa rin po che/ skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā ba'i// zhal la sgo gsum gus pas 'dud// bu gson dang dar ma mdo sde ba// yab kyis gong gi bka' stsal pa// mi rtag pha rol bzhud do skad// 'dus byas phung po 'jig pa la// thugs khral che ba shin tu bden// pha jos bstan pa'i gdams ngag dang*// gdams pa ma lus 'di rnams la// dus da lta thugs la gsal mi gsal// nā ro paṇa chen chos drug la// dus da lta gdeng dang ldan mi ldan/ khyad chos bsre 'pho'i gdams ngag la// dus da lta nges shes skyes ma skyes// gzhi skye med phyag rgya chen po la// dus da lta mnyam bzhag brtan mi brtan// bu pha rol bzhud pa'i dus 'di ru// rje mar pa lo tsā'i bka' drin gyis// ma nga rang lha mo bdag med ma// dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum// snying pa

V 'dab bzhi seṅga'i khri// nyi zla paV'i gdan steng na// sangs rgyas mar pa lo tsā bzhugs// bu rnam shes tshangs pa'i mthong nas thon// da res a ma'i thugs kar 'phos/ de skad ces gsungs pa dang*// 'chi ba la nyams nga bag tsha ma mchis te/ yab yum gnyis drin lan ma 'khor ba la shin tu 'phreng gsung nas mgur 'di bzhengs pa/ ༈ rje sum ldan gyi bla ma rin po che// dpal rdo rje 'chang dang zhal dngos mnyam// mtshan ldan mar pa lo tsā dang*// yum bdag med ma la skyabs su mchi// nga 'di nas pha rol 'gro ba la// nyams nga bag tsha ma mchis te// yab dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang*// yum sangs rgyas bskyed byed bdag med ma// drin lan ma 'khor 'chi ba de// cung zad sems la 'phreng bas kyang*// 'on kyang mi phan 'chi ba la// pha chos bstan pa'i gdams ngag dang*// rgyud 'grel gdams pa sems la gsal// phung po khams dang skye mched rnams// lha dang lha mo'i rnam par gsal// bsre 'pho'i gdams ngag mi 'tshal bas// yab yum thugs khral bya mi 'tshal// nang rig pa spros bral nam mkha'i klong*// 'pho bya 'pho byed rten dang bral// rnam shes gyen la 'phang mi 'a khyad 'phags gnas su yab yum dang*// gtan du 'dzoms pa'i smon lam 'tshal// de skad gsungs nas grongs pa dang*/ thams cad mya ngan shin tu che nas ngu mchong las med/ rje btsun yang thugs mug par byung ba la gcig gis zhus pa/ thams cad sgyu ma yin gsungs ba la 'di yang sgyu ma min nam zhus pas/ da lan gyi sgyu ma 'di sgyu rgod byung gsungs/ rje mar pas dgung lo mang po ni lon/ sras jo sras mdo sde dbu chag nas grongs pa'i dus su thugs la bsam pa'i/ thugs 'od gsal gyi ngang du lam me 'dug ste snang ba 'di sgyu ma yin pa la/ bu 'di rang yang sgyu ma yin pa la yong bsam nas mgur bzhengs pa yin gsungs/ bu gces par gsos pa'i mdo sde de// bla ma bas bka' drin che bar byung*// bu rtag pa'i dngos por ma grub ste// sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du go lags pas// lam 'od gsal gyi ngang du yal nas thal// dka' ba byas pa'i mdo rgyud de// rang mos pa'i rten du bzhugs snyam yang*// bu sgyu ma'i dngos pos rtag ma thub// nor rdzas la dgos ched ma mchis pas// ser sna la skye rgyu ma rnyed do// sha khrag gis 'brel pa'i bu tsha de// sems la mtshon cha bas gzan pa zhig byung*// gnyen chos sku 'od gsal du rtogs pa des// brtse gdung la bya sa ma rnyed do// zhe sdang gsog pa'i dgra sdang de// bu mdo sde bas snying du sdug pa zhig byung*// dgra dang bu la nye ring ma rnyed pas// zhe sdang la gsog sa ma rnyed do// dka' ba byas pa'i rgyud sde bzhi// thugs las byung ba'i man ngag gnad// sgra thang log skad kyi yig tshad rnams/

lam 'odas// pha yul la dgos pa mi gda'o// chos rnams rang bzhin spros bral la// mthar thug gi 'brel pa gang yang med// gnas skabs kyi 'brel pa zad nas gda'// ིra yun ring bskyangs pa'i sgom chen tsho// tshe 'di la mngon zhen ma che mdzod// bu dar ma bsam gtan gyis sna drangs pa'i// lhag ma lus pa'i bu drug la// chags zhen ma skye sgyu ma 'dra// dus gtan du 'grogs pa'i jo mo gnyis// 'dzin chags ma byung bdag med ma// pha spun nye drung mar tsho la// dgos che na ma byung na bun 'dra// na bun 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim// da ni mar chung yang na so zad nas gda'// chos nyid kyang zad sar skyol nas gda'/ ces rje mar pa'i jo sras mdo sde grongs pa'i dus kyi mgur ro// ༈ mya ngan sangs byed kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos bshad cing go ba'i shes rab ma// bdag med ma la gros shig 'debs// tha mal dang ma bsres dran pa bsten// nges shes bskyed la mya ngan spongs// bu gces par bskyangs pa'i mdo sde 'bum// 'od gsal dbyings su gshegs pa de// rje dang bka' drin mnyam pa byung*// dran 'dun sgyu ma'i gsal thebs phyir// mya ngan la bya yul mi 'dug cing*/ sems can la nye ring mi 'dug pas// 'gro kun brtse bas skyongs shig bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// gser las bzhengs pa'i mdo mang sogs// sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchod rnams// bu mdo sde'i don du bzhengs lab dgu 'dus pa'i snying po dang*// sgra thang klog skad kyi lo tsā rnams// bu mdo sde'i don du bslab lags kyang*// mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs// chos bdag med gteragyi kha byang 'dra// chos mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa des// kun la ster ro bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// ser snas bsags pa'i zas nor dang*// grwa pas phul ba'i gnag lug rnams// bu mdo sde'i don du spel lags kyang*// mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs// nor bdag med sa 'og gi gter dang 'dra// phyugs bdag med spang kha'i ri gas 'dra// nor phyag rgya chen por rtogs pa des// 'tsho skyong la byed don mi 'dug pas// kun sbyin par mthong zhig bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// pha yul spe gsar gyi mkhar zhing dang*// mi las brtsigs pa'i sa mkhar rnams// bu mdo sde'i don du bgyis lags kyang*// mkhar bdag med dri za'i grong khyer 'dra// yul snang stong sgyu mar rtogs pa des// 'dzin spras la byed don mi 'dug pas// mkhar gyi 'dzin spras bor cig bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// pha spun mar tsho'i ngo 'dzin dang*// dgra sun skye bo rgyab bskyur tshul// bu mdo sde'i don du byas lags kyang*// mdo sde 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gshegs// snang ba sems su rtogs pa des// dgra gnyen la khyad par mi 'dug pas// thams cad chos skur sgoms shig bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs ba dang*// shul na lus pa'i bu drug la// bstan 'dzin gyi re bzhed ma mchis te// mdo sde bzhin du brtse bas skyongs// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// paṇa chen nā ro'i lung bstan ltar// kho bo'i bu slob brgyud bcas rnams// zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du// gong nas gong du 'phel rgyas pas// bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar rgyas 'byung*// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen grub// nyams dga' 'o skyid do bdag med ma// bu'i mya ngan sangs so bdag med ma// zhes pa'i mgur gsungs pas/

yum bdag med ma la sogs pa kun gyi thugs khral sangs shing*/ thugs dam la bogs thon par gyur to// la stod khum bu'i mgur/ ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ rje mar pa lo tsā bas la stod khum bur mgur bzhengs pa/ dad pa bgyi ba'i g.yer po de// blo 'khor ba las log pa'i rtsa na gda'// rang tshe 'di'i blo dang ma bral na// rkyen glo bur gyi dad pa ltar snang yin/ kha'i dad pas kyang rnal 'byor bslu bar mchi'o// brtson 'grus bgyi ba'i g.yer po che// 'chi ba rjes dran gyi rtsa na gda'// mi rtag pa rgyud la ma skyes na/ kha long med pa skad zer yang ltar snang yin// lo 'dod kyi chos kyis bslu bar mchi'o// dam chos bgyi ba'i g.yer po de// nyams su len pa'i rtsa na gda'// sems dang chos su ma 'dres na// gnad zab pa skad zer yang ltar snang yin// dpe cha yis rnal 'byor bslu bar mchi'o// lta ba bgyi ba'i g.yer po de// chos brgyad snyoms pa'i rtsa na gda'// rang gzung 'dzin gyi blo dang ma bral na/ kha byar med pa skad zer yang ltar snang yin// kha ta gog pos kyang bslu bar mchi'o// sgom pa bgyi ba'i g.yer po de// sems rang gsal 'dzin med kyi rtsa na gda'// rang bying rgod kyi skyon dang ma bral na// sgom bzang ba skad zer yang ltar snang yin/ du ma btsugs na// rnam dag pa skad zer yang ltar snang yin// yig brgya dang bshags pas kyang bslu bar mchi'o// 'bras bu bgyi ba'i g.yer po de// rang sems sangs rgyas kyi rtsa na gda'// sku gsum rang ngo ma shes na// gzhi lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas ltar snang yin// nam shi sangs rgyas kyis bslu bar mchi'o/ dbyangs de skad khum bu'i sgo rtsar blangs// zhes gsungs so// blo bde bcu gsum gyi mgur/༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag 'dra'i blo bder 'jug pa la// phyag rgya chen po ngo mtshar che// gcig chod kyi gdams pa blo re bde// 'pho ba mi dgos pa ngo mtshar che// skye shis mi 'jigs pa blo re bde// phyogs med du shar ba ngo mtshar che// lta ba'i phyogs su ma lhung bas// yid la med pa blo re bde// sgom pa'i phyogur ro//

the tshom mun sel gyi mgur/ ༈ bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen de// lnga brgya phrag bcu'i snyigs ma la// las can smin grol mdzad pa'i tshe// rje nā ro chen por sku sprul pas// mkhos chung mar pa lo tsā 'di// gsan nam gzigs sam thugs kyis mkhyen// pha thugs rjes zung dang sprul pa'i sku// ZÓ ti byang chub gsung lam du// rlung sems bde drod zung du chud// zag med bde ba chen por 'gro// sgrib bral rig pa'i ye shes shar// bla na med do bla ma'i gsung*// ma rig mun pa dbyings su dag /gzung du 'dzin pa'i sgrib gnyis bral// bde gsal spros dang bral bar shar// rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba 'di// rang bzhin med pa'i gzugs brnyan te// de ltar rtogs pa'i snang ba rnams// rmi lam snang ba ji bzhin du// chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur shar// lha dang lha min mi rnams dang*// dmyal ba yi gas dud 'gro dang*// sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i snang ba 'di// sgyu ma lta bur med par rtogs// yul dang yul can dmigs pa dang*// 'byung ba'i sgo dang rlung gnas kyis// gang 'dod kyi don du 'gyur 'gyur 'dra// bsre 'pho dri ma med par shar// skye ba'i dus su ma bcos bzhag /rmi lam dus su ma bslad dran// bar do'i dus su ma bcings rig /'bras bu'i dus su ma bsgribs shar// nā ro'i rjes 'brangs skyes bu rnams// gdams ngag zab pa nyams su longs// rig pa yod kyis nges shes bskyed// blo chung log par rtog pa rnams// sangs rgyas la yang skur 'debs shing*// rang grib la yang gshe byed pa'i// skye bo g.yam la rgyug pa la// don la 'di yin 'di min med// blun po 'bod rgyug byed pa la// mkhas rnams de yi rjes mi 'brang*// tha snyad tshig gi chos rnams stong*// nga sku 'di lha yi 'khor lo yin// gsung 'di chos kyi rang bzhin yin// thugs 'di ye shes ngo bo yin// bu sun pa med par nyams su longs// the tshom med par byang chub 'grub// ces gsungs pas nges shes skyes so/

ka bzhi'i lung bstan gyi mgur/ deng sang grongs sam ma grongs lta/ khang pa ka gcig gdung gnyis de// dus deng sang 'gyel lam ma 'gyel lta// zhing gcig glo mo haṃ khung de// dus deng sang 'jag skya e 'phyur lta/ khyim mtshes a khu g.yung dpal de// dus deng sang shi 'am ma shi lta// mo las 'phro can gyi legs se de// dus deng sang gnas la e song lta// bdag mi 'dug yul du 'gro bar zhu/ zhes zhus pas/ de nyid cang mi gsung*/ de nub bla ma rnal du song ba'i rmi lam du skal ldan bzhi 'byung ba rmis/ phyi nyin bu slob rnams bsdus nas tshogs 'khor cig mdzad pas rmi lam mgur du bzhengs pa/ rje 'gro ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal ba sku 'khor sras bcas la// gus pas mchog tu skyabs su mchi// mdang rnal du song ba'i rmi lam na// rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// shar du ka chen gcig btsugs pa rmis// thog tu song chen gcig babs pa rmis// seng g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa rmis// seng nam mkha'i dbyings su mchongs pa rmis// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// lho ru ka chen gcig btsugs pa rmis// thog tu stag mo gcig babs pa rmis// stag 'dzum drug mtha' nas rgyas pa rmis// stag khong 'dzum lan gsum byas pa rmis// stag mo nags la 'gying ba rmis// stag thang shing rgyud du 'brel pa rmis// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// nub tu ka chen gcig btsugs pa rmis// thog tu khyung chen gcig babs pa rmis/ khyung gshog drug mtha' nas rgyas pa rmis/ khyung bya mig gnam du bzlog pa rmis/ khyung nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur ba rmis// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// byang du ka chen gcig btsugs pa rmis/ thog tu rgod cig babs pa rmis// rgod gshog drug mtha' nas rgyas pa rmis// rgod bya spu gnam du gzengs ba rmis/ rgod tshang brag la bcas pa rmis// bya de la bu gcig skyes pa rmis// bya bran gyis bar snang gang ba rmis// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// shar du ka chen gcig btsugs pa de/
