khyod dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge yin// thog tu seng chen babs pa de/ khyod mi gzhi seng ge 'dra ba yin// seng g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa de// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thob pa yin// seng nam mkha'i dbyings su mchongs pa de// sgom sgrub tshad du skyol ba yin// lho ru ka chen gcig btsugs pa de/ khyod gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor yin// thog tu stag gcig babs pa de/ khyod mi gzhi stag mo 'dra ba yin// stag 'dzum drug mtha' nas rgyas pa de// bshad rgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba yin// stag khong 'dzum lan gsum byas pa de// rje bla ma'i gdams ngag thob pa yin// stag mo nags la 'gyings pa de// gdams ngag la nges shes skyes pa yin// thang shing rgyud du 'brel pa de// bu tsha bos rgyud pa zin pa yin// nub tu ka chen gcig btsugs pa de/ khyed rtsang gi mes ston tshon po yin// thog tu khyung chen cig babs pa de/ khyod mi gzhi khyung dang 'dra ba yin/ khyung gshog drug mtha' nas rgyas pa de// nang gi yon tan rgyas pa yin/ khyung bya mig gnam du zlog pa de// 'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin/ khyung nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur ba de// tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// skad cig gis yud du chod pa yin// byang du ka chen gcig btsugs pa de/ khyod gung thang gi mi la ras pa yin// thog tu rgod po babs pa de/ khyod mi gzhi rgod po 'dra ba yin// rgod gshog drug mtha' nas rgyas pa de// lta ba'i gdar sha chod pa yin/ rgod bya spu gnam du gzings pa de// rlung srog rtsol gnad du chud pa yin// rgod tshang brag la bcas pa de/ khyod sgom sran brag bas che ba yin// bya de la bu gcig skyes pa de// bu 'gran gyi do med cig 'byung ba yin/ bya bran gyis nam mkha' gang ba de// sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba yin// bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*/ brgyud pa je bzang je bzang 'gyur// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*/

ces gsungs pas da lta de bzhin du byung*/tshogs 'khor nam byed kyi mgur/ ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ rje mar pa lho brag pa la/ bla ma mes tshon pos 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag cig zhus pa la/ tshogs 'khor gcig dgos gsungs nas tshogs 'khor cig mdzad pas de'i dus su rje btsun gyis rgya gar du tshogs kyi 'khor lo khyad par can ji lta bu gzigs/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa'i dus nam yin zhus pas/ rje mar pas mgur 'di bzhengs pa yin/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo skad pa de// smin lam gyi dbang bskur byed tsa na// tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin// rgyud sde'i nyan bshad byed tsa na// tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin// dam tshig bshags sdom byed tsa na// tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pa yin// zab mo'i gdams ngag zhu tsa na// tshogs kyi 'khor sa mi khyab mthong*// dgos ngo mtshar che ba 'di 'dra mthong*// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen la// rje'u rigs kyi ded dpon tsakra dang*// chang tshong gi bu mo ku

q lis// rin chen 'bar ba'i maṇ+ḍi lha tshogs dang*// grangs med mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ pho mo drug cu rtsa gnyis 'tshogs// zab mo brda dang skad kyis dris// cho ga'i rim pa rgyas par byas// rje btsun nā ro'i thugs ka nas// bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams// dkyil 'khor dbus su legs par byon// dpal ldan nā ro chen po des// rdo rje dril bu phyag tu bzung*/ khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la// g.yas brkyang ba yis rol ba mthong*// rnal 'byor pho mo gzhan rnams kyang*// g.yas pa ḍa ma ru dkrol zhing*// g.yon pa ting ting shag bzung nas// gar gyi nyams kyis rol ba mthong*/ kho bo mar pa lo tsā ba// lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// zab mo bzhi'i ngo bo mthong*// lar tshogs 'khor de 'dra mthong ba yin// de 'dra'i rje dang mjal ba yin// 'as dang 'ud kyi tshogs mi mchi// ngo mtshar bar gdams sam gtsang ston pa/ zhes gsungs so// rje mar pa'i mgur nyer lnga'o// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /yon mchod 'khor bcas mtha' yas sems can rnams// tshe 'dir bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// bkra shis dge'o// ā+oṃ ye Zrma he tu prā £ wa he dun te khan ta thā ga to ƒ ba dad te^ tsa yo ni ro Z e baṃ £ ti ma hā shra ma na ye swā hā// chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur/ ༈ rje mar pa lo tsā ba de/ bi kra ma la shī la'i gnas na bzhugs pa la dus lan gcig skyo nas gzigs rtog la sogs pa mdzad pas kyang thugs skyo ba ma sangs te/ seng ldeng stug po'i nags gseb na phar skyo bsang du phyin pas bla ma la gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma nā ro pa mngon sum du byon/ bu lo tsā ba skyo ba bsang ba'i phyir chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur gnang ba yin gsungs/ dal 'byor gzugs kyi phung po 'di// dbyar skyo tsa na 'di skad gsungs// sems kyi gnas thabs lta ba'i gdeng*// yul gyi gnas thabs sgom pa'i gnad// phyi ni sgyu ma lha yi sku// nang na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// 'og na a shad tsaṇ+ḍa lī// steng na haṃ gi thig le can// steng 'og rlung gi 'khor lo'i dbyibs// bar na bde stong gsal ba'i nyams// ming yang gtum mo'i gdams ngag zer// sems gnad du tshud dam lo tsā ba// dus rmi lam tsam gyi sprul pa la// gnas mgrin pa gnas kyi sa bon can// phyi yi snang ba sgyu ma tsam// nang na nyams myong smrar ma btub// nyin mtshan gyi snang ba sprul pa'i sku// ming yang sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag zer// zhen pa bzlog gam lo tsā ba// gnyid dang rmi lam gyi bar shed na// gti mug chos sku'i ngo bo nyid// brjod med 'od gsal bde ba'i nyams// rjes la 'od gsal rgya yis 'debs// ming yang 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag zer// sems skye med du go'am sgom chen kun// sgo brgyad 'khor ba'i skar khung can// sgo gcig phyag rgya chen po'i lam// sgo brgyad bcad nas sgo gcig 'byed// rnam par shes pa chos nyid 'das// ming yang 'pho ba'i gdams ngag zer// rlung dus su khegs sam sgom chen kun// rmi na du bskyur// gzhan lus sprul sku'i ngo bo can// ming yang zung 'jug gi gdams ngag zer// rlung las su rung ngam lo tsā ba// rmi+i lam dus kyi snang tshul 'di// skyes pa rmis na pho 'drer bzung*// bud med rmis na mo 'drer bzung*// byol song rmis na klu ru bzung*// dga' ba rmis na sems 'phang skye// ngan pa rmis na snying mi dga'// 'dre rang sems kyi rtsa ba ma shes na// bgegs la zad pa med las che// phyi nang gi chos la thos pa dgos// go bas mtha' gnyis spong ba yin// yin min gyi sgro 'dogs chod lags pas// gol sas mi 'jigs gdeng thob mchis// gol sa med pas dbu ma'i lam// lam de la skyo ba ga la yod// zhes chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur gsungs pa lags so// des skyo ba sangs skad/

mar pa mgo yag des ngan rdzong*/ des lcim lung pa'o// ༈ nā ro pas mgur gsungs pa/ snang ba'i mtshan nyid skye ba med// 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid gzhi rtsa bral// sems kyi mtshan nyid zung du 'jug /bla ma'i mtshan nyid brgyud par ldan// zhes gsungs so// bla ma rnam gnyis kyi mgur 'di rnams/ bla ma mar pas yi ger bris nas bod du bsnams nas byon pa la/ mi la ras pa dang/ mar pa mgo yag gnyis min pa gang la yang ma gnang ba lags so// skyo ba byung na dngos 'dzin yin// gzhi rtsa byung na rnam rtog yin// phyogs char zhen na zhe 'dod yin// rang bzo byed na rmongs par zad// de la jo bo nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ sems dngos po'i gnas thabs ni/ sems nyid rnam med dag la gsal ba/ zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig yin te/ da ltar gyi shes pa cir yang snang ba ni dri ma 'khrul pa brdzun pa yin te/ 'di phar bsal ba'i dus rnam pa thams cad nub pa'i shes pa/ gsal ba'i ro bde bar shar ba/ bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med par bzhed do// ༈ nā ro pas gsungs pa/ sngon tshul bzhin sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can// bod yul gyi mar chung lo tsā khyod// 'khor lo sgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// dad pas rdo la yi ge bris// rigs rgyud nam mkha'i me tog yal// bka' brgyud chu bo'i gzhung bas ring*// seng ge khyung gi phru gu bzhin// bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// theg mchog snying po'i don bsdus nas// las can smin dang grol gyur pa'i// skal ldan gdul bya'i rgyal po khyod// da ltar bod yul dbus su song*// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs// spos kyi shing rnams rgyas pa'i sa// sman sna tshogs skyes pa'i ri mgul na// skal ldan gdul bya snod ldan yod// khyod de ru song la 'gro don bsgrub// bu khyod kyi sku don 'grub nas mchi// skye ba 'di nyid 'das gyur nas// mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i gnas// 'od gsal gyi ngang du mjal bar bgyi// zhes lung bstan pa'i mgur 'di gsungs pa lags skad/

༄// na mo gu ru/ rtogs pa'i mtsho mo mi mer ba lags kyang*// nyams myong gi 'khyag dar chags pa zhig byung*/ gdams ngag gi kha ser tsha bas kyang phan nam ang*/ dad pa'i zhing mi gshin pa lags kyang*/ byang chub kyi myu gu 'khrungs pa zhig byung*/ sgom sgrub kyi so nam rem pas kyang phan nam ang*/ bsam gtan gyi 'khar dpe'u mi mtho ba lags kyang*/ dgra dug lnga'i jag pa thub pa zhig byung*/ sems yengs med kyi rtse gcig bzhag pas kyang phan nam ang*/ bdag pho rgo can zhig ma lags te/ rje bla ma bas kyang thugs la 'dogs pa zhig byung*/ de sngon bsags kyi las 'phro sad pas kyang phan nam ang*/ dpal nā ro pa'i dbang bzhi/ bla ma la rtogs pa phul ba'i mgur ro// rtogs pa klong gyur gyi mgur/༈ rtogs pa klong du gyur cing chos la rang byan chud pa gdeng dang ldan pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje gong ma rnams kyi bka' drin ni// ngas sos dal dben tshe rtsa rlung bsgoms// lus sems gcun zhing gcun zhing bsgoms// 'byung ba 'khrugs kyang nyam nga med// bogs 'don du shes pa'i gdeng zhig yod// gnyid kyi dus su 'od gsal bsgoms// snang ba sdud cing sdud cing bsgoms// gti mug tu song yang nyam nga med// zung 'jug tu shes pa'i gdeng zhig yod// rmi lam gyi dus su sgyu lus bsgoms// snang ba spro zhing spro zhing bsgoms// rnam rtog tu song yang nyam nga med// sgyu mar shes pa'i gdeng zhig yod// 'dod yon da tshe lha skur bsgoms// ro bro myang zhing myang zhing bsgoms// bza' btung du mthong rung nyam nga med// tshogs mchod du shes pa'i gdeng gcig yod// thabs lam gyi skabs su gzhan lus bsgoms// bde ba bskyed cing bskyed cing bsgoms// tha mal du 'dug kyang nyam nga med// lhan skyes su shes pa'i gdeng gcig yod// 'chi ba'i dus su 'pho ba bsgoms// 'pho ba sbyong zhing sbyong zhing bsgoms// 'chi ltas byung yang nyam nga med// rdzogs rim du shes pa'i gdeng gcig yod// shi ba'i dus su bar do 'dzin// bar do sprin dang na bun 'dra// chags sdang skyes kyang nyam nga med// rang grol du shes pa'i gdeng gcig yod// ces gsungs/

mes ston la ched du gtad pa'i mgur/sdos pa'i// zab mo'i gdams ngag nub par phangs// mes ston dang rngog ston ma gtogs pa// khong gzhan la gzhung bshad byas pa med// chos 'dod pa rnams la shod cig byas// nor dbul ba can gyi slob mas kyang*// bla ma la bka' rgyas btab pa med// nor ci yang med pa'i mthu chen dang*// zhabs tog can gyi rngog ston la// gdams ngag la dam lhod ma byas pas// dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa gyis// mi nga yis dka' las 'di tsam byas// nor chud zos can du ma song ba// lag tu gser srang brgya cu 'khyer// rten khyad par can la mchod pa phul// bla ma rnams la 'bul bar bgyis// gnas khyad par can du tshogs gtor byas// bu khyed kyis byas pa'i zhabs tog la// drin lan dam chos dpag med sbyin// chos kyi zho sha nyams su longs// 'gro ba gzhan la ci phan mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ mes ston nges shes 'drongs te/ thugs bskyed chen po byung ngo*// ༈ mes ston rang gi 'dod zhus dang*/ bka' yongs su gtong ba la ched du gtad pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bde ba'i dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon// sprul sku zung 'jug he ru ka// gar mgu'i nyams len bde stong ngang*// zhal sbyor lhan cig skyes la 'dud// brda mthong tsam gyis don rtogs shing*// zur gyis go ba'i gang zag la// thos pa tsam gyis grol bar 'gyur// tha snyad tshig gis mi mtshon pa// zag med don gyi ye shes ster// bskyod pa bde ba'i skad cig la// sdug bsngal med pa de lta bur// zag bcas yid 'di mi ches pas// bde stong ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun// rtogs pa bral ba'i sems la zhog /sangs rgyas lta bu'i bla ma'i gsung*// yang brgyud pa gzhan nas 'di skad gsungs// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma la// sgyu rtsal goms par gyur pa yi// skyes bu bya la mda' rtse bzhin// goms pa rgyud la rtag brten la// ji ltar zhan pa'i bag chags 'byung*// gdod nas dag pa'i sems rgyud 'di// glo bur rkyen gyis ma bslad na// nam mkha' bzhin du 'dus ma byas// phyin ci ma log gnas lugs yin// yid la bya rgyu rdul dang bral// bzung du rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang*// man ngag rgyud la goms pa yis// tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe// pha rol phyin pa'i dbyings su thim// de la skye ba yod ma yin// nam mkha' lta bu'i rang sems de// na bun rtog pas ma bslad cig

/rje nā ro paṇa chen 'di skad gsungs// chos tshul bzhin nyams su len pa la// snyug dong bcug pa'i sbrul bzhin du// rtsol ba bral ba'i lus mi 'gul// yid la chags pa'i mya ngan rnams// gnad la phog pa'i zug rngu ltar// bya ba btang ba'i sems mi yong*// sems gnyug ma'i rang bzhin gdod nas stor// tho bas dngos po 'joms pa bzhin// mthong dang reg dang dran pas grol// don 'di la legs par go bar mdzod// 'di phyag rgya chen po'i sgom dbyangs yin// dam chos gzhan la phan gyur na// sho sbar ma bsdams mes ston pa// skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag la// sba bar mi bya man ngag sbyin// ces gsungs so// yongs su grags pa'i lam glu ring mo/༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje mar pa lo tsā bas rgya gar du lo bcu dgu bzhugs te/ nangs kyi tha mar bod du gshegs par bzhed nas/ ha la par pa ta dug mtsho khol ma'i do ri la dpal zhi ba bzang po bzhugs nas/ bla ma la phyi phyag skyel du phyin te tshur log nas shing a mra'i tshal du nyal ba'i nub mo bsam pa cung zhig btang bas/ yong tshe 'di la bar chod med par sgra skad mkhas pa'i tshad cig lobs/ rgyud 'grel mang po yang shes/ da 'gro ba shin tu brod pa la/ bla ma sku drin can dang mched grogs snying dang 'dra ba rnams shul du lus pa yang sems pa 'phreng*/ lam gyi gcan 'phrang dang*/ zam pa mang po yod pa shin tu mtsher nas de'i dus su lam glu ring mo 'badun// dus skad cig ma bral 'grogs pa'i phyir// thugs la mi 'dogs kyi sa ma mchis// dpal me tog spungs pa'i dgon pa der// dbang bzhi'i chu bo rdzogs par skur// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag mthar thug gnang*// bla med theg pa mchog gi don// gnyis med rtse gcig gzhir bzhag nas// sems stong pa nyid la sbar zin byas/ kha ba can 'dabs byang phyogs su// lung bstan rgyal tshab bskos pa'i phyir// da ni ban chung bod du 'gro// ban chung bod du 'gro ba la// shul na 'phreng ba rnam gsum yod// yid la bcags pa rnam gsum yod// lam na 'jigs pa rnam gsum yod// bar na mtsher ba rnam gsum yod// gdeng na brod pa rnam gsum yod// ngo mtshar che ba rnam gsum yod// glu de phyi rjes ma bcad na// tshig des don gyi brda mi 'jal// rje nā ro dang mai tris dbu mdzad nas// grub thob kyi bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad// 'di shul na lus te ma bas 'phreng*// dpal 'jigs med grags pa'i dbu mdzad nas// mched dang lcam dral brgya rtsa brgyad// 'di shul na lus te ma bas 'phreng*// gnas pu

a ha ris sna drangs nas// grub thob kyi gnas chen brgya rtsa brgyad// 'di shul na lus te ma bas 'phreng*// lha Zrma bo de a sho ka /drin can gyi gnas po pho mo rnams// da 'bral mi phod de yid la bcags// bram ze'i khye'u gser phreng can// shi srog gis mthud pa'i grogs po byas// da 'bral mi phod de yid la bcags// ded dpon gyi bu mo sngo sangs ma// mtshan ldan phyag rgyar bsten bsten nas// da 'bral mi phod de yid la bcags// lho dug mtsho khol ma'i sna drangs nas// shar chu bo gaṅga da gzod brgal// 'di ma mthong gi gong nas nga re 'jigs// ri u shi ri'i nags 'dabs na// mi rkun gyi jag pas lam na bsgugs// 'di ma mthong gi gong nas nga re 'jigs// grong khyer ti ra hu ti na/ khrel med kyi sho gam bcu gcig 'bebs// 'di ma mthong gi gong nas nga re 'jigs// 'phrang pa la ha ti ma gtogs pa// gcan 'phrang gi zam pa brgya bcu gcig /e ma dngul chu bas kyang 'tsher// la kha la bya la ma gtogs par// la chen dang la chung brgya bcu gcig /e ma dngul chu bas kyang mtsher// thang dpal mo dang dpal thang ma gtogs pa// thang chen dang thang chung brgya bcu gcig /e ma dngul chu bas kyang mtsher// sgra ka la tsan tras sna drangs nas// skad sna brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs lo tsā 'tshogs na nga re brod// dpal dgyes rdor dang gdan bzhis sna drangs nas// rgyud 'grel brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs ston chen 'tshogs na nga re brod// ka bzhi'i gdams pas sna drangs nas// snyan brgyud brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs sgom chen 'tshogs na nga re brod// bsre ba dang 'pho ba ma gtogs pa/ khyad chos brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// dud sol lha mo ma gtogs pa// bstan srung brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes/ che na ngo mtshar de che mod// rim lnga'i dmar khrid ma gtogs pa/

rdzogs rim brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// de thams cad bla ma rje'i drin// 'bangs drin lan gzhal gyis mi 'khor bas// rje mi 'bral mar gyur pa bram ze sa mud ta kirti dang*/ rnal 'byor ma su ka Zba'i yongs su grags pa'i lam glu ring mo'o//

nā ro dang mai tri pa'i bzhed gzhung gi rtogs mgur phul ba/ sa pa yin/ khyad par du'ang lo tsā ba khyed rgya gar du yun ring bzhugs pa la/ srog la bar chad med par slob gnyer mthar phyin nas 'dug pas/ bkra shis pa'i glu zhig blang dgos/ khyed kyi bla ma mai tri pa de lta ba gtso bor smra ba yin zer pas/ khong gi dgongs pa ji ltar bzhed cing 'dug 'dir byung ba la/ de'i dus su rje mai tri pa'i bzhed gzhung ma/ rtogs pa phul ba'i mgur bzhengs pa yin gsungs/ pha ri khrod zhabs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dgongs pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don// chos phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// grogs snying dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje'i spun// 'bral thabs med do rang cag rnams// tha dad lus la sems rgyud gcig /dpal 'jigs med grags pa ma lags sam// nga rgya gar dbus nas yongs pa dang*/ khyed bal po'i mthil na bzhugs pa gnyis// tshe 'du byed dbang du ma thal bar// de ring khyad par dus bzang la// mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i tshogs gral du// dus mtshungs zhal yar 'dzoms pa de// dam tshig la ngo lkog med par nges// mi kho bo shin tu spro ba skyes/ khyed dga' ru tshor ram 'dir bzhugs rnams// nga mgo rmongs bod kyi ban chung la// mi khyed kyis mtshan snyan lo tsār btags/ khyed sgra sgyur bod kyis glu long gsungs// ngag 'dren pa'i gre 'gyur mi bde yang*/ khyed pho bo gong ma'i gnad mi theg /rje nā ro mai tri rnam gnyis la// sku drin rjes su dran pa'i glu// ngo mtshar can gyi mthong lugs yod// snyan ca re gson cig lcam dral rnams// rje rtogs tshad can gyi mai tri ba/ khong gi snyan pa rgyang nas khums// sprul sku'i bzhugs gnas rgya gar yul// ljongs yangs pa can gyi dbus 'gyur du// sa skyong rgyal po cod paṇa gyis// zhabs rdul ze'u 'brus len gyur cing*// gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas pa rnams// mnga' bdag gtsug gi rgyan yin zhes// snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur grags/

cho 'phrul bya'i lo dus la// bde gshegs mchod pa mnga' mdzad phyir// mtshan mnga' bdag zhes byar yongs su grags// pha sangs rgyas de'i zhal snga nas// theg pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don// mtha' bral yid la mi byed pa// chos phyag rgya che la ngo sprod bgyis// phyi gzung ba yul gyi snang ba 'di// bde ba chen po rgyun chad med// skye med chos kyi sku ru rtogs// nang 'dzin pa yid kyi rnam shes 'di// 'gyu ba ngos bzung med pa'i phyir// rig pa rten med gcer bur mthong*// snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun// gdod nas ma grub skye ba med// ngo bo spros dang bral bar rtogs// mar 'khor ba spang byar mi 'dod cing*// yar mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub byar med// 'khor 'das rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang*// zung 'jug bde ba chen por rtogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bcud phyung yang*// mthar thug de las med do gsungs// mi kho bo'i sgro 'dogs de nas chod// de rje mai tri'i bzhed gzhung lags/ khyed lta ba bzhed na de la mdzod// dbyangs mchod par bzhes shig dkon mchog gsum// thugs dgyes par dgongs shig gdan gang rnams/ zhes gsungs so// ༈ yang rje pham thing pa'i zhal nas rje mai tri pa'i dgongs pa de ngo mtshar shin tu che na/ 'o skol rang gi bla ma dang khyed gang du mjal/ sku che ba'i yon tan khyad par can nam/ ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas ci mthong zhes 'dri ru byung la/ sku drin rjes su dran pa'i mgur 'di bzhengs pa yin gsungs/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i nā ro pa// pha rje btsun de yis drin thob pa// da// gsung don bdud rtsi rjes gnang ba'i// chos 'brel pa tsam gyi bla ma yang*// dpal sing ga gling pa'i sna drangs nas// mngon shes rig pa mnga' brnyes shing*// snang ba bsgyur nus brtson 'grus bzhugs// kun gyi nang nas mchod sdong bzhin// rje 'gran zla med pa'i nā ro pa// rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can// rje khong gi sku drin 'khor thabs med// pha yid la gcags so sprul pa'i sku// mi kho bos ma btsal sa phyogs med// zhal yang de mjal de ma mjal// ri mun pa can gyi nags 'dabs su// ngo mtshar shel gyi pha bong la// rgya la 'bur du brkos pa bzhin// pha rje btsun gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes mthong*// lar che na ngo mtshar de che mod// nga rang dbang med pa'i mchi ma shor// ngu snying 'dod pa'i gdung ba skyes// rab tu ma bzod smre sngags bton// rtse gcig yid kyis gsol ba btab// rje thugs rje gzigs nas mngon du byon// yong mthong lam lta bu'i dga' ba skyed// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// dkon pa'i rin chen gser phye phul// nga ni de kun mi 'dod gsungs// yang yang bskyar te bzhes par zhus// ltos med nags kyi gseb tu gtor// bla ma dkon mchog bzhes shig gsungs/

kho bos phangs sems skyes pa las/ khyed 'dod na slar yang yod do gsungs// thal sbyor snyim pa kha phye nas// ma god ma nyams snga ma bzhin// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// zhabs mthe bong sa la brdab pa las// rdo dang gseg ma gser du gyur// thams cad gser gling yin no gsungs// che na ngo mtshar de che mod/ lto dkar nya'i khog pa las// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa bshams// ro brgyar ldan pa'i kha zas byung*// che na ngo mtshar de che mod/ khyod 'di ru ma sdod bod du song*// ljongs kha ba can rgyud byang phyogs na// gdul bya snod ldan yod do gsungs// lung bstan rjes su gnang ba thob// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// lar sprul sku nā ro paṇa chen la// ngo mtshar can gyi mthong lugs brgyad/ khyed rdo rje spun las ma gtogs pa/ khong gzhan la bzlas na yid mi ches// lar da dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// log rtog skye bo phrag dog che// yon tan brjod na sgro skur 'deb// spun khyed la ma gtogs gsang ba yin// glu mchod par bzhes shig sku drin can/ thugs dgyes par dgongs shig snying gi grogs/ zhes mar pa lo tsā bas nā ro mai tri rnam gnyis la/ sku drin rjes su dran pa'i mgur phu bo rnam gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i mched grogs rnams la byon skyes su phul ba'o// ༈ gson dang snying grogs dpal bzang po// nga mar pa bya ba'i ba qེ la// nā ro mai tri'i dgongs pa gnyis// gang zab gsungs pas dbyangs 'di len// seng ge lta bu'i nā ro pa// kun gyi nang nas rin po che// dgos 'dod thams cad skong mdzad pa'i// dgongs pa nyid kyi thugs la mnga'// rje Zrma Z ras thugs rjes bzung*// paṇa chen 'di yi zhabs pad ni/ deng sang bdag gi gtsug gi rgyan// khong gi dgongs pa 'di ltar gda'// snyan lhan ner gson la thugs gtad 'tshal// chos sku'i mkha' la ye shes sprin phung 'khrigs// char rgyun sprul pas 'gro ba yongs la khyab// brgyud pa ma chad skyes bu'i bla ma mchog

/de la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku nam mkha' lta bu ste// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen yin// ye shes sprin phung 'khrigs pa de// byang chub sems dpa' rnam gnyis yin// phrin las bdud rtsi'i char 'bab pa// rje btsun bram ze sa ra ha// sprul pas 'gro don mdzad pa de// ri khrod dbang phyug sha ba ri// de yi brgyud pa ma chad pa// mnga' bdag rgyal sras man du ma gol gsan par zhu// tshig gi sdeb sbyor mi mkhas kyang*// don gyi gdams ngag go lugs 'di// snyan tshud bgyid pas mjal bar mdzod// srid gsum ye nas rnam par dag /don dam ye nas go rgyu med// med pa ma yin rgyun chad med// 'pho 'gyur med par lta bar bzhed// gnyug ma'i ngo bo ngang gis gsal// zag med bsam gtan rgyun chad med// med pa ma yin 'du bral med// zhen chags med par sgom par bzhed// sna tshogs rten 'brel shugs 'byung la// sgyu ma'i rol pa 'gag pa med// med pa ma yin dngos po la// glo bur nges med ོda par bzhed// sems rgyud byang chub snying por gsal// sku gsum sangs rgyas thob byar med// med pa ma yin re dogs bral// gzhi med rtsa bral 'bras bur bzhed/ ces gsungs pas// yang dris pa/ sgom nyams su len pa'i gangarjes gnang mdzad// gsang mtshan gnyis med rdo rjer btags// khong rgyud sde kun kyi lde mig 'dzin// gsang sngags thabs lam mngon du gyur// chos kyi rgyal mtshan chos kyi mdzod// chos kyi seng ge chos kyi rgyal// sgra dang dbu tshad mtha' dag mkhyen// paṇ+ḍi ta yi dngos grub brnyes// dngos po'i gnas lugs dri med mkhyen// rgyal srid rtswa bzhin dor byas nas// tshe gcig mchog gi go 'phang thob// rje btsun mkha' 'gros zhal bstan cing*// thun mong bsgrubs pas thams cad thob// de ltar yon tan dpag med brnyes// pha khong gi dgongs pa 'di ltar gda'// rim par skyes pa'i gang zag la// srog rtsol gtum mo'i gdams ngag dang*// zhen med sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag dang*// mun sel 'od gsal gyi ngo sprod dang*// srid pa longs sku'i ngo sprod dang*// skye ba sprul sku'i ngo sprod sogs// thabs mchog gzhi lam 'bras bu'i khrid// cig car ba yi gang zag la// phyag chen gcer mthong ngo sprod mdzad// pha khong mthong sgo gsum dad pa skyes// thos na las kyi sgrib pa 'dag

/mjal na ngan song 'jigs las grol// zhus na sang de ltar gda'// legs sam skal ldan rdo rje'i spun// ces pa de skad gsungs pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta shṝ £ dras dbu mdzad pa rnams dgyes nas lo tsā ba khyed kyi mdun ma gsha' mar grub gda' gsungs so// bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi mgur/༈ bla ma bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// nga yi brgyud pa rin chen 'di nyid la// nyes ltung med pa'i bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /gdams ngag zab mo'i nye lam la// nor 'khrul med pa'i bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /nga rang mar pa lo tsā la// zab mo gnad kyi bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// byin rlabs dngos grub bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu chen slob ma'i 'khor tshogs la// dad pa dam tshig bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /yon bdag yul mi nye ring la// mthun rkyen tshogs sogs bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /las dang bya ba thams cad la// 'gro don byang chub bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre la// chad mdo btsan pa'i bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /'dir tshogs khrom gyi lha mi la// bde skyid smon lam bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /ces gsungs pa'i rjes su bla ma rngog pa la sogs pa'i bu slob dang yon bdag rnams kyi 'bul ba bzhes nas/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba rnams mdzad pa lags so// 010) ༄// bdag med ma'i byin rlabs bzhugs so/ ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ mkha' 'gro ma bdag med ma'i byin rlabs dslob ma la 'pho ba'i thabs gnas khang yid dang mthun par maṇ+ḍal la dsa bon rnams rim pa bzhin du brjod la me tog tshom bu bco lnga bkram/ me long la

dchang ngam dris byugs la sin Zà ra'i phye ma dar dram ras 'dra la btsags pas chos 'byung gru gsum bsnol ma bris la/ dbus kyi lte ba la lha mo bco lnga'i sa bon bco lnga 'bri/ zur rnams la jo bo tai lo pa nas da lta yan chad kyi bla ma'i dgsang mtshan shes na legs ming gi yi ge dang po gser gyi thur mas bris te/ de yang maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dman dz+nya ra la sogs pa'i steng du thod pa'i chang byin gyis brlabs byas pa de bzhag de'i steng du shing gi khri 'dra ba'i steng du dar dmar pos bkab pa/ de'i steng du sin Zà ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhag go bzhag me tog dang spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa dlha mo bco lnga la pu tsa tshar re bshams na legs bsham/ gtor ma dang tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa yang bsham/ der gdan bting ste/ bla ma bzhugs su gsol/ bla mas dgyes pa rdo rje phyag bcu drug pa'i yum dang bcas pa'i bskyed rim rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bsgoms/ lha mo bco lnga'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs par ci rigs par dnus tshad gcig bzlas/ bla mas rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i nyams dye shes sems dpa' bzhug e gcig bsgom/ me long la lha mo bco lnga bla ma dang bcas pa bsgom/ thod pa chang gis bkang ba gcig bla ma'i lag pa g.yas par bzung ste/ g.yon pa'i srin mtheb chang gi nang du bcug la oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ de nas oṃ dā hūm̐ dang sbyar swā hā'i bar du lha mo'i sa bon bcug nas thigs gtor lha mo rnams la gtor bas lha mo rnams shin tu mnyes par bsgom/ de nas me long la de ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis dsin Zà ra la mchod/ bu mo chung ngu mas dbu mo dang bla ma dang sin Zà ra'i dkyil 'khor bcas pa la phyag gsum byas la ḍā ki la thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig ces gsol ba gdab par bya'o zan gyi ting lo re re khar 'jog tu bcug

tshogs kyi dgcig sgom du bcug la de las bdag med ma 'phros pas mchod pa yang yid kyis dbul/ de nas spos chus slob mar khrus byas te/ bla ma la dskyabs 'gro sems bskyed gcig bya la maṇ+ḍal dang me tog phul te/ de nas slob ma de stan bde ba'i steng du skyil krung bca' thal mo sbyar la sems shin tu rtse gcig par gyis shig byas la/ da khyed kyis slob dpon dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum zhal sbyar du sgom zhig bya/ slob dpon gyi snying khar bdag med ma nyungs dkar gyi 'bru tsam pa/ g.yas ddad gus dang bcas pa na gri gug g.yon na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung bcug pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ 'od zer kha dog drug dang ldan pa dpag tu med pa byung bas khyod rang gi snying gar bzhugs pas/ lus thams cad bdag med ma'i sku 'od zer dang bcas pas me re re gang bar sgoms dang gsung bya/ yang dang yang du byas pas byin rlabs phebs te'o// de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i Zà ra'i da la la me tog la sogs pa dgsan gsum kar byas pa dang mi 'gal mchod/ yi ge ma rnams mkha' 'gro ma'i ngo bor bzhugs la/ slob ma'i dpral bar thig le bya/ lhag ma gtums la dpung pa g.yon par bcings pa'o/ lag tu blang pa'i drje ma zhus pas rim pa slob dpon zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / 011) ༄// dbang bzhi nyams phyag rgya chen po/ ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ lar sangs rgyas sems can gyi khyad par rnam rtog spangs ma spangs yin te/ sems can rnam rtog ma spangs pas sems can no// sangs rgyas rnam rtog spangs pas sangs rgyas lags so// de'i rtog pa spongs pa la e waṃ bsgoms te/ de la'ang gnyis/ rtogs pa'i e waṃ dang*/ gnas pa'i e waṃ mo// dang po ni chos thams cad bde stong gnyis med ci'i ngo bor yang mi gnas pa spros pa thams cad bral ba gcig la bya'o/ de ni lus kyi gnad shin tu yang gal che ste/

de'i gnas khyad par can de rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud nas ston pa lags so// nyams myong skye bar byed pa'i nyin mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ ri mthon por song la mig tu nyi ma dang ser bu ma song par bsgom mo// de ltar bsgoms pa'i dus su du ba dang*/ srin bu me khyer la sogs pa rtags lnga gang rung 'ong ste/ yid ches pa tsam las/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por song ba'i rtags ma yin no/ de dag gi bsgom pa'i thabs ni/ gling bzhi bsdus pa dang*/ ri rab bsrang pa dang*/ dar po che nam mkha' la 'phyar ba dang*/ bya rgod nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ nyi ma zla ba gzung ba'o// de'i dus su chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi don la blo gnas pa de ltar bya'o/ des kyang bag ma byung na nam mkha'i dkyil sngo sang nge ba la dmigs la bsgom mo// shes pa bying ba mi 'byung*/ mi rtog pa skyes na drod dang bde ba shugs la 'byung*/ de ltar gnas pa la rnal 'byor chen po'i man ngag ces bya/ dbang bzhi pa zhes bya/ de ltar rtogs pa la dbang bzhi gsum rnam pa thams cad nas thams cad du mi dgos so//

´/brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u gsum pa nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ rnam pa rab tu gnas// e waṃ rnam pa'i bde chen po// dbang las yang dag shes par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i gdams pa bdag la ri bo'i dgon par slob dpon jo thog gis dmyal { gnyal } nas byon pa'i phyi the'i lo la gnang ngo*/ phyag yig ni rje btsun nyid kyis 'dug pas yid ches kyang bdog pa'o// 012) ༄// dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus tshigs bcad can/ ༈ rgya gar skad du/ sha ka ka ṭa saṃ k+ṣista/ bod skad du/ dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// dang po'i las can rnams dga' phyir// dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad par bya// gsol ba gdab dang bsnyen pa dang*// sa dang sta gon thig dang tshon// dkyil 'khor bsgrub dang mchod pa dang*// bdag nyid 'jug dang dbang bskur dang*// yon 'bul ba dang bcu gcig go /sems can don brtson sems kyis ni// dngos po kun gyis gsol ba gdab// bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas pas// dkyil 'khor las rnams mi bya'o// dang po rang lha'i bdag nyid kyis// dkyil 'khor la gnas bsnyen pa bya// de nas sa yi cho ga brtsam// grong dang dur khrod tshong 'dus dang*// tshal dang lha khang grong khyer gyi// shar dang byang gi sa gzhir shes// lho dang nub phyogs de ltar min// lto 'phye brtag sogs rim pa yis// dkyil 'khor khang pa yid 'ong bya// de dbus lci ba ma lhung bas// dkyil 'khor sa ni nyis 'gyur byug de nas sa lha zhing skyong mchod// gnang ba thob nas sngags pa yis// lag pa sa la bzhag nas su// rang gi snying po brgya brgyar bzla/ slob dpon sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin// lha yi sku yi bdag nyid can// dpa' bo rdo rje dril 'chang ba// mkha' 'gror bcas la gsol ba gdab// blo ldan rdo rje gsor byed cing*// dri gzugs su spro/

bgegs kyi tshogs la 'go gzigs pa'i// 'gying bcas sngags ni zlos bzhin du// de rnams snying gar gdam par bya// rwa ba rnams ni phyogs su bya// rdo rje'i gur ni steng du dang*// rdo rje'i rang bzhin sa ru bya// de nas phyi de nyin par ni// sta gon dag ni bya ba yin// lha dang bum pa slob ma'o// bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin byas nas// gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba der// bdud rtsi lngas ni rab tu byug /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas rnams su// tsan dan sogs kyis gru bzhi bya// phal pa yi ni gnas rnams su// sor mos zlum por byas nas su// lha mo'i 'khor lo cho ga bzhin// me tog sogs kyis mchod par bya// de nas rin chen gser dang dngul// zangs sam 'jim pa dag kyang rung*// ji ltar sbyor ba rjes mthun par// bum pa dag ni bya ba ste// btsa' ba nag po la sogs med// lto yangs bum pa bzang po'i dbyibs// bya ¨ི seng gh+ri la sogs pa// sman dang rgyun bcas chu yis dag /de steng dam tshig chen po ni// me tog chu dang ldan par bya// mtshan ma yang yang mdog ru bya// mgrin par ras zung gsar pas dkri// kha ni shing lo gsar pas dgang*// ku sha'i chun po 'og tu 'ding*/ kha dog bcos min ku shas brgyan// lhag par gnas shing mchod byas nas// slob ma rnams ni lhag gnas bya// gsol gdab gdams dang spro ba bskyed// sdom pa gsum la legs bkod nas// bur bya gnas gsum byin brlabs shing*// so shing gtad nas khrus byas te// srad bu dmar po'i khyad par du// dpung pa bcing ste rtag tu bsrung*// ye shes Zིཿyi sngags bzlas pa'i// ku sha de la rab tu sbyin// chos bshad cho ga'i rim pa'o// mkhyen par gsol te snyan gsan dbab// yid kyis thams cad nam mkhar bkod/ srad bu ye shes lnga ldan zhing*// nyi shu rtsa lngar rnam dbye ba// dkyus su 'khor lo'i nyis gyur la// sboms su sgo yi nyi shu'i cha// de nas cho ga bzhin du mchod// chos kun ngo bo nyid kyis ni// srad bu phan tshun bsgril bar bya// ru Zི ra ni chen pos brlan// khaḥgasum brjod nas lte bar ni// g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung nas// blo ldan nam mkhar thig btab ste// de bzhin sa la'ang gnas par bya/

khrud byed la sogs nas brtsams te// ji srid khru ni brgya yi bar// nub dang lho yi phyogs su ni// slob dpon nges par yang dag gnas/ shar dang byang gi phyogs nas su// slob ma gnas te mnyam bzhag pas// tshangs sogs legs par phye ste gdab// thig skud chad na slob dpon 'chi// dman dang lhag na nad 'byung ste// phyogs la 'khrul na slob ma myo// de bas shes rab skyon med bya// ye shes thig skud gshegs gsol nas// rin chen lnga yi phye ma'am// yang na 'bras la sogs pa ste// dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar// ljang khu nag po de bzhin te// slob dpon dbang mtshams su ni// song ste mnyam par bzhag nas su// legs sbas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis/ ri mo lnga ni dbye bar bya// phan tshun bar du nas re tsam// shong ba'i tshad du 'bri ba ste// ri mo sbom na nad du 'gyur// phra bas nor ni nyams par 'gyur// yon pos 'dir ni rtsod par 'gyur// chad pas 'chi ba 'byung bar 'gyur// shar phyogs su ni dkar po che// lho ni ser po yang dag ldan// nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste// byang du margad yang dag ldan// dbus kyi sa yi cha nyid ni// iu nī la 'od 'bar ba'o// ༈ sgo bzhi kun nas zur bzhi ba// rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan// grwa yi cha ni thams cad kyang*// sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ rdo rje rin chen gyis spras pa// mnyam par bzhag ste yang dag 'bri// rdo rje rwa ba'i nang du ni// dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan pa ste/ dbus su mtho ba 'bri bar bya// shar dang byang du gzhol bas ni// sngags pa rnams kyi dngos grub 'gyur// dbus su mtho bas rgyal srid dang*// rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas dag thob// byang du mtho bas 'chi 'gyur ram// nor ni brlag par 'gyur ba ste// yang na nad kyis 'deb par 'gyur// dbus su dma' ba'i rang bzhin pas// sgrub pa po ni 'joms dang ldan// lha yi gnas ni de nyid du// dbus su sna tshogs paV 'bri// ge sar dang ni ldan pa la// mtshams rnams su ni thod pa ste// sangs rgyas bzhi yi gdan bzhugs pa// rdo rje la sogs dpa' rnal 'byor// 'dab ma'i mkha' 'gro la sogs pas// khwa gdong la sogs dbye bar bya// dkyil 'khor kun tu rin chen dang*// mchod rdzas kun gyis brgyan par bya// brgyad ni sgo ru rnam par bkod// bum pa dgu 'byor che la gnas pa yin// mdor bsdus pas ni me tog spos// de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis/

rab mnyam bzhag ste mchod par bya// glu dang gar gyi dga' bdes kyang*// der ni gtor ma sbyin par bya// de ltar cho ga bzhin dkyil 'khor// 'dod pa kun ldan mchod gnas su// slob dpon smin pa'i las kyis ni// slob ma yongs su smin par bya// bu sdug de dag gdong pa la// dar ras legs par bkab nas su// thal mo me tog gis bkang la// kye khyod su yin 'dri bya ste// bdag ni skal bzang zhes kyang smra// de nas bskor ba byas nas ni// blo bzang 'di ni mnyam bzhag pas// pho brang nyams dgar gzhug par bya// sku gsum thugs kyi sdom pa'ang sbyin// slob dpon byin gyis brlabs byas te// lho yi phyogs su lus bstan pas// thal mo'i me tog de nas dor/ gang du me tog de lhung ba// de yi rigs su shes byas la// gdong g.yogs dkrol nas dkyil 'khor bstan// skye ba sngon bsags sdig pa rnams// dkyil 'khor mthong bas byang bar 'gyur// sngags pas dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar// gang gi rnal 'byor pa nyid 'dod// mkha' la khu tshur gyis brdeg dang*// smig sgyu'i chu ni 'thung dang mtshungs// dgod dang lta dang lag 'dzin gyi// 'khyud dang gnyis sprod la sogs pas// dbang bskur ba ni 'gyur ba yin// bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang*// bzhi pa zhes byar bla mas gsungs// chu dang cod paṇa rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming gis dbang bskur te// dbang lnga de bzhin gshegs bdag nyid// gdugs dang gdan dang rig pa sogs/ rdo rje dril sogs yang dag ldan// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang*// rdo rje sems dpa' phyir mi ldog /sbyin bya bum pa yang dag ldan// lus dag sprul pa'i sku thob bo// gang dang gang la lhag mos pa// de dang de yi dbang bskur bya// rig pa che yang legs sbyin nas// brtul zhugs rjes su gnang ba dang*// lung bstan dbugs 'byin mtha' brten te// rnam par dbye ba bcu gcig 'dod// de nas slob dpon legs par ni// mnyam par bzhag ste phyag rgya mchod// de nas slob mas £Éda rdzogs dang chos dang ni// dag pa'i skur ni bsgyur bas na// grub pa'i dngul chu chen po'o// de phyir dbang bskur bcu bzhi ste/

dbang bskur re re sa re'o// sbyor ba kun gyi dam pa yin// gang zhig rtag tu 'dod gyur pa// lha dang lha min mi rnams te// 'di dag zil gyis gnon par 'gyur// rgyud 'di ru ni dbang bskur bas// thams cad kyi ni sgrub pa po// gang gis bla ma mnyes byed pa// de yis don kun 'grub pa'i phyir// bdag gi srog kyang 'bul rigs na// dngos po gzhan dag lta ci smos// dpal nā ro pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyi na sngar zhus te bsgyur ba'o// 013) ༄// dbang dang 'brel pa rgyud kyi gdams pa la dpal he ru ka'i sgo nas smin par byed pa/ ༈ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang dang 'brel pa rgyud kyi gdams pa la// dpal he ru ka'i sgo nas dbang bskur ba ste/ rdo rje slob dpon la slob mas lan gsum gyi bar maṇ+ḍal dang*/ me tog bcas pas gsol ba gdab pa sngon du 'gro ba la/ bla mas gnang ba byin te thun mong gi rten bshams pa la sogs pa bya ba'i rim pa rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ bla ma stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ 'gro ba thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom ste/ skad cig gis he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed pa'i gas bsags pa de dag kyang sems kyi rnam pa tsam du shes pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas rang gi snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum bskyed/ phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang mtshams bzhir bum pa dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang*/ lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir sku gsung tha pa dang*/ dus gzhan dang*/ skye ba gzhan dang*/ skal pa gzhan dang*/ theg pa gzhan du gyur pa ma yin par khyed rnams bar chad lnga dang bral bas nges par skal ba dang ldan pa'i phyir lam mchog tu gyur pa la bzhugs pas blo spro bar gyis shig ces gdams pa bstan pa'o// de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal dang me tog phul te phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/

rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba 'dis// mtha' yas sems can don gyi phyir// dkyil 'khor mchog gi dbang bskur gsol// zhes lan gsum gdab bo// de nas bla mas gnang ba ni/ bu kun tshur shog thar pa yis// grong khyer nyams dgar khyed gzhugasangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// zhi ba mnyam pa nyid dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas thun mong gi sdom pa bstan te/ lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*// ngag gi las ni rnam bzhi dag /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni// ci nus par ni rjes su bsrung*// sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// 'khor ba dag kyang nges mi spangs// rtag tu mya ngan 'das la gnas// lha dang lha min gsang ba la// de la brnyas par mi bya zhing*// phyag rgya la sogs mtshon cha dang*// mtshan mar 'gong bar mi bya ste// de ltar sdom par gsung ba dag /blo ldan khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung*// ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa zhu ba'i phyir/ bla ma la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med ye shes mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// ces gsol ba lan gsum gdab bo// de nas bar der yan lag bdun pa brjod nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bor gyur pa dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi gsung la skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin du thugs la yang sbyar te skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya'o// de nas slob mas kyang rdo rje 'chang gi zag med kyi bde ba 'dod pa'i bsam pas thal mo sbyar te/

dga' chen khyod ni ston pa po// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen pos tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de ni bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa la gnas par gdams pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod naṅge skyob pa yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten 'jug pa rtogs nas su// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod nas/ slob mas sdom pa bzung ste/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ci srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ci ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsam ste bzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yis// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pa

V'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor bzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po ste// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum brjod pa'o// de nas slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le byas nas/ yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas khro bo'i sngags ga gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun// sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu gcod// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med deng 'dir rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yun du bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// nges pa rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po 'byung ba yi// rang byung skal pa chen po la// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yis// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes bya ba 'di dag gis spro ba bskyed pa'o// de nas slob dpon bdag nyid kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa rgyas par phul nas/ slob ma de dag gis me tog gi phreng ba bzung ste/ oṃ pra ti ts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes brjod me tog bla ma'i thugs kar phul/ bla mas kyang pra ti gh+radz+ra pa O oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ta laṃ hriḥzhes brjod la gdong g.yogs phye bar bya'o// de nas dbang bskur bya ste/ chu'i dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul te/ phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid che// ci ltar yon tan che 'byung ba// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// ces brjod pa dang*/

bla ma'i thugs kar paV dang nyi ma'i gdan la mi bskyod pa/ badz+rang*/ lha'i bu rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang*/ sgra rdo rje ma la sogs pas rol mo sna tshogs sgrog par bsam zhing rdo rje'i glu len/ oṃ shrīḥsarba ta tha ga ta badz+ra a £ི ṣir hūṃ/ zhes brjod pa dang*/ rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi// zhe sdang rnam dag mi bskyod pas// dpal ldan chu'i dbang bskur ro// zhes gsungs shing*/ dbang bskur/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang*// zhe sdang mi bskyod pa dang me long lta bu'i ye shes yin pa la yin par ngo sprad cing byin gyis brlabs par bsgom mo// mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang ngo*// yang sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab la slob dpon gyi dpral ba'am lte bar paV dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rin chen 'byung ldan ra*da par gyur nas/ bdag nyid kyi dpral ba'am lte bar thim pas lus ser ltems kyis gang bas tshor ba'i phung po dang nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su ngo sprod cing byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ shriḥsarba ta tha ga ta ra* a £ི ṣi traṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag la// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi// nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan gyi// rdo rje cod pan dbang bskur ro// rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang ngo*// yang sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab la slob dpon gyi mgrin par paV dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ snang ba mtha' yas paV he ru ka yab yum snyoms 'jug mdzad de/ de'i sbyor mtshams las byang sems kyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ paV kyi// rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ shriḥsarba ta tha ga ta paV a £ི ṣi hriḥzhes gsung zhing dbang bskur 'du shes kyi phung po dang 'dod chags 'od dpag med dang*/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su ngo sprad cing byin gyis brlabs par bsgom mo// snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// yang sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab la slob dpon gyi lte ba'am gsang gnas nas/

don yod grub pa karma he ru ka yab yum gyi sbyo dag pa// bya ba nan tan ye shes kyi// phrag dog don yod grub pa yi// dril bu chen po'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ shriḥsarba ta tha ga ta karma a £ི ṣi+os kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can// gti mug rnam par snang mdzad kyi// dpal ldan ming gi dbang bskur ro// oṃ shriḥsarba ta tha ga ta £à Z a nu £ི sho Z Z rma Z tu dz+nya na a £ི ṣi sa ma ye shriḥ¨áཾཾ/ gzugs kyi phung po dang*/ gti mug rnam par snang mdzad dang chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin du/ gdod nas gnas pa ngo ma shes par mdzad cing gsal gdab byin gyis brlabs/ kye* dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes brjod cing*/ bkra shis dang rol mo'i sgra dang gu gul la sogs bsreg go /rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang ngo*// de nas sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang nus pa bstan par bya ba ni/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom du bcug nas/ oṃ badz+ra hūṃ/ zhes lag pa g.yas su rdo rje gtad la/ hūṃ) thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyoms tshul dag pa'i bdag /ces so// de nas dril bu lag pa g.yon du gtad de/ oṃ Zrma a/ zhes brjod nas/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa sems dpa'i mchog /srid pa mchog gi mdzad pa yin// ces dril bu bkrol zhing rdo rje 'chang gi skur bskyed pa ste/ stong pa'i rang sgra sgrog pa'o// de nas phyag rgya'i dam tshig ni/ 'khyud pa'i tshul du byed rab cing*/ rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo nyid// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yis// rang gi sku'i sbyor ba yis// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya// oṃ ā badz+ra sa ma yā badz+ra ho// ces so// rang gzhan gyi rig pa thams cad gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mtshon pa rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig

sgra thams cad skye med brjod du med pa dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha sku phyag rgya chen por shes pa phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig ste dam tshig gsum dang 'bral ba med par mdzod cig /ces gdams so// de nas gzhan don nus pa'i slob ma yod na/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur bar bya ste/ maṇ+ḍadabang lnga dang dam tshig sbyin zhing bum pa'i chus khrus byas te/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta shriḥr* gu ru a £ི ṣi sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas chu zhabs gyen la 'khyil bas/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan par bsgom/ oṃ su pra ti\ badz+ra swahā/ zhes bya bas brtan par bya/ zhing khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol bar bya'o// de nas gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyis rgyas gdab cing mchod pa lnga phul la 'di skad du/ dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni// 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par// mchod pa kun dang ldan pa la// dus kun du ni bde bar rol// zhes so// de nas rjes gnang sbyin te/ ngo bo nyid kyi sems can rnams// ci lta ci ltar 'dul 'gyur zhing*// de lta de ltar chags la sogs// dri med sems can don bya'o// ces so// de nas dus thams cad du khur khur ba dang*/ zhing las tshong dang khe skyed la sogs dman pa'i las mi bya zhing bla ma ma mnyes par mi bya ba dang*/ gsang ba 'di dasngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi bdag /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu// bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan no// dkyil 'khor zab mo 'dir dbang bskur ba ni/ dkyil 'khor thams cad du dbang bskur ba yin zhing*/ gang dag rdo rje slob dpon gyis lung bstan pa de la/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu lung ston cang te'u nyid// ka pā la ni in dras brgyan// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa// dpa' bo chen pos bzung bar bgyi// zhes gdams pa dang bcas pa bstan no// de nas dbugs dbyung ba ni/

gsang mchog dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir// mthong ba dang ni zhugs gyur pa// sdig pa kun las yongs grol ba// khyed rnams de nyid legs par gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te// mi thub pa dang mi chod pa// cis kyang mi 'jig dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir// ston pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin// ces so// de nas gzengs bstod cing mchog tu spro ba bskyed pa ni/ gsang mchog 'dir ni legs gnas pa// de ring skye ba 'bras bu bcas// lha dang dam tshig mnyam pa ru// deng khyod 'gyur bar the tshom med// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa// kun gyi de ring khyod dbang bskur// khams gsum 'dir ni khyod dbang phyug /rgyal ba'i bdag por bstan pa yin// des ni bdud las rnam rgyal te// grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs// khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas nyid// de ring thob par the tshom med// ces brjod do// de nas ci 'byor pa'i me tog phul nas/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal bar bya'o// bla mas kyang nan tan du gdams pa ni/ rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung// rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod// rtag tu bla ma la yang gus// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra bya ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas bstan no// de dag gis dbang bskur ba dngos bstan no// de'i rjes sam yang na tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dus su/ mchod pa dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas byin gyis brlabs par bya ste/ de ltar dbang bskur ba de rnams mdun du bzhag la bla mas ngag tu brjod pa dang dus gcig tu bsgom du bcug ste/ slob ma so so rang rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor lnga'i bdag nyid du yongs su rdzogs par bkod nas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab pa daV dmar po brgyad kyis mtshan par bsam pa'o// nye nas bla ma'i thugs ka'i mi bskyod pa las/

hūṃ mthing ga brgyad 'phros pas pu li ra ma la ya/ mgo bor thod pa'i dum bu dang*/ rab tu gtum mo nas bzung nas/ ma la wa phrag pa'i rtsar gnas pa rdo rje'i lus dang*/ shing grib ma'i bar du bstan pa rnams la phog pas yig 'bru bdud rtsir zhu ma'i snying kha'i chos 'khor du bde chen yab yum la hūṃ mthing nag dang baṃ dmar po gnyis 'phros/ rang gi snying kha'i bde mchog yab yum la phog pas/ yig 'bru bdud rtsir zhu ba dang yab yum la bde ba lhang gis skyes par bsgom/ de dang dus mnyam du lha mo bcu gnyis dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad kyi rgyud la bde ba skyes par bsam/ de nas yig 'bru gnyis po yang rdo rje gnyis su gyur pas mtshan par bsam// de nas dmigs pa rtse gcig pas ma yengs par bsgom zhing dbang gi ye shes lam du bya ste/ de dag ni byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bya'o// de nas bla ma'i thugs ka'i yab yum dang 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs thams cad snyoms par zhugate 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa yab yum thams cad gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i nyams myong rgyas te bde ba de nyid kyi dus na/ rang bzhin stong pa bde stong ro gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa ni byin gyis brlabs pa chen po'o// de nas 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs de dag la 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten dag pa lha'i gzhal yas khang du byas/ bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mo'i rnam par byas nas/ thams cad he ru ka yab yum gyi go 'phang la bkod nas/ de dag thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas nas/ slar khams gsum gyi brtan g.yo thams cad 'dus pa rang la thim/ rang yang lus dkyil gyi 'khor lo lnga'i lha la thim/ 'khor lo lnga po yang rim gyis snying kha'i bde mchog yab yum la thim/

bde mchog yab yum gnyis rim gyis 'dus pa thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ de yang nam mkhar sprin dengs pa bzhin du dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med du phril gyis song bar bsam ste/ rim gyis 'od gsal du 'jug pa zhes bya'o// de'i ngang la rnam par rtog pa 'phro na zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba zhes bya ste/ byin rlabs mthar phyin pa zhes bya'o// de nas ngo sprod par bya ba la gsum las/ dang po sku skye med du ngo sprod pa ni/ lha'i sku me long nang du 'char bar byas la/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin// dag cing gsal la rnyogs pa med// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin ni// bu khyod kyi ni lus la bzhugs// ces pas sku snang la rang bzhin med pa'i don bstan pa'o// gsung rdo rje brjod med du ngo sprod pa ni/ dril bu bkrol te/ thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin te// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam par sbyor// kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal// zhes sgra'i rang bzhin 'gag med gsung la ngo sprad pa'o// thugs rdo rje rtog med du ngo sprod pa ni/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa bstan te/ hūṃ) ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// skye med thugs kyi rdo rje 'di// bu khyod snying la yang dag zhugs// ces rdo rje gnyis med kyi ye shes ngo sprad pa'o// de dag ni thog mar dbang bskur ba dang*/ bar du byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ tha mar ngo sprad pa'i sgo nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang gi ngo sprod smin par mdzad pa/ yang snying gsang ba'i gdams pa zhes bya ba ste/

rje nā ro pa chen pos mar pa/ des mar pa mgo yag la gdams pa// des ngan rdzong £ོ de ra tsa la/ des rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa spu hreng ba seng ge grags pa la gdams nas/ des yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// de phyis dge slong chos kyi grags pas 'chi med grub pa yin gsungs/ / 014) ༄// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i me dbang gi cho ga bzhugs so// ༈ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// dbang bskur mchog tu gyur pa yi// gtum mo me yi dbang bskur bstan// dbang bskur dsdom pa la sogs pa rgyas par byed na/ bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o// 'di rgyas pa'i dbang dka'/ 'di las zab pa med/ dbang bsdus pa 'di byed pa las rgyas pa byed pa nyung gsung 'di nyid ma thob na// gtum mo sgom pa don re chung*// gtum mo byed 'dod rnal 'byor pas// bla ma dam pa rab bsten nas// dbang bskur 'di ni brtson pas zhu// 'di la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes dang gsum mo// dang po la gnyis te/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ sbyang ba'o/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma la zhu ba'o/ gnyis pa sbyang ba ni/ man ngag gzhan du shes par bya'o/ dngos gzhi la gsum/ sa chog sta gon/ zhag gi cho ga dang gsum mo// dkyus so// dang po sa chog ni/ sa brtag pa dang*/ sa blang ba dang*/ sa sbyang ba dang*/ sa srung ba rnams te/ rim pa bzhin du bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa sta gon la gsum/ lha sta gon/na slob ma'i don gyi phyir// sang ni dal 'khor 'bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsum brjod pa ni/ sta gon gyi skabs so// gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa de nyid rgyas par na bum pa drug bsdus na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis las/ rnam rgyal du lha rdzogs pa/ las bum du mkha' 'gro ma ro langs bde ba sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/

g.yas g.yon dang po gri gug dang thod pa can/ 'og ma gnyis cang te'u dang kha ṭ+wāṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus bzlas pas mchod cing bstod pa ni/ hūṃ ) rdo rje mkha' 'gro las byed pa// khaṇ+ḍa ro he bde ba'am dpal// dmar mo rgyan ldan lha mo che// lha mo khyod la bdag bstod do// zhes bstod nas byang shar du gzhug go /dbang ma thob kyi bar du bar chad bsrung du gsol bya'o// de nas rnam rgyal shin tu dag par bkrus/ kha dog dmar pos bgos la/ dbus su me'i dal/ phyogs bzhir gri gug gi mtshan ma 'bri/ nang bcud kyis dgang*/ kha rgyan bzung*/ bum pa'i steng du ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba dang*/ rdo rje gzung thag gzhag gcig mas { las } med na dbus dang phyogs bzhir 'bri/ bsangs sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dal/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu de'i steng du laṃ las ri rab/ de'i steng du ¨áཾཾ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ de'i nang du me'i klong rim bsam/ de'i klong du mkha' 'gro ma lnga bsam ste/ thams cad sku mdog dmar po g.yas na me'i gri gug g.yon na me'i thod pa/ dbu skra dang sen mo ba spu rnams me 'bar ba bsgom/ gtso mo'i zhal rang la dang*/ 'khor rnams gtso mo'i zhal la drgyas par na gtso mo lnga la rigs kyi ḍāk+ki mang pos bskor ba'am/ lnga lnga bsgom bltas par bsgom/ de nas gtso mo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dal tsha ba zhig bsam la/ de'i dbus su dbsdus pa la a/ phyogs bzhir a ha ri ni sa bzhi po dmar rong re bsam la/ bzlas pa byas pas/ 'od zer 'phros nas sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can rnams bsregs nas rang la 'dus pas rang yang dang po tshig par bsam/ bar du rang la me 'bar bar bsam/ tha ma mkha' 'gror bsam la bzlas pa 'bum tsho gcig tsam du/ a ha ri ni sa drnam rgyal nas slob ma sta gon ni/ yol ba'i nang du slob mas bla ma la yon phul la/ gsol ba 'di skad gdab bo// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/

mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas sa rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dang*// de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan phyed brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa// shākya seng ge la sogs pas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang 'di yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces pa byas la don bshad do// de nas spro ba skyed de/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rnal 'byor la sogs pa// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes pas nyan par rna ba gtod cig don gshad pa'o/ de nas sdig pa gshags par bya ste/ rtsa ltung dang yi ge brgya pa bya'o// de la sogs pa bdun rnam dag gang yang rung ba drang gang bde ba byas nas/ de nas sdom pa sbyin par dgsol ba gdab par bya ste/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge bas chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// dam tshig dag kyang bdag la gsol// pa V'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rigs mchog chen po la// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis skyed par bgyaVུ mchog gi dngos grub bo// rtsa ba rang la bstan na bskyar la bya'o// de nas rtswa ku sha bsang la/

a ha ri ni sa ces pas byin te/ rtswa mchog ku sha dag byed pa// dag byed rtswa mchog ku sha 'di// stan dang rngas su byin pa yis/ rmi lam gang yin bstan du gsol// ces pas byin la/ rmi lam rmis pa de ma brjed par nangs par nga la smros shig bya'ad pa phyir bsal de// nyes pa kun las skyab tu gsol// zhes pas dskyes pa g.yas dang bu med g.yon ga go /rmi lam rmis pa rnams nangs par nga la smros shig bya/ bla mas dal gyi lha rnams mchod nas gtor ma btang ngo*// de nas nangs par bla mas slob ma'i rmi lam dri zhing ngan na zlog pa'i cho ga nang gi sbyin sreg bya'o// slob ma sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga'o// de nas nub gsum pa dal zhag gi cho ga ni/ nangs par nyi shar la sta gon gyi lha dnam mkha' la steg la/ thig dyal bdab par bya'o// de nas tshon 'gye bar bya'o// de nas dbus gru gsum dmar po la/ zla gam nag po/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi dmar po gru chad ljang gong ras mdzes mtshon no/ sgo mo phyogs bzhi dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang khu dang bzhi/ 'dod yon dmar dang pha gu ser// dra ba nag po pu shu mdzes// rta babs c bas cha gcig ljang gu'o// pu shu phra mor bri bar bya// rta babs mdzes mtshon mun pa nag /ka ba ser la lhag pa phyogs// dkar dang ser dang dmar ljang nag /'dod yon pan tsa yin par 'dod// phyi rol dur khrod nag po la// phyogs skyong la sogs rang rang mdog /pa V ra ba mdzes pas skor// rdo rje dkar la me ri dmar// dal ni rgyas par 'bri bar bya// de nas dal rgyan la dmaṇ+ḍa dang bla re su tsa dang tsaka dal skyed par bya'o// dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i rjes la sngar gyi lha rnams dbab ddbus dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma'i dal la gri gug dmar mo bris la/ 'byung bzhi ri rab kyi steng du ¨áཾ las gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i me'i klong gi nang du mkha' 'gro lnga bskyed/ thams cad g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa/

dbu skra dang*/ ba spu rnams nas me 'bar bar bsgom/ gtso mo rang la zhal bstan 'khor rnams gtso mo zhal bstan/ de nas gtso mo'i thugs kar me'i dal gyi dbus su a/ phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa dmar rong nge ba bsam/ lha bskyed pa'i rjes la sta gon gyi lha bstim pa sogs bya'o dmchod gtor tshogs dbul ra 'dir ni bzhugs par 'tshal// zhes brjod pas mkha' 'gro lngas gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ de nas spro ba skyed par bya ste/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la sogs pa sngar ltar du byas la/ nyan pa rna gtod cig pa'i bar du bya'o// de nas bla mas slob ma de shar sgor khrid la 'di skad bya'o// bdun rnam dag la sogs pa byas te/ sngar gyi sdom pa rnams 'dir yang skyor/ de nas dam tshig bsgrags te/ rdo rjemago la bzhag la 'di skad do// deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis dngos grub gang gis ta thā thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub phra mo gzhan lta ci smos na/ de lta bu'i ye shes de khyod la ngas skyed par bya yis/ khyod kyi dal la ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas yang rdo rje bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig ste// gal te tshul 'di smras pa ni// rdo rje 'di yis dam tshig gis// khyod kyi mgo bo 'gas par byed// ces brjod/ de nas snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ hū+ūṃ ) rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag 'jug par byed// gal te tshul 'di smra na ni// de ma thag tu bral te gshegs// zhes bya'o// de nas dri chu lce la bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub tu// rdo rje sems ma'i dngos grub 'byung*// oṃ badz+ra badz+ra hūṃ dza/ zhes brjod/ de rnams kyi yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig bsgrags pa tshar ro// de nas bla ma'i dam tshig gi bsgrags te 'di skad do// deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/

ngas 'di byos shig ces bka' sgo ba de bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig byas na khyod mi bde ba'i dmyal bar 'gyur ro bya'i sgrib pa dag par bsam mo// de nas rlung me drod kyi rang bzhin de/ rkang pa'i mthil nas rang 'bar de// snying dkyil sdig pa sna nas thon// khaṇ+ḍa ro hes gsol bar bsam// drag por rlung bud par bya// sdig pa bral ba'i cho ga'o// de nas ye shes dsku gsung thugs la ye shes dbab thabs gsum yod pa las gang rung bya/ ma phob na gsum ga byas pas mi phebs mi srid legs so dbab par bya/ nyi zla'i khang par 'od kyi lus 'dar zhing g.yo 'dra bar dmigs la/ mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba gdab// rol mo bcas pas ye shes dbab/ ye shes dbab pa'i skabs so// de nas me long maṇ+ḍal du dbum pa'i rtser man ñji steng du me tog dor la tshom bu byas me tog dor la 'di skad do// mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor pos// sngon tshe ye shes snyems pa'i lha// gang yin de la 'bab gyur shog /lha byung ba'i mig btag par bya'o// de nas me tog de de rang du nya ra bya'o/ hū+ūṃ ) rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ ha badz+ra ne tra pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hriḥces pas mig dar phye/ de nas mthong ba bstan te 'di skad do/ hū+ūṃ) ltos shig ltos shig 'di la ltos// da la bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// 'di ni thar ba'i grong mchog yin bya'o// de nas lha rnams dang phyi rim gzhal yas khang bstan te/ shar phyogs na bde drod kyi mkha' 'gro ma ye shes dbu brgyan bya ba yod/ de bzhin du lho phyogs na bde drod sogs 'gre'o// gsang ba kun grol ma/ nub phyogs na bde drod thig le rgyan gsal ma/

byang phyogs na bde drod zhi ba'i mtsho/ dbus phyogs na bde drod kyi mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje nam mkha' rgyan yang zer/ lus med kyi mkha' 'gro yang zer/ rdo rje phag mo yang zer/ me 'bar drod skyed ma yang zer ba de rnams dang mjal bar bsgom/ de nas bla mas d'dir dbang la gsol ba gdab par bya bum pa'i lha rnams bzhu la bzlas pa gcig kyang bya/ de nas dbang stegs kyi steng du dal gyi shar ngos su bzhag la/ bum pa'i dbang bskur te/ de'i nus pa 'jog pa'i dbang dang*/ dri ma 'khrud pa gnyis yin pa las/ 'di la gnyis ka bya ste/ sngon la las bum gyis khrus byas la dri ma bkrus te 'di skad do/ hūṃ ) ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyi ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a £ི ṣe ka ta hūṃ/ de nas rnam rgyal gyi nus pa skyed par bya ste/ hūṃ) gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// dbang bskur ba ni bum pa'i dbang*// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki ni a £ི ṣe ka ta hūṃ/ ces pas gnas dgur bgod cing ting nge 'dzin brlabs la/ bum rdzas btung bar bya'o// ngo bo mi bskyod pa la rnam pa ye shes dbu rgyan/ rang bzhin byang sems dkar dmar gyi bde bas khengs par sgom/ de nas dbu rgyan dka pa la'i rdzas gyi dbang bskur bar bya ste/ hū+ūṃ ) dbu rgyan dar dpyang cod pan 'di// rgyal ba kun gyi byin gyis brlabs// byin rlabs rgya chen 'di btags pas// las dang nyon mongs bral gyur cig /oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a £ི ṣe ka ta hūṃ/ ces dang*/ gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa/ dbang bskur ba ni dbu rgyan dbang*// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ ra* ḍā ki ni a £ི ṣe hūṃ maṃ/ ces pas ngo bo rin 'byung la rnam pa gsang ba kun grol nyams su myong ba lhang ba skyes par sgom/

de nas dbum pa dang rdo rje sgrag par bya ste/ bsdus pa la rdo rje rkyang du bya'o/ yang las bum dang sgrags la bya'o rdo rje'i dbang bskur ste/ rdo rje dgu pa bsangs la snang ba mtha' yas su mos pa bya/ rdo rje rtse dgu rab tu dpa' gyur pa// sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms mdzad dbang*// skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a £ི ṣe ka ta maṃ/ de nas rtse lnga pas 'di skad do/ hū+ūṃ) gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje'i dbang*// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ paV ḍā ki ni a £ི ṣe hūṃ/ ces pas/ ngo bo snang ba mtha' yas la// rnam pa thig les rgyan gsal ma// rang bzhin mi rtog pa'i ye shes so// de nas dril bu bsangs la 'di skad do// hū+ūṃ) chos dbyings ye shes dril bu che// thogs med dus nas da lta'i bar// sdig byas ma lus sbyang byas te// dril bu'i dbang bskur dam pa sbyin// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a £ི ṣe ka ta hūṃ/

ces pas khrus bya d ces pas bla mas bsil lo// de nas/ hū+ūṃ ) gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// dbang bskur ba ni dril bu'i dbang*// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ karma ḍā ki ni a £ི ṣe maṃ hūṃ/ ces pas slob ma la gtad la bsil/ ngo bo don yod grub pa la// rnam pa mkha' 'gro zhi ba'i mtsho// rang bzhin 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba sgom mo// de nas rdo rje dang dril bu snol ba la ddril lcer bzung la zer ba'ang gda' bla mas bzung la 'di skad do// ā li kā li dbum pa dang mnyam sbyar nas// thabs dang shes rab hūṃ gi lus// rnam par dag pa rnam snang sku// rdo rje ming mi rab tu sbyangs// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a £ི ṣe ka ta hūṃ/ ces pas bla mas bskur/ de nas slob ma gtad drnam rgyal gyi ming ster bar gda'o la/ hūṃ ) gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// dbang bskur ba ni ming gi dbang*// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ £à Z ḍā ki ni a £ི ṣe maṃ hūṃ/ ces pas mkha' 'gro gang rung res ming gdag go /ngo bo rnam snang las/ rnam pa mkha' 'gro nam mkha' rgyan/ rang bzhin bde stong zung 'jug tu bsam mo// de ni rig pa'i dbang ddbang phyi nang gnyis te bcu'o lnga'o/ de ni brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur te/ rdo rje gtad la 'di skad do// hū+ūṃ ) thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje rgyal po dga' ba che// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /phyag rgya chen po'i brtul zhugs te/ zhes pas sbyin no/ de nas bla ma'i dbang bskur te/ bu la rgyan drgyas par byed na brgyad po bya'o skon la 'di skad do/ rdo rje slob dpon dpa' chas 'di// bu yi lus la bskon pa yi// bar chad ma lus bsal byas te// rdo rje slob dpon dbang du sbyin// oṃ badz+ra d'dir me long dang thur ma'i dam byed pa'ang yod

rak+ṣa hūṃ/ de ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs kyi dang bla ma'i dbang drig pa'i dbang lnga la phyi nang gnyis de bcu thams cad la rjes ma gnyis te bcu gnyis me long me long gnyis med bcu bzhi yod gnyis te bdun po thun mong gi dbang bdun zhes bya'o// 'di ni khyad par gyi dbang bdun bskur te/ slob ma khri'am dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar bzhag la/ 'di skad ces pas snang ba sbyin te/ hūṃ dslob ma thig le byin gyis rlobs pa'ang zer bar gda' sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// bu 'di la ni dgongs mdzod la// zhi ba byang chub sems rgyun gyis// dbang bskur dam pa rab tu sbyin// ces pas dlag mchod kyi ka pa la nas sbyin par bya'o phud re sbyin no// de la dgos pa ni thig le 'bar 'dzag sgom du btub pa'i snang ba'o// de nas me yis lus po dgsang gnas su btsug pa skyed la/ yan lag lnga/ nying lag nyi shu/ pus mo gnyis/ gru mo gnyis/ dpung ba gnyis/ rna ba gnyis/ kha dang gsang ba'i gnas gnyis/ mdun rgyab gnyis dang sum cu so gnyis la me skyed pa 'di skad do// hriḥlha mo ye shes gos dkar mo// 'bar ba kun tu 'bar ba de// bu yi lus ngag yid gsum 'bul// me yi lus su dbang bskur cig /byas pas mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje nam mkha' rgyan gyis lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ me'i lus su dmar hril gsum gyis song bar bsam/ de nas bla mas me thog pas brab ste/ de la dgos pa dme ye shes rang snang tsam du bsam zer bshad bde rtsa sum cu so gnyis po de nas me'i a shad sgom du btub pa'i dgos pa yod/ de nas yang slob ma de dkyil krung la sogs sdod lugs legs par bcas la/ sgom thag bcug par sbyang ba ltar bsgom du gzud do// de ltar thun gcig song ba dang*/ me lcags kyi rdza ma'i dbang bskur te 'di gdams ngag ltar bya'o// de yang thun gcig bsgom mo// drod 'dod na 'di gal che dus rtag tu 'di bsgom mo// de nas ras gzhi gos dang sgom thag byin gyis brlabs nas/

tshig 'dis sbyin no// rdo rje me yis ras gos 'di// me yi gos la tsha ba'i dbal// phyi rgol grang ba rtsad bcad nas// rdo rje me ras dbang bskur sbyin// zhes pas ras kyi tho bas slob ma gtsogs pas me la me gsal ba bzhin dmar khro bar bsam/ de nas me ri'i nang du slob ma tshud par bsam mo// de nas sgom thag de rdo rje'i phreng ba me 'bar bar bsgom la/ hū+ūṃ ) rdo rje'i phreng ba me 'od 'bar// bdud dang mu stegs pham byas nas// bu 'di'i byang chub 'dis sgrub cig /drod dang ye shes rab tu 'bar// badz+ra badz+ra hūṃ raṃ/ ces pas sgom thag gzung zhing*/ 'di'i gnas skabs su rje btsun mi la'i lo rgyus bya gsungs/ de nas 'dir rlung bum pa can gyi dmigs pa phog la dar cig sgom ste thun gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa sgom du gzud do// dmigs pa gdams ngag rang 'bog go /de nas de'i rjes la rlung las byed kyi dbang du byas te/ nā ro pa'i rlung badz+ra tsakra la sogs pa rnams sbyin no// de yang gdams ngag ltar ro// de rnams dril bas khyad par dbang bdun po song ngo*// de nas yang bye brag gi dbang gsum sbyin te/ lus byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir gtor dbang ni 'di skad do// hū+ūṃ) 'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma yi dbang*// sku yi gtor dbang dam pa 'di// bu yi lus la bskur bar bya// oṃ āḥhūṃ ¨áཾ ces pas lus rdo rje'i sku 'gyur med du bsam/ de nas ngag tu slob mas ni bzlas pa bya ste/ sngags bsgrags lugs mngon rtogs ltar du phog la a ha ri ni sa zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bgrang bar bya'o// de nas thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ rang lus snang stong gnyis med/ sgra grag stong gnyis med/ sems gsal stong gnyis med kyi ngang nas bskur bya'i yul yang stong*/ bskur byed kyi mkhan po yang stong*/ bskur ba'i ngo bo yang stong par bsam/

snang stong gnyis med gsal stong zung 'jug mtshan ma med pa zhig bsam/ de thams cad dril bas bum pa'i dbang ste/ gtum mo ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i phyi dbang song ngo*// gnyis pa nang gi dbang yang u 'bi sha ba go tsam cig byin gyis brlabs te me'i gseb tu skyur bas/ so sgra dang bcas nas song zhing*/ de'i dri mas bde bar gshegs pa rnams mnyes par bsam/ dus rtag tu de bzhin du bya'o// yang rang yi dam du bsam la dbul/ tshig nas thal ba gcig kyang med par sgom/ yar log mar log gi rlung gis thal ba brlag tu bsam du gzud do// gsum pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma yun ring por bsten te zhu bar bya'o// brgyud pa snga ma la med do// gnyis las phyi dbang dang nang dbang gsum las phyi ma/ hūṃ rin chen dung dkar dri ma med// rdo rje sems dpa'i snying pos brgyan// dkar gsal dri med dung chen dbang*// skal ldan bu la sbyin par bya// zhes pas sbyin no// dung de mdog sa rang gang 'dod dam/ che ba mchog 'dod na g.yon gyi srin lag la bcang ngo c 'di'i lugs la chad lhag med par tshang ba yin no// bka' rgya la rang nyid dbang zhu ba'i sngon rol tu rlung las zla ba re ma byas par bskur du med do// zab mo ´/ thun mong la bcu gnyis/ khyad par bdun te bcu dgu bye brag la gsum te nyer gnyis kyis bum dbang song*/ nang dbang dang nyer gsum po de dbang yin no// de la khyad 'phags gsang dbang nyer bzhi'o/ / 015)༄// dbang dang 'brel ba rgyud kyi gdams pa 'od gsal nyi zla kha sbyor gyi zhal gdams// ༈ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po/ dpal rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa/ rgyud sde rnams kyi bcud bsdus pa/ chos nyid kyi 'od gsal 'chi ba don dam pa'i bden pa bar do dang po 'char ba de/ rnal 'byor pa dbang po rab brtson 'grus kyi lam du bzlog nas sgom pa bstan pa ni/

thabs bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis tshe 'dir nyams su blangs pas bar do dang por ngo sprod pa ni lam bde chen du sbyangs pa zhes bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa 'od gsal bsgom pa snying ga chos 'khor lam du byed pa ni/ rgyud las/ rtag tu snying gi dbus gnas pa// thig le gcig la 'gyur med de// de bsgom byed pa'i skye bo la// ye shes nges par skye bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i don ni/ thun mong bya ba'i rim pa sngon du 'gro bas/ lus gnad rdo rje bsdams pa bya/ mig bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i blta stangs dang bstun nas/ lus kyi nang stong par snang ba'i sgal tshigs kyi nang*/ a wa ZÓ ti rtsa dbu ma'i nang*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba'i thad so tsam du hūṃ mthing nag tser re ba tshon gang ba gcig la dmigs pa drag tu gtad/ de yang rnam pa gsal ba hūṃ du snang ba/ de'i ngo bo stong pa/ hūṃ du snang ba de'i mtshan nyid gnyis med zung 'jug nyams bde stong gi rang bzhin te/ bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can du dmigs pa'o// de la rlung gi gnad sna bug g.yon nas nang du drangs pa dang*/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyis sbyangs la/ dmigs pa'i gnad hūṃ la dmigs pa'i bsam pa gnad du bya ste/ 'byung 'jug gi rlung nang du bcug pas hūṃ las 'od zer kha dog mi 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung bas/ rang gi lus kyi smin mtshams kyi mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo dkar po 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dbus kyi lte ba la yi ge a dkar po yod pa la spros pas a de gsal bar gyur/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la dmigs la 'khor lo la shes pa drag tu gtad pas 'khor lo g.yas su sga ra ra 'khor bar gsum mam bdun bsam mo// de la dmigs pa drag tu gtad pas 'khor lo de g.yas g.yon nas je phra la thig ler gyur/ thig le zla ba dkar po'i rang bzhin dkar la 'tsher ba/

snum la 'dril ba/ kha ba'i rnam pa lta bu thigs la khad pa gcig tu gyur te/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas mar byung bas snying ga'i hūṃ gi steng du lding bar gyur pa dang*/ de la zhag bdun la sogs pa sgoms gsungs so// yang hūṃ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung bas 'og tu 'phros pas gsang gnas mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo dmar po 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte ba la k+ṣa dmar nag yod pa la 'phros nas/ rlung brdegs pas 'og rlung drangs pa'i sbyor bas k+ṣa la thim/ k+ṣa de yang thig le'i rnam par gyur pa dmar la 'od 'tsher ba tsha drod kyi rnam par gyur pa de rtsa dbu ma'i nang du zhugs te/ hūṃ gi 'og tu gdan gyi rnam pa lta bur gyur pa dang*/ nyi zla thabs dang shes rab kyi tshul du gyur pa'i dbus na rig pa'i ngo bo hūṃ gi rnam pa lta bur gyur pa la dmigs pa drag tu gtad pas thig le gnyis po hūṃ la thim par gyur/ hūṃ de yang je phra la thig le dngul chu'i mdog lta bu'i rnam par gyur pa la shes pa gtad cing zla ba drug tu dus gsum du ma yengs par bsgom na bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rgyun gyis dag pa/ zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni gnas lugs 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i don rgyud la 'char ba'o// thig le de yang mi dmigs par bsdu ba phyi snod nang bcud thams cad bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin du rim gyis nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa lta bur gyur par bsgom mo// phyis goms shing brtan nas thun cig car du bsgom par bya'o// de ltar rnal 'byor pa'i thun bzhi la sogs pa'i sgo nas zla ba gsum dang zhag bdun bsgom na dbang po rab kyis nges par dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ pa med par zug rngu dang bral bas bde ba'i ngo bor 'gyur ba'o// de ltar bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis rtsa'i mdud pa thams cad rang sar grol bas/ 'khor lo'i dbus kyi thig le a dang k+ṣa thabs shes rab kyi ngo bo gnyis po snying gar phyin cing srog rtsol gyi rlung dbu mar tshud pas/

gnas skabs su dbang po sgo lnga'i rlung zin pas mngon par shes pa lnga la sogs pa 'char bar 'gyur ba dang*/ lus la rtsa'i yon tan bde ba dang*/ ngag la rlung gi yon tan gsal ba dang*/ sems la mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'od gsal rgyun mi chad pa 'char la/ rnam rtog phra ba bag la nyal dang*/ rags pa mngon du rgyu ba thams cad thim ste lam bde chen du sbyangs pa'i don no// blo phyag rgya chen po la bzhag pa ni/ sems nyid ma bcos pa gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa rig pa'i ye shes skad cig ma lam du khyer ba/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngang du rtogs pa las/ de'i rang bzhin brjod du med pas spros pa dang bral ba de'i ngang las dmigs pa yengs pa med par ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig pas/ blo 'dzin med ting nge 'dzin ni ro gcig pa de yang zhen cing 'dzin pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i ngang las/ shes pa bya bral ma bcos pa/ gnyug ma/ bcos min rang lugs su bzhag pas blo phyag rgya chen po la bzhag pa'i don no// yang snying gsang ba mkha' 'gro ma'i snyan brgyud/ rje btsun rin po che nā ro pa'i gsung gi 'od zer/ bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi rje lo tsā ba'i gsung sgros ji lta ba bzhin du mar pa mgo yag la gdams pa'o// dpal bde mchog gsang ba rin po che yid bzhin nor bu la brten pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa'o// //dge'o// maṅga laṃ £ wajà// 016)༄// dbang bdud grol gyi gdams pa dang chos nyid gnyug ma'i mgur gnyis bzhugs so// dbang bzhi'i don bstan pa/kye * ma bla ma e sangs
